creatives.description: Advertising creatives to create within the specified ad group. Max size: 20. You can create at most 20 ads in one request for a single ad group; make multiple calls to `/ad/create/` to create more ads in the same ad group.

ad_format.description: Ad format. Use `SINGLE_VIDEO` for single video ads, `SINGLE_IMAGE` for single image ads, `CAROUSEL_ADS` for TikTok Standard Carousel ads, `CATALOG_CAROUSEL` for TikTok VSA Carousel ads and automotive catalog carousel scenarios, and `LIVE_CONTENT` for Live Shopping Ads. Once set to `CAROUSEL_ADS` or `CATALOG_CAROUSEL`, this field cannot be updated.

ad_name.description: Ad name. To auto-generate the name, pass an empty string (`""`); the generated name will be the ad ID (`ad_id`). Length limit: 512 characters. Emojis are not allowed. Each Chinese or Japanese word counts as two characters; each English letter counts as one.

ad_text.description: Ad text shown as part of the ad creative. For Spark Ads Push, `ad_text` is required. For non-Spark Ads, either `ad_text` or `ad_texts` must be set. If both `ad_text` and `ad_texts` are specified, `ad_text` is ignored. Max length: 100 characters. Emojis are not allowed. Each Chinese or Japanese word counts as two characters; each English letter counts as one.

ad_texts.description: List of ad texts. Valid only for Search Ads Campaigns. For non-Spark Ads, either `ad_text` or `ad_texts` must be set. If both `ad_text` and `ad_texts` are specified, `ad_text` is ignored. When multiple ad texts are provided, the system automatically selects the most relevant text for the audience. Max size: 5. Each text has a max length of 100 characters and cannot contain emoji. Each Chinese or Japanese word counts as two characters; each English letter counts as one.

aigc_disclosure_type.description: Valid only when `identity_type=CUSTOMIZED_USER`. Controls whether the ad is self-disclosed as AI-generated content. Default is `NOT_DECLARED`. For Single Video or Carousel Ads, you can update this field only when updating the ad creative itself; for example, if you only reorder Carousel images, this field cannot be updated. For Dynamic Format, Catalog Video, and Catalog Carousel ads, this field cannot be updated.

app_name.description: App name displayed in the ad. If omitted, the app store name is used. Length: 1 to 40 characters. If the app store name exceeds 40 characters, you must pass a replacement value here.

auto_disclaimer_types.description: Valid only when campaign `objective_type=LEAD_GENERATION` and `catalog_enabled=true`, the ad group specifies an Auto-Model catalog through `catalog_id`, and this ad sets `ad_format=CATALOG_CAROUSEL`. Disclaimer types to show in Automotive Carousel Ads for Models. Max size: 1.

auto_message_id.description: Required when ad group `promotion_type=LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_TT_DIRECT_MESSAGE`. Automatic message ID for a TikTok Direct Messaging Ad. Currently only welcome messages are supported.

avatar_icon_web_uri.description: Avatar image ID. The image can be uploaded via the image upload endpoint. Required picture ratio is 1:1.

brand_safety_postbid_partner.description: Post-bid third-party brand safety measurement partner. Allowlist-only. Not supported for ACO ads or for ad groups where `promotion_type=LIVE_SHOPPING`. The ad group's pre-bid `brand_safety_type` constrains usage: if ad group `brand_safety_type=NO_BRAND_SAFETY`, you can pass only `viewability_postbid_partner`, not this field; otherwise you may pass both. If passed together with `viewability_postbid_partner`: if either is `IAS`, both must be `IAS` and `brand_safety_vast_url` must equal `viewability_vast_url`; if different partners are passed, only the post-bid brand safety measurement setting becomes valid.

brand_safety_vast_url.description: Wrapped VAST URL used by the post-bid partner to measure brand safety. Required when `brand_safety_postbid_partner=IAS`. Obtain this URL from IAS. Allowlist-only. Not supported for ACO ads or for ad groups where `promotion_type=LIVE_SHOPPING`. When both `brand_safety_postbid_partner` and `viewability_postbid_partner` are `IAS`, `brand_safety_vast_url` must be the same as `viewability_vast_url`.

call_to_action.description: Call-to-action text. For TikTok ads, specify either this field or `call_to_action_id`. If both are specified, this field is ignored. In a Live Shopping Ad where `creative_type=SHORT_VIDEO_LIVE`, this field is required and must be `WATCH_LIVE`.

call_to_action_id.description: CTA portfolio ID. If both this field and `call_to_action` are specified, `call_to_action_id` is used and `call_to_action` is ignored.

card_id.description: Creative portfolio ID. Pass the ID of a supported creative portfolio type such as call-to-action text, Display Card, Website info card, Download Card, Product Card, Product Tiles, Countdown Sticker, Gift Code Sticker, Pop-up Showcase, Gesture, or Superlike. Once a Product Tiles portfolio is included in an ad, you cannot delete it from the ad, though you can update it to a different portfolio.

carousel_image_index.description: Valid only for VSA Carousel ads when additional image URLs have been configured for the specified products. Not supported for Automotive Carousel Ads for Inventory or Models. If omitted, the main catalog product images are used. Value range: 0 to 9. The index refers to the position within each product's `additional_image_urls` list returned by `/catalog/product/get/`. If the index does not match available additional images or image fetch fails, that product is not counted. If at least two products have valid additional images, only those products are shown with additional images; if fewer than two do, all products are shown with main images.

catalog_id.description: Product catalog ID. Required for Shopping Ads when the ad group `product_source` is `CATALOG`; products whose links are shown in the ad come from this catalog. Starting June 30, 2024, when ad group `product_source` is `STORE`, this field is ignored and no longer needs to be passed.

click_tracking_url.description: Click Tracking URL from your measurement partner. If the tracked app's partner ID is `44` (TikTok Business SDK) or `49` (TikTok App API), you do not need to pass this field and it will be ignored if provided. If self-attribution is enabled for the tracked app and the partner ID is not `44` or `49`, this field defaults to the app's configured Click Tracking URL and updates are not supported. Pangle does not support DCM, Sizmek, or Flashtalking.

cpp_url.description: Custom Product Page (CPP) URL for an App Store product page customized for a promoted app. The URL must be consistent with the promoted app (`app_id`). Format: `https://apps.apple.com/{region}/app/{app_name}/id{app_id}?ppid={ppid}`. Length limit: 512 characters. This is an allowlist-only feature.

creative_authorized.description: Whether to authorize displaying some of your ads in TikTok For Business Creative Center. Valid only for non-US advertisers. Default is `false`. This field can only be used for video ads.

creative_auto_enhancement_strategy_list.description: List of automatic enhancement strategies to apply during delivery. Default behavior depends on allowlist status for the "automatic enhancements enabled by default" feature: if allowlisted, this field defaults to the allowlisted strategies; if not allowlisted for any, it defaults to an empty list (`[]`). Automatic enhancements are generally available to all advertisers, but having them turned on by default is a separate allowlist-only feature per enhancement.

creative_type.description: Creative type for Live Shopping Ads, Product Shopping Ads, App Pre-Registration, and automotive catalog scenarios. When ad group `shopping_ads_type=LIVE`, this field is required and can be `SHORT_VIDEO_LIVE` or `DIRECT_LIVE`. When ad group `shopping_ads_type=PRODUCT_SHOPPING_ADS`, you may omit it or set `PSA`. When campaign `app_promotion_type=APP_PREREGISTRATION` and ad group `promotion_website_type=TIKTOK_NATIVE_PAGE`, you may omit it or set `CUSTOM_INSTANT_PAGE`. When campaign `objective_type=LEAD_GENERATION` and `catalog_enabled=true`, you may omit it or set `AUTO_INVENTORY_INSTANT_PAGE`.

dark_post_status.description: Whether the ad is created as a dark post. Default is `ON`. If set as a dark post, it does not appear on the creator's homepage. You can set this to `OFF` only if both the identity's "Show through ads only" mode is disabled and the ad account does not have mandatory "Show through ads only" mode enabled. If the ad account enforces mandatory Ads-only mode, you can only set this field to `ON` when creating Spark Ads using Spark Ads Push. Mandatory ad-account Ads-only mode is allowlist-only.

deeplink.description: Specific in-app destination to open if the audience has the app installed. See `deeplink_type` for the mode. Deferred deeplinks are allowlist-only and require technical implementation. Some non-deferred deeplink scenarios are also allowlist-only.

deeplink_format_type.description: Required together with `deeplink` when campaign `objective_type=TRAFFIC` and ad group `optimization_goal=DESTINATION_VISIT`. Format type of the deeplink. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

deeplink_type.description: Deeplink type. Default is `NORMAL`. If the campaign's `campaign_type=IOS14_CAMPAIGN`, you cannot set this field to `DEFERRED_DEEPLINK`. Deferred deeplinks are allowlist-only; some non-deferred deeplink scenarios are also allowlist-only.

deeplink_utm_params.description: Supported only when ad group `shopping_ads_type=VIDEO`, `product_source=CATALOG`, and `promotion_type` is `WEBSITE`, `APP_ANDROID`, or `APP_IOS`. Max size: 14. If `shopping_ads_deeplink_type=SHOPPING_ADS`, parameters are automatically appended to the product deeplink on delivery. If `shopping_ads_deeplink_type=CUSTOM`, you must manually include the parameters in `deeplink`; if you also pass `deeplink_utm_params`, they are not appended automatically and must exactly match the parameters already used in `deeplink`. Deeplink URL parameters are allowlist-only.

key.description: Deeplink URL parameter key. You can specify a custom parameter or one of the supported UTM parameters: `utm_source`, `utm_medium`, `utm_content`, `utm_campaign`. UTM parameters are case-sensitive. Custom parameter length limit: 100 characters.

value.description: Deeplink URL parameter value. You can specify a custom value or one of the supported macros: `__CAMPAIGN_NAME__`, `__CAMPAIGN_ID__`, `__AID_NAME__`, `__AID__`, `__CID_NAME__`, `__CID__`, `__PLACEMENT__`. Custom value length limit: 600 characters.

disclaimer_clickable_texts.description: Clickable disclaimer entries. Required when `disclaimer_type=TEXT_LINK`. Max size: 3. If you pass multiple clickable disclaimers, both the total combined text length and each individual text length must not exceed 40 characters.

text.description: Clickable disclaimer text. Length limit: 40 characters.

url.description: URL opened when users tap the clickable disclaimer text.

disclaimer_type.description: Disclaimer type for the ad. `TEXT_ONLY` requires `disclaimer_text`; `TEXT_LINK` requires `disclaimer_clickable_texts`. This feature is allowlist-only for some advertiser groups and for all Reach & Frequency objectives. Supported only for objectives `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `REACH`, `TRAFFIC`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, `ENGAGEMENT`, `LEAD_GENERATION`, and `RF_REACH`; only on TikTok placement; and not for Automated Creative Optimization ads. Once added to the ad, a disclaimer cannot be deleted.

display_name.description: Display name for landing page or pure exposure ads. Required when the promotion type is landing page or pure exposure. Length limit: 1 to 40 English characters, or 1 to 20 Chinese/Japanese/Korean characters.

dynamic_destination.description: Dynamic destination strategy. You cannot set this field to `DLP` if ad group `promotion_type` is `APP_ANDROID` or `APP_IOS`. It is also not supported for website-promoting Video Shopping Ads with catalog product source when ad group `shopping_ads_type=VIDEO`, `product_source=CATALOG`, `promotion_type=WEBSITE`, and `optimization_goal` is `CLICK` or `TRAFFIC_LANDING_PAGE_VIEW`.

dynamic_format.description: Dynamic format. When set to `DYNAMIC_CREATIVE`, use dynamic creative behavior and `vertical_video_strategy` must be `UNSET`.

end_card_cta.description: Required when campaign `objective_type=LEAD_GENERATION` and `catalog_enabled=true`, the ad group specifies an Auto-Inventory or Auto-Model catalog through `catalog_id`, and this ad sets `ad_format=CATALOG_CAROUSEL`. CTA for the end card (`image_ids`) of an Automotive Carousel Ad for Inventory or Models.

fallback_type.description: Fallback behavior when the audience does not have the app installed. If set to `WEBSITE`, you must pass `landing_page_url`.

identity_authorized_bc_id.description: Required when `identity_type` is `BC_AUTH_TT`. Business Center ID associated with the TikTok Account User in Business Center identity.

identity_id.description: Identity ID. Used together with `identity_type`. For non-Spark Ads, `identity_id` and `identity_type=CUSTOMIZED_USER` can be used for better ad information management.

identity_type.description: Identity type for the ad. `BC_AUTH_TT` requires `identity_authorized_bc_id`. Used with `identity_id`; for non-Spark Ads, `identity_id` plus `identity_type=CUSTOMIZED_USER` can be used for better ad information management.

image_ids.description: Image IDs used in the ad or as a video cover. For `ad_format=SINGLE_VIDEO`, this field is required for video Spark Ads via Spark Ads Push and for video Non-Spark Ads; only one value is allowed and it is used as the video cover, with the same aspect ratio as the video. For video Spark Ads via Spark Ads Pull, this field is not supported and you must pass `tiktok_item_id` instead. For `ad_format=CAROUSEL_ADS`, this field is required for Standard Carousel Spark Ads via Spark Ads Push and for Standard Carousel Non-Spark Ads; size range is 1 to 35, and the order controls carousel display order. For Standard Carousel Spark Ads via Spark Ads Pull, this field is not supported and you must pass `tiktok_item_id` instead. For `ad_format=CATALOG_CAROUSEL` with campaign `catalog_enabled=true`, this field is required and only one value is allowed; it is used as the summary photo for Automotive Ads for Inventory or Models. For `ad_format=SINGLE_IMAGE`, this field is required and exactly one image ID can be assigned.

impression_tracking_url.description: Default Impression Tracking URL from your measurement partner. If the tracked app's partner ID is `44` (TikTok Business SDK) or `49` (TikTok App API), you do not need to pass this field and it will be ignored if provided. If self-attribution is enabled for the tracked app and the partner ID is not `44` or `49`, this field defaults to the app's configured Default Impression Tracking URL and updates are not supported.

instant_product_page_used.description: Whether to use TikTok Instant Product Page, an auto-generated TikTok instant page that shows a range of products. When `dynamic_destination=DLP`, you do not need this field. When `dynamic_destination=UNSET`, you can set this field to `true` and do not need to pass `page_id`.

item_duet_status.description: Whether to enable dueting for the Spark Ad. Valid only for Spark Ad posts, and only when `promotional_music_disabled=false`.

item_group_ids.description: Product SPU IDs. Required when ad group `shopping_ads_type=PRODUCT_SHOPPING_ADS`, `product_source=STORE`, and `product_specific_type=CUSTOMIZED_PRODUCTS`. When ad group `shopping_ads_type=VIDEO`, `product_source=CATALOG`, and `product_specific_type=PRODUCT_SET`, pass either `item_group_ids` or `product_set_id`. Max size: 20 for `VIDEO` + `CATALOG` + `PRODUCT_SET`; 50 for `PRODUCT_SHOPPING_ADS` + `STORE` + `CUSTOMIZED_PRODUCTS`.

item_stitch_status.description: Whether to enable stitching for the Spark Ad. Valid only for Spark Ad posts, and only when `promotional_music_disabled=false`.

landing_page_url.description: Landing page URL that users are redirected to. It may already include URL parameters appended to the end of the URL.

music_id.description: Required when `ad_format=CAROUSEL_ADS` for Standard Carousel Spark Ads via Spark Ads Push or Standard Carousel Non-Spark Ads, and also required when `ad_format=CATALOG_CAROUSEL`. Music ID to use in the TikTok Carousel ad.

operation_status.description: Ad status when created. Default is `ENABLE`. For Reach & Frequency ads, specify `ENABLE` or omit the field; do not specify `DISABLE`. To update status after creation, use `/ad/status/update/`.

page_id.description: Page ID. Instant Forms are for `LEAD_GENERATION` campaigns and only apply to TikTok placement. Before creating for the first time, you must sign the `LeadAds` agreement through `/term/confirm/`. Collection Ads were sunset on Feb. 16, 2023; do not set a storefront page as your instant page.

page_image_index.description: Valid only when `instant_product_page_used=true` and additional images are configured for the specified products. If omitted, main catalog product images are used on the TikTok Instant Product Page. Value range: 0 to 9. The index refers to the position within each product's `additional_image_urls` returned by `/catalog/product/get/`. If the index exceeds available additional image URLs, this field is ignored and the main product image (`image_url`) is used.

phone_number.description: Required together with `phone_region_calling_code` and `phone_region_code` when ad group `promotion_type=LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_CALL`. Phone number the audience can tap to call. Lead Generation ads with phone-call promotion type are allowlist-only.

phone_region_calling_code.description: Required together with `phone_region_code` and `phone_number` when ad group `promotion_type=LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_CALL`. Region calling code for the clickable phone number, for example `+1`. Lead Generation ads with phone-call promotion type are allowlist-only.

phone_region_code.description: Required together with `phone_region_calling_code` and `phone_number` when ad group `promotion_type=LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_CALL`. Region code for the clickable phone number, for example `US`. Lead Generation ads with phone-call promotion type are allowlist-only.

playable_url.description: Playable material URL, valid in Pangle and TikTok placement. All ads in the same ad group share the same playable material. Starting September 30, 2024, Playable Ads can no longer be created for TikTok placement.

product_display_field_list.description: Valid only when campaign `objective_type=LEAD_GENERATION` and `catalog_enabled=true`, the ad group specifies an Auto-Inventory catalog through `catalog_id`, and this ad sets `ad_format=CATALOG_CAROUSEL`. List of vehicle detail fields to display in Automotive Carousel Ads for Inventory. Max size: 2. The vehicle title is always displayed automatically; for example, if you set `["MILEAGE","YEAR"]`, the ad displays the vehicle `mileage`, `price`, and `title`. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

product_set_id.description: Product set ID. When ad group `shopping_ads_type=VIDEO`, `product_source=CATALOG`, and `product_specific_type=PRODUCT_SET`, pass either `item_group_ids` or `product_set_id`.

product_specific_type.description: Required only when either: ad group `shopping_ads_type=VIDEO` and `product_source=CATALOG`, or ad group `shopping_ads_type=PRODUCT_SHOPPING_ADS` and `product_source=STORE`. Controls how products are selected. For `VIDEO` + `CATALOG`: `ALL` means do not send `sku_ids`, `item_group_ids`, or `product_set_id`; `PRODUCT_SET` requires either `item_group_ids` or `product_set_id`; `CUSTOMIZED_PRODUCTS` requires `sku_ids`. For `PRODUCT_SHOPPING_ADS` + `STORE`: `ALL` means do not send `sku_ids`, `item_group_ids`, or `product_set_id`; `CUSTOMIZED_PRODUCTS` requires `item_group_ids`. Also note: when `shopping_ads_type=VIDEO` and `product_source=STORE`, specify products directly through `item_group_ids`; when `shopping_ads_type=VIDEO` and `product_source=SHOWCASE`, specify products through `showcase_products`; when `shopping_ads_type=LIVE`, no product specification is needed.

promotional_music_disabled.description: Whether to disable promotional use of the music in the Spark Ad. Default is `true`. To allow dueting and stitching for the TikTok video, set this field to `false`. Valid only for Spark Ad posts.

schedule_id.description: Valid only for Reach & Frequency ads. Schedule ID used to associate ad delivery information with the ad inside a Reach & Frequency ad group that has sequenced delivery enabled. After association, `is_draft` is automatically set to `false`, and `schedule_id` becomes the ID of the ad associated with that delivery information. You can confirm association by calling `/adgroup/get/` and checking `is_draft` and `schedule_id`.

shopping_ads_deeplink_type.description: Source of the deeplink used in Shopping Ads. Default is `NONE`. If set to `CUSTOM`, you must also pass `deeplink`. `SHOPPING_ADS` is not supported when ad group `shopping_ads_type=VIDEO` and `product_source=CATALOG`, and at the ad level either `ad_format=SINGLE_VIDEO` with `vertical_video_strategy=SINGLE_VIDEO`, or `ad_format=CATALOG_CAROUSEL`. Deferred deeplinks are allowlist-only; some non-deferred deeplink scenarios are also allowlist-only.

shopping_ads_fallback_type.description: Fallback website type in Shopping Ads retargeting when the deeplink cannot be triggered. If set to `CUSTOM`, you must also pass `landing_page_url`. `SHOPPING_ADS` is not supported when ad group `shopping_ads_type=VIDEO` and `product_source=CATALOG`, and at the ad level either `ad_format=SINGLE_VIDEO` with `vertical_video_strategy=SINGLE_VIDEO`, or `ad_format=CATALOG_CAROUSEL`.

showcase_products.description: Required when ad group `product_source=SHOWCASE`. List of Showcase products to use in the ad. Max size: 20. Available Showcase products can be retrieved from `/showcase/product/get/`.

catalog_id.description: Catalog ID that the product (`item_group_id`) belongs to. Starting June 30, 2024, when ad group `product_source` is `STORE`, this field is ignored.

item_group_id.description: SPU ID of the Showcase product.

store_id.description: Store ID that the product (`item_group_id`) belongs to. Only TikTok Shop store type is supported.

sku_ids.description: SKU IDs. Required when ad group `shopping_ads_type=VIDEO`, `product_source=CATALOG`, and `product_specific_type=CUSTOMIZED_PRODUCTS`. Max size: 20.

tiktok_item_id.description: TikTok post ID to use as a Spark Ad. Required when `identity_type=AUTH_CODE`, or when `identity_type=BC_AUTH_TT` and you create Spark Ads through Spark Ads Pull. Not supported when `identity_type=CUSTOMIZED_USER`. Pass the `item_id` returned by `/tt_video/info/` or `/identity/video/get/`. By using Spark Ads, you confirm you have the rights to use the music in the videos for commercial purposes.

tiktok_page_category.description: Required when the ad group's `optimization_goal=PAGE_VISIT`. Determines the TikTok page category to promote. `PROFILE_PAGE` requires neither `landing_page_url` nor `page_id`. `OTHER_TIKTOK_PAGE` requires `landing_page_url` with the specific TikTok page URL. `TIKTOK_INSTANT_PAGE` requires `page_id`. This field cannot be updated after creation. If set to `OTHER_TIKTOK_PAGE`, `landing_page_url` also cannot be updated after ad creation.

tracking_app_id.description: Application ID used to track offsite app events. Supported for auction objectives `REACH`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, `TRAFFIC`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `LEAD_GENERATION`, `APP_PROMOTION`, `PRODUCT_SALES`, `ENGAGEMENT`, and Reach & Frequency `RF_REACH`. If ad group `app_id` is specified and you want offsite app event tracking, this field must match the ad group `app_id`; otherwise you may pass any app ID to track.

tracking_message_event_set_id.description: Valid only when ad group `promotion_type=LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_SOCIAL_MEDIA_APP_MESSAGE`, `optimization_goal=CLICK`, `messaging_app_type` is `MESSENGER` or `WHATSAPP`, and `page_id` is not passed. Message event set ID used to measure when users start a conversation in the instant messaging app. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

tracking_offline_event_set_ids.description: Offline Event Set IDs to track and measure offline activity from people who see or interact with the ads. Max size: 50. If omitted, this field defaults to all existing auto-tracking Offline Event Set IDs under the advertiser account. If you pass this field manually, you must include at least all existing auto-tracking Offline Event Set IDs; non-auto-tracking sets are optional. Supported objectives: `REACH`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, `TRAFFIC`, `LEAD_GENERATION`, `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `ENGAGEMENT`, and `PRODUCT_SALES`. If campaign `objective_type=PRODUCT_SALES`, you can use this field only in Video Shopping Ads where ad group `shopping_ads_type=VIDEO` and `product_source=CATALOG`.

tracking_pixel_id.description: Pixel ID used to track offsite events. Supported for auction objectives `REACH`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, `TRAFFIC`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `LEAD_GENERATION`, `APP_PROMOTION`, `PRODUCT_SALES`, `ENGAGEMENT`, and Reach & Frequency `RF_REACH`. For auction objectives, if ad group `pixel_id` is specified and you want to use pixel tracking, `tracking_pixel_id` must match that ad group `pixel_id`; otherwise you may pass any pixel ID to track. For Reach & Frequency objectives, you may pass any pixel ID to track.

utm_params.description: List of URL parameters, supported only in specific objective and placement scenarios including Product Sales VSA for Catalog, automotive catalog scenarios, and several other campaign objectives. Max size: 14. For VSA for Catalog, if `shopping_ads_fallback_type=SHOPPING_ADS`, the parameters are automatically appended to the product link on delivery. If `shopping_ads_fallback_type=CUSTOM`, you must manually include the parameters in `landing_page_url`; if you also pass `utm_params`, they will not be appended automatically and must exactly match the parameters already present in `landing_page_url`, or an error occurs. In automotive catalog scenarios, the parameters are automatically appended to the product link. In other supported scenarios, if `landing_page_url` already includes parameters, you may also pass `utm_params` to store them, but they will not be appended automatically and must exactly match the URL.

key.description: URL parameter key. You can specify a custom parameter or one of the supported UTM parameters: `utm_source`, `utm_medium`, `utm_content`, `utm_campaign`. UTM parameters are case-sensitive. Custom parameter length limit: 100 characters.

value.description: URL parameter value. You can specify a custom value or one of the supported macros: `__CAMPAIGN_NAME__`, `__CAMPAIGN_ID__`, `__AID_NAME__`, `__AID__`, `__CID_NAME__`, `__CID__`, `__PLACEMENT__`. Custom value length limit: 600 characters.

vehicle_ids.description: Vehicle IDs. Required when campaign `objective_type=LEAD_GENERATION` and `catalog_enabled=true`, the ad group specifies an Auto-Inventory or Auto-Model catalog through `catalog_id`, and this ad sets `product_specific_type=CUSTOMIZED_PRODUCTS`. Max size: 20.

vertical_video_strategy.description: Video type for Product Sales scenarios. Must be `UNSET` when `dynamic_format=DYNAMIC_CREATIVE`. `CATALOG_UPLOADED_VIDEOS` is allowlist-only. If you set `vertical_video_strategy` to `CATALOG_UPLOADED_VIDEOS`, you cannot later update it to a different value.

video_id.description: Video ID. Required when `ad_format=SINGLE_VIDEO` and `identity_type=CUSTOMIZED_USER`. When `ad_format=SINGLE_VIDEO` and `identity_type` is `TT_USER` or `BC_AUTH_TT`, pass either `video_id` or `tiktok_item_id`. Not supported when `ad_format` is `SINGLE_IMAGE` or `CAROUSEL_ADS`. For Spark Ads, you can use either `video_id` or `tiktok_item_id`. TikTok recommends using `/file/video/ad/upload/` with `upload_type=UPLOAD_BY_VIDEO_ID` to bind the video ID with the advertiser ID.

video_view_tracking_url.description: Monitoring URL for video view tracking.

viewability_postbid_partner.description: Post-bid third-party viewability measurement partner. Allowlist-only. Not supported for ACO ads or for ad groups where `promotion_type=LIVE_SHOPPING`. If passed together with `brand_safety_postbid_partner`: if either is `IAS`, both must be `IAS` and `brand_safety_vast_url` must equal `viewability_vast_url`; if either is `ZEFR`, both must be `ZEFR`; if different partners are passed, only the post-bid brand safety measurement setting becomes valid.

viewability_vast_url.description: Wrapped VAST URL used by the post-bid partner to measure viewability. Required when `viewability_postbid_partner=IAS`. Obtain this URL from IAS. Allowlist-only. Not supported for ACO ads or for ad groups where `promotion_type=LIVE_SHOPPING`. When both `brand_safety_postbid_partner` and `viewability_postbid_partner` are `IAS`, `brand_safety_vast_url` must be the same as `viewability_vast_url`.

exclude_field_types_in_response.description: Field types to exclude from the response.

fields.description: Fields to return. Use field names from the response `list` object. If omitted, all fields are returned by default.

ad_ids.description: List of ad IDs. Max size: 100.

ad_ids_v2.description: List of v2 ad IDs. Supports Manual Ad IDs and Upgraded Smart+ Ad IDs. Max size: 100. When filtering by Upgraded Smart+ Ad IDs, the response includes only `advertiser_id`, `campaign_id`, `campaign_name`, `adgroup_id`, `adgroup_name`, `ad_id_v2`, `ad_name`, and `campaign_automation_type`.

adgroup_ids.description: List of ad group IDs. Max size: 100.

buying_types.description: Buying types to filter by. Default: `["AUCTION", "RESERVATION_RF"]`. `RESERVATION_TOP_VIEW` cannot be combined with other values; to filter TopView ads, set this field to `["RESERVATION_TOP_VIEW"]`.

campaign_ids.description: List of campaign IDs. Max size: 100.

campaign_system_origins.description: Origins of the campaigns the ads belong to. Default: `["TT_ADS_PLATFORM"]`. If set to `PROMOTE`, only `advertiser_id`, `campaign_id`, `campaign_name`, `adgroup_id`, `adgroup_name`, `ad_id`, `ad_name`, `create_time`, `operation_status`, and `secondary_status` can be retrieved for those ads.

creation_filter_end_time.description: Return ads created earlier than this UTC timestamp in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` format. For performance and reliability, keep the creation-time filter within a six-month range.

creation_filter_start_time.description: Return ads created later than this UTC timestamp in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` format. For performance and reliability, keep the creation-time filter within a six-month range.

destination.description: Destination page type to filter by. `APP` applies when the ad group's `promotion_type` is `APP_ANDROID` or `APP_IOS`. `TIKTOK_INSTANT_PAGE` applies when the ad specifies a TikTok Instant Page `page_id`. `WEBSITE` applies when the ad specifies `landing_page_url`. If you also specify `objective_type`, only destination values supported for that objective are valid.

modified_after.description: Return ads modified after this UTC timestamp in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` format. For performance and reliability, keep the modification-time filter within a six-month range.

objective_type.description: Advertising objective. If you filter by either `WEB_CONVERSIONS` or `CONVERSIONS`, the response returns ads for both `WEB_CONVERSIONS` and `CONVERSIONS`.

secondary_status.description: Ad secondary status. Not returned in the sandbox environment because ads are not actually delivered. Valid values depend on the `primary_status` you specify.

page.description: Current page number. Default: `1`. Value range: `>= 1`.

aco_ad_ids.description: List of ACO ad IDs to update. Allowed quantity: `1-20`. Either `ad_ids` or `aco_ad_ids` must be provided. For ACO ads, only `ENABLE` and `DISABLE` are supported, so do not use `DELETE` when this field is set.

ad_ids.description: List of ad IDs to update. Allowed quantity: `1-20`. Either `ad_ids` or `aco_ad_ids` must be provided.

operation_status.description: Operation to perform on the specified ads. Enum values: `DELETE` (delete), `DISABLE` (pause), `ENABLE` (enable). If `aco_ad_ids` is used, only `ENABLE` and `DISABLE` are valid. The status of deleted ads, or ads in deleted campaigns or deleted ad groups, cannot be modified.

creatives.description: Advertising creatives to update. Max size: 20.

ad_format.description: Required only when `patch_update` is not `true`. Ad format. Set `SINGLE_VIDEO` for single video ads, `SINGLE_IMAGE` for single image ads, `CAROUSEL_ADS` for TikTok Standard Carousel ads, `CATALOG_CAROUSEL` for TikTok VSA Carousel ads and Automotive Carousel ads, and `LIVE_CONTENT` for Live Shopping ads. If this field was set to `CAROUSEL_ADS` or `CATALOG_CAROUSEL` at creation time, it cannot be updated.

ad_name.description: Required only when `patch_update` is not `true`. Ad name. Set to an empty string (`""`) to auto-generate the name as the ad ID (`ad_id`). Length limit: 512 characters; emojis are not allowed. Each Chinese or Japanese word counts as two characters; each English letter counts as one.

ad_text.description: Ad text shown as part of the creative. For Spark Ads Push, `ad_text` is required. For non-Spark Ads, either `ad_text` or `ad_texts` must be set. If both `ad_text` and `ad_texts` are specified, `ad_text` is ignored. Length limit: 100 characters; emojis are not allowed. Each Chinese or Japanese word counts as two characters; each English letter counts as one.

ad_texts.description: List of ad texts. For non-Spark Ads, either `ad_text` or `ad_texts` must be set. Valid only for Search Ads Campaigns. If both `ad_text` and `ad_texts` are specified, `ad_text` is ignored. The system automatically selects the most relevant text for the audience. Max size: 5. Each text has a 100-character limit and cannot contain emojis. Each Chinese or Japanese word counts as two characters; each English letter counts as one.

aigc_disclosure_type.description: Valid only when `identity_type=CUSTOMIZED_USER`. Controls the AIGC self-disclosure label for AI-generated content. Default is `NOT_DECLARED`. For Single Video or Carousel Ads, you can update this field only when updating the ad creative itself; for example, reordering carousel images alone does not allow updating this field. For Dynamic Format, Catalog Video, and Catalog Carousel Ads, this field cannot be updated.

app_name.description: App name shown in the ad. If omitted, the app store name is used. Length: 1-40 characters. If the app store name exceeds 40 characters, you must pass a new app name here.

avatar_icon_web_uri.description: Avatar image ID. Upload through the image upload endpoint. Image ratio requirement: 1:1.

brand_safety_postbid_partner.description: Post-bid third-party brand safety measurement partner. Can be updated only before the ad passes review and becomes active. If ad-group-level `brand_safety_type=NO_BRAND_SAFETY`, you may pass `viewability_postbid_partner` but not `brand_safety_postbid_partner`. If ad-group-level `brand_safety_type` is any other value, you may pass both fields. If both `brand_safety_postbid_partner` and `viewability_postbid_partner` are set and either is `IAS`, both must be `IAS`, and `brand_safety_vast_url` and `viewability_vast_url` must be the same IAS wrapped VAST URL. If the two post-bid partners differ, only the brand safety measurement setting takes effect. Allowlist-only. Not supported for ACO ads or ad groups with `promotion_type=LIVE_SHOPPING`.

brand_safety_vast_url.description: Wrapped VAST URL used by the post-bid partner to measure brand safety. Required when `brand_safety_postbid_partner=IAS`. Must be obtained from IAS. Can be updated only before the ad passes review and becomes active. If both `brand_safety_postbid_partner` and `viewability_postbid_partner` are `IAS`, `brand_safety_vast_url` must equal `viewability_vast_url`. Allowlist-only. Not supported for ACO ads or ad groups with `promotion_type=LIVE_SHOPPING`.

call_to_action.description: Call-to-action text. For TikTok ads, specify either `call_to_action` or `call_to_action_id`. If both are specified, `call_to_action` is ignored. In a Live Shopping ad where `creative_type=SHORT_VIDEO_LIVE`, this field is required and must be `WATCH_LIVE`.

call_to_action_id.description: CTA portfolio ID for a group of auto-optimized CTAs. If both `call_to_action_id` and `call_to_action` are specified, `call_to_action` is ignored.

card_id.description: Creative portfolio ID. Can reference portfolios such as call-to-action text, Website Info Card, Display Card, Download Card, Product Card, Product Tiles, Countdown Sticker, Gift Code Sticker, Pop-up Showcase, Gesture, or Superlike. To delete the creative portfolio used in VSA for Catalog, omit this field; the response value becomes null. However, if dynamic format is enabled and `card_id` is omitted in `/ad/update/`, the creative portfolio is not deleted because the product card is auto-generated for dynamic-format ads.

carousel_image_index.description: Valid for VSA Carousel ads when additional product images are configured. Not supported for Automotive Carousel Ads for Inventory or Models. Specifies which `additional_image_urls` position to use for all catalog products in the VSA Carousel ad. If omitted, main product images are used. Range: 0-9. For example, `1` uses the second URL in each product's `additional_image_urls`. If the specified index is unavailable for a product or the image cannot be fetched, that product is not counted. If 2 or more products have usable additional images, only those products are shown with additional images; if fewer than 2 do, all products are shown with main images.

click_tracking_url.description: Click tracking URL from your measurement partner. If the app specified at ad-group level has `partner_id` 44 (TikTok Business SDK) or 49 (TikTok App API), you do not need to pass this field and any value provided is ignored. If self-attribution is enabled for the ad-group-level app and the partner ID is not 44 or 49, this field defaults to the app's configured Click Tracking URL and updates are not supported. Pangle does not support DCM, Sizmek, or Flashtalking.

cpp_url.description: Custom Product Page (CPP) URL for iOS app promotion. Must be consistent with the promoted app (`app_id`). Format: `https://apps.apple.com/{region}/app/{app_name}/id{app_id}?ppid={ppid}`. Length limit: 512 characters. Allowlist-only feature. If you use `page_id` together with `cpp_url` and later update `cpp_url`, the App Profile Page is not updated automatically; you must manually update the App Profile Page to keep it consistent.

creative_authorized.description: Whether to allow some ads to be displayed in TikTok For Business Creative Center. Valid only for non-US advertisers. Default is `false`. Can be used only for video ads.

creative_type.description: Creative type for Live Shopping Ads, Product Shopping Ads, App Pre-Registration, Automotive Ads for Inventory, or Automotive Ads for Models. When ad-group-level `shopping_ads_type=LIVE`, this field is required and must be `SHORT_VIDEO_LIVE` or `DIRECT_LIVE`. When ad-group-level `shopping_ads_type=PRODUCT_SHOPPING_ADS`, you may omit this field or set it to `PSA`. When campaign-level `app_promotion_type=APP_PREREGISTRATION` and ad-group-level `promotion_website_type=TIKTOK_NATIVE_PAGE`, you may omit this field or set it to `CUSTOM_INSTANT_PAGE`. When campaign-level `objective_type=LEAD_GENERATION` and `catalog_enabled=true`, you may omit this field or set it to `AUTO_INVENTORY_INSTANT_PAGE`.

dark_post_status.description: Whether the Spark Ad is a dark post. Values: `ON` or `OFF`. If enabled, the ad does not appear on the creator's homepage. You can set this to `OFF` only when both the identity's "Show through ads only" mode is disabled and the ad account does not enforce mandatory ads-only mode. If the ad account enforces mandatory ads-only mode, you can set this field only to `ON` when creating Spark Ads using Spark Ads Push. Mandatory ads-only mode for an ad account is allowlist-only.

deeplink.description: The in-app destination to open when the audience has the app installed. Used according to `deeplink_type`. Deferred deeplinks are allowlist-only and require technical implementation. Non-deferred deeplinks are allowlist-only in some scenarios.

deeplink_type.description: Deeplink type. Default is `NORMAL`. `DEFERRED_DEEPLINK` is not supported for Dedicated Campaigns; if the campaign's `campaign_type=IOS14_CAMPAIGN`, do not set this field to `DEFERRED_DEEPLINK`. Deferred deeplinks are allowlist-only. Non-deferred deeplinks are allowlist-only in some scenarios.

deeplink_utm_params.description: List of deeplink URL parameters. Supported only when ad group `shopping_ads_type=VIDEO`, `product_source=CATALOG`, and `promotion_type` is `WEBSITE`, `APP_ANDROID`, or `APP_IOS`. Max size: 14. If `shopping_ads_deeplink_type=SHOPPING_ADS`, these parameters are automatically appended to the product deeplink at delivery. If `shopping_ads_deeplink_type=CUSTOM`, you must manually append parameters to `deeplink`; if you also pass `deeplink_utm_params`, they are not auto-appended and must exactly match the parameters already in `deeplink`. This is an allowlist-only feature.

key.description: Deeplink URL parameter key. Can be a custom parameter or supported UTM parameter: `utm_source`, `utm_medium`, `utm_content`, `utm_campaign`. Case-sensitive. Custom key length limit: 100 characters.

value.description: Deeplink URL parameter value. Can be a custom value or one of these macros: `__CAMPAIGN_NAME__`, `__CAMPAIGN_ID__`, `__AID_NAME__`, `__AID__`, `__CID_NAME__`, `__CID__`, `__PLACEMENT__`. Custom value length limit: 600 characters.

disclaimer_clickable_texts.description: Clickable disclaimer entries. Required when `disclaimer_type=TEXT_LINK`. Max size: 3. If you pass multiple clickable disclaimers, both the overall length across all texts and the length of each individual text must be no more than 40 characters.

text.description: Clickable disclaimer text. Length limit: 40 characters.

url.description: URL opened when users tap the disclaimer text.

disclaimer_type.description: Disclaimer type. `TEXT_ONLY` requires `disclaimer_text`. `TEXT_LINK` requires `disclaimer_clickable_texts`. If adding a disclaimer to an ad that currently has none, set this field to the desired type. If the ad already has disclaimers, you may update only the disclaimer text, URL, or both; you cannot change the disclaimer type and must pass the same type. Allowlist-only for some advertisers and objectives. Supported only for objectives `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `REACH`, `TRAFFIC`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, `ENGAGEMENT`, `LEAD_GENERATION`, and `RF_REACH`; supported only on TikTok placement; not supported for ACO ads.

display_name.description: Display name for landing page or pure exposure ads. Required when the promotion type is landing page or pure exposure. Length limit: 1-40 English characters, or 1-20 Chinese/Japanese/Korean characters.

dynamic_destination.description: Dynamic destination strategy. Valid only when ad group `shopping_ads_type=VIDEO`, `product_source=CATALOG`, `promotion_type=WEBSITE`, and `optimization_goal` is `CONVERSION` or `VALUE`. `DLP` enables Dynamic Landing Page behavior; `UNSET` leaves the strategy unset.

dynamic_format.description: Dynamic format. `DYNAMIC_CREATIVE` enables smart creative to show different videos, product cards, and destinations based on purchase intent. If `dynamic_format=DYNAMIC_CREATIVE`, `vertical_video_strategy` must be `UNSET`.

end_card_cta.description: Valid only when campaign-level `objective_type=LEAD_GENERATION` and `catalog_enabled=true`, the ad group specifies an Auto-Inventory or Auto-Model `catalog_id`, and ad-level `ad_format=CATALOG_CAROUSEL`. CTA for the end card image (`image_ids`) in Automotive Carousel Ads.

fallback_type.description: Fallback behavior when the audience does not have the app installed. `APP_INSTALL` sends users to the app store page of the ad-group-level `app_id`; `WEBSITE` requires `landing_page_url`; `UNSET` leaves fallback unset.

identity_authorized_bc_id.description: Required when `identity_type` is `BC_AUTH_TT`. ID of the Business Center associated with the TikTok Account User in Business Center identity.

identity_id.description: Required only when `patch_update` is not `true`. Identity ID. For non-Spark Ads, use together with `identity_type=CUSTOMIZED_USER` for ad identity management.

identity_type.description: Required only when `patch_update` is not `true` and you use Spark Ads. Identity type. `BC_AUTH_TT` requires `identity_authorized_bc_id`. `AUTH_CODE` or `BC_AUTH_TT` with Spark Ads Pull requires `tiktok_item_id`. `TT_USER` or `BC_AUTH_TT` with `ad_format=SINGLE_VIDEO` requires either `video_id` or `tiktok_item_id`. `CUSTOMIZED_USER` is used for non-Spark Ads and is required for some fields such as `aigc_disclosure_type`; `tiktok_item_id` is not supported when `identity_type=CUSTOMIZED_USER`.

image_ids.description: List of image IDs used in the ad or as a video cover. Obtain IDs from `/file/image/ad/search/` or `/file/image/ad/upload/`. When `ad_format=SINGLE_VIDEO`, this field is required for video Spark Ads via Spark Ads Push and for video Non-Spark Ads; only one image is allowed and it is used as the video cover with the same aspect ratio as the video. For video Spark Ads via Spark Ads Pull, this field is not supported and you must pass `tiktok_item_id` instead. When `ad_format=CAROUSEL_ADS`, this field is required for Standard Carousel Spark Ads via Spark Ads Push and for Standard Carousel Non-Spark Ads; size must be 1 to 35 and the order controls carousel display order. For Standard Carousel Spark Ads via Spark Ads Pull, this field is not supported and you must pass `tiktok_item_id` instead. When `ad_format=CATALOG_CAROUSEL` and campaign-level `catalog_enabled=true`, this field is required and only one image is allowed as the summary photo for Automotive ads. When `ad_format=SINGLE_IMAGE`, this field is required and exactly one image ID is allowed. If you change image IDs for a TikTok Carousel Ad, the ad enters review again.

impression_tracking_url.description: Default impression tracking URL from your measurement partner. If the app specified at ad-group level has `partner_id` 44 (TikTok Business SDK) or 49 (TikTok App API), you do not need to pass this field and any value provided is ignored. If self-attribution is enabled for the ad-group-level app and the partner ID is not 44 or 49, this field defaults to the app's configured Default Impression Tracking URL and updates are not supported.

instant_product_page_used.description: Whether to use TikTok Instant Product Page. When `dynamic_destination=DLP`, you do not need this field. When `dynamic_destination=UNSET`, you can set this field to `true`, and then `page_id` is not required.

item_duet_status.description: Whether to enable dueting for the Spark Ad post. Valid only for Spark Ad posts and only when `promotional_music_disabled=false`.

item_group_ids.description: Used when `product_specific_type=PRODUCT_SET`; pass either `item_group_ids` or `product_set_id`. Product SPU IDs. All products must belong to the same ad-group-level catalog (`catalog_id`). Max size: 20.

item_stitch_status.description: Whether to enable stitching for the Spark Ad post. Valid only for Spark Ad posts and only when `promotional_music_disabled=false`.

landing_page_url.description: Landing page URL. May already include URL parameters. If used with `utm_params` in scenarios where parameters are not auto-appended, `utm_params` must exactly match the parameters already present in the URL. Example: `https://www.example.com?utm_source=TikTok&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=Campaign1&utm_content=Content1`.

music_id.description: Music ID for TikTok Carousel ads. Valid when `ad_format=CAROUSEL_ADS` and you create Standard Carousel Spark Ads via Spark Ads Push or Standard Carousel Non-Spark Ads, or when `ad_format=CATALOG_CAROUSEL`. If you change the music ID on an existing TikTok Carousel Ad, the ad enters review again.

page_id.description: Page ID. Use `/page/get/` to retrieve pages in the ad account. Instant forms are for `LEAD_GENERATION` campaigns and apply only to TikTok placement. Before first use, confirm the `LeadAds` agreement through `/term/confirm/`.

page_image_index.description: Valid only when `instant_product_page_used=true` and additional product images are configured. Selects which `additional_image_urls` position to use on the TikTok Instant Product Page. If omitted, main product images are used. Range: 0-9. For example, `1` uses the second image URL in each product's `additional_image_urls`. If the index exceeds the available additional image URLs for a product, the field is ignored for that product and the main `image_url` is used.

playable_url.description: Playable material URL. Valid on Pangle and TikTok placement. All ads in the same ad group share the same playable material. Starting September 30, 2024, you can no longer update Playable Ads delivered to TikTok placement.

product_set_id.description: Used when `product_specific_type=PRODUCT_SET`; pass either `product_set_id` or `item_group_ids`. Product set ID. The product set must contain products from the same ad-group-level catalog (`catalog_id`).

product_specific_type.description: Valid only when `shopping_ads_type=VIDEO` and `product_source=CATALOG`. Controls how products are selected for a Video Shopping Ad with catalog product source. `ALL` means TikTok dynamically chooses from all products and you should not pass `sku_ids`, `item_group_ids`, or `product_set_id`. `PRODUCT_SET` requires either `item_group_ids` or `product_set_id`. `CUSTOMIZED_PRODUCTS` requires `sku_ids`.

promotional_music_disabled.description: Whether to disable promotional use of music in the Spark Ad post. Default is `true`. Set to `false` to allow dueting and stitching. Valid only for Spark Ad posts.

shopping_ads_deeplink_type.description: Source of the deeplink used in Shopping Ads. `CUSTOM` requires `deeplink`. `SHOPPING_ADS` uses the product deeplink from the catalog. `SHOPPING_ADS` is not supported when ad group `shopping_ads_type=VIDEO` and `product_source=CATALOG`, and ad-level `ad_format=SINGLE_VIDEO` with `vertical_video_strategy=SINGLE_VIDEO`, or `ad_format=CATALOG_CAROUSEL`. Deferred deeplinks are allowlist-only. Non-deferred deeplinks are allowlist-only in some scenarios.

shopping_ads_fallback_type.description: Fallback website type in Shopping Ads retargeting when the deeplink cannot be triggered. `CUSTOM` requires `landing_page_url`. `SHOPPING_ADS` uses the product web link from the catalog. `SHOPPING_ADS` is not supported when ad group `shopping_ads_type=VIDEO` and `product_source=CATALOG`, and ad-level `ad_format=SINGLE_VIDEO` with `vertical_video_strategy=SINGLE_VIDEO`, or `ad_format=CATALOG_CAROUSEL`.

shopping_ads_video_package_id.description: Product video package ID. Use `/catalog/video/get/` to obtain valid video package IDs.

sku_ids.description: Required when `product_specific_type=CUSTOMIZED_PRODUCTS`. SKU IDs for products in the same ad-group-level catalog (`catalog_id`). Use to update specific products in a Video Shopping Ad with catalog product source. Max size: 20. Cannot be updated to an empty list or null. Only products whose `/catalog/product/get/` response has `ad_creation_eligible=AVAILABLE` are supported. If `ad_format=CATALOG_CAROUSEL`, specify at least 2 products.

tiktok_item_id.description: TikTok post ID to use as the Spark Ad. Required when `identity_type` is `AUTH_CODE` or `BC_AUTH_TT` and you create Spark Ads through Spark Ads Pull. Not supported when `identity_type=CUSTOMIZED_USER`. Pass the `tiktok_item_id` returned by `/tt_video/info/`. By using Spark Ads, you confirm you have the rights to use the music in the videos for commercial purposes.

tracking_app_id.description: Application ID used to track offsite app events. Supported for Auction objectives `REACH`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, `TRAFFIC`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `LEAD_GENERATION`, `APP_PROMOTION`, `PRODUCT_SALES`, `ENGAGEMENT` and Reach & Frequency objective `RF_REACH`. If ad-group-level `app_id` is set and you want to track offsite app events, `tracking_app_id` must match that ad-group-level `app_id`; otherwise you may pass any application ID to track.

tracking_offline_event_set_ids.description: Offline Event Set IDs to track and measure offline activity from people who see or interact with the ad. Max size: 50. If omitted, this field defaults to all existing auto-tracking Offline Event Set IDs under the advertiser account. If you pass this field manually, you must include at least all current auto-tracking Offline Event Set IDs; non-auto-tracking sets are optional. An Offline Event Set that was changed from auto-tracking to non-auto-tracking, or deleted, is no longer considered a current auto-tracking set. Supported for campaign objectives `REACH`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, `TRAFFIC`, `LEAD_GENERATION`, `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `ENGAGEMENT`, and `PRODUCT_SALES`. If `objective_type=PRODUCT_SALES`, this field can be used only when ad group `shopping_ads_type=VIDEO` and `product_source=CATALOG`.

tracking_pixel_id.description: Pixel ID used to track offsite events. Supported for Auction objectives `REACH`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, `TRAFFIC`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `LEAD_GENERATION`, `APP_PROMOTION`, `PRODUCT_SALES`, `ENGAGEMENT` and Reach & Frequency objective `RF_REACH`. For Auction objectives, if ad-group-level `pixel_id` is not 0 and you want to use pixel tracking, `tracking_pixel_id` must equal that ad-group-level `pixel_id`; otherwise you may pass any pixel ID to track. For Reach & Frequency, you may pass any pixel ID to track.

utm_params.description: List of URL parameters as key/value pairs. Max size: 14. Supported in these scenarios: (1) VSA for Catalog with campaign `objective_type=PRODUCT_SALES`, ad group `shopping_ads_type=VIDEO`, `product_source=CATALOG`, and `promotion_type` in `WEBSITE`, `APP_ANDROID`, `APP_IOS`; (2) Automotive scenarios with campaign `objective_type=LEAD_GENERATION` and `catalog_enabled=true`, and ad group `promotion_target_type=EXTERNAL_WEBSITE`; (3) other scenarios where campaign `objective_type` is `REACH`, `TRAFFIC`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, `LEAD_GENERATION` with `catalog_enabled=false`, `ENGAGEMENT`, `APP_PROMOTION` with `app_promotion_type=APP_PREREGISTRATION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, or `RF_REACH`. In VSA for Catalog, if `shopping_ads_fallback_type=SHOPPING_ADS`, parameters are automatically appended to the product link at delivery. If `shopping_ads_fallback_type=CUSTOM`, you must manually append parameters to `landing_page_url`; if you also pass `utm_params`, they are not auto-appended and must exactly match the parameters already in `landing_page_url` or an error occurs. In Automotive scenarios, parameters are automatically appended to the catalog product `landing_page_url`. In other scenarios, if `landing_page_url` already contains URL parameters, you may pass `utm_params` to store them, but they are not auto-appended and must exactly match the URL.

key.description: URL parameter key. Can be a custom parameter or one of the supported UTM parameters: `utm_source`, `utm_medium`, `utm_content`, `utm_campaign`. UTM parameters are case-sensitive. Custom key length limit: 100 characters.

value.description: URL parameter value. Can be a custom value or one of these macros: `__CAMPAIGN_NAME__`, `__CAMPAIGN_ID__`, `__AID_NAME__`, `__AID__`, `__CID_NAME__`, `__CID__`, `__PLACEMENT__`. Custom value length limit: 600 characters.

vast_moat_enabled.description: Whether Moat Viewability Verification is enabled. Default is `false`. TikTok recommends setting `viewability_postbid_partner=MOAT` instead of using this field directly.

vertical_video_strategy.description: Video type used for Product Sales scenarios. Must be `UNSET` if `dynamic_format=DYNAMIC_CREATIVE`. If this field was set during ad creation, you must keep passing the same value; it cannot be changed later.

video_id.description: Video ID. Required when `ad_format=SINGLE_VIDEO` and `identity_type=CUSTOMIZED_USER`. When `ad_format=SINGLE_VIDEO` and `identity_type` is `TT_USER` or `BC_AUTH_TT`, pass either `video_id` or `tiktok_item_id`. Not supported when `ad_format` is `SINGLE_IMAGE` or `CAROUSEL_ADS`. For Spark Ads, you can use either `video_id` or `tiktok_item_id`. TikTok recommends using `/file/video/ad/upload/` with `upload_type=UPLOAD_BY_VIDEO_ID` to bind the video to the advertiser ID.

viewability_postbid_partner.description: Post-bid third-party viewability measurement partner. Can be updated only before the ad passes review and becomes active. If both `brand_safety_postbid_partner` and `viewability_postbid_partner` are set and either is `IAS`, both must be `IAS`, and `brand_safety_vast_url` and `viewability_vast_url` must be the same IAS wrapped VAST URL. If the two post-bid partners differ, only the brand safety measurement setting takes effect. Allowlist-only. Not supported for ACO ads or ad groups with `promotion_type=LIVE_SHOPPING`.

viewability_vast_url.description: Wrapped VAST URL used by the post-bid partner to measure viewability. Required when `viewability_postbid_partner=IAS`. Must be obtained from IAS. Can be updated only before the ad passes review and becomes active. If both `brand_safety_postbid_partner` and `viewability_postbid_partner` are `IAS`, `brand_safety_vast_url` must equal `viewability_vast_url`. Allowlist-only. Not supported for ACO ads or ad groups with `promotion_type=LIVE_SHOPPING`.

patch_update.description: Whether to use incremental update mode. Supported only for `ad_name`, `identity_id`, `identity_type`, `identity_authorized_bc_id`, `video_id`, `image_ids`, `music_id`, `tiktok_item_id`, `ad_text`, and `ad_texts`. For example, to update only the ad name, set `patch_update=true`, pass the new `ad_name`, and include required fields such as the headers, `advertiser_id`, and `ad_id`. For all other fields, this endpoint uses full update mode; sending partial data can overwrite unspecified fields to null. TikTok recommends thorough testing before enabling incremental mode.

actions.description: List of behavioral targeting category objects.

action_category_ids.description: Valid only when TikTok placement is the only placement selected. IDs of video interaction categories, creator interaction categories, hashtags, or hashtag bundles to target.

action_period.description: Time period (in days) to include behaviors from. Allowed values: `0`, `7`, `15`. When `action_scene` is `CREATOR_RELATED` or `HASHTAG_RELATED`, `0` is used regardless of the value passed. `0` means no fixed timeframe. When creating with `action_scene=VIDEO_RELATED` via TikTok Ads Manager, `15` is used by default; via API, `0`, `7`, or `15` can still be passed.

action_scene.description: Type of user behavior to target. `VIDEO_RELATED` = video interactions. `CREATOR_RELATED` = creator interactions. `HASHTAG_RELATED` = hashtag interactions.

video_user_actions.description: Specific user interactions to target for the chosen `action_scene`. When `action_scene=VIDEO_RELATED`: `WATCHED_TO_END`, `LIKED`, `COMMENTED`, `SHARED`. When `action_scene=CREATOR_RELATED`: `FOLLOWING`, `VIEW_HOMEPAGE`. When `action_scene=HASHTAG_RELATED`: `VIEW_HASHTAG`. Via TikTok Ads Manager you cannot define this field; defaults are all four for `VIDEO_RELATED` and both for `CREATOR_RELATED`. Via API you can pass any allowed combination.

adgroup_app_profile_page_state.description: Whether to use App Profile Page. `ON` or `OFF`. App Profile Page is not supported in a Dedicated Campaign with optimization goal as in-app event and bid strategy as cost cap. Therefore, you cannot set `ON` when all of the following are true: `ios14_targeting=IOS14_PLUS`, `optimization_goal=IN_APP_EVENT`, and `bid_type=BID_TYPE_CUSTOM`.

adgroup_name.description: Ad group name. Maximum 512 characters; emoji is not allowed.

age_groups.description: Age groups to target. In certain scenarios, ad groups targeting `AGE_13_17` in the US, Latin America, the European Economic Area, the UK, Switzerland, or Canada are not allowed (see New age restrictions for ads on TikTok). If you use targeting options that do not support `AGE_13_17` in those regions and you leave `age_groups` unspecified or as `[]`, the field defaults to `["AGE_18_24", "AGE_25_34", "AGE_35_44", "AGE_45_54", "AGE_55_100"]`. If your ad group targets `AGE_13_17` in those regions, explicitly specify the exact age groups you want to target.

app_config.description: Required when `sales_destination=WEB_AND_APP` at the campaign level. Details of the app(s) to promote. Maximum size: 2. You can specify an Android app, an iOS app, or both.

app_id.description: Required when `app_config` is specified. App ID of the app to promote.

App ID of the app to promote. Required when `objective_type=APP_PROMOTION` and `app_promotion_type=APP_RETARGETING`, or when `objective_type=APP_PROMOTION` with `app_promotion_type=APP_INSTALL` or `APP_PREREGISTRATION` and the campaign is not an iOS14 Dedicated Campaign. You cannot use an app that has not activated the SAN module on your MMP.

attribution_event_count.description: Event count (Statistic type) for the ad group, controlling how actions are counted after viewing or clicking. `UNSET` = unset. `EVERY` = count multiple events as separate conversions. `ONCE` = count multiple events as 1 conversion. Allowed values vary by advertising objective. If you omit all four attribution fields, default settings (if any) are used; check via `/adgroup/get/`. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

audience_ids.description: List of custom audience IDs to include.

audience_rule.description: Rules that specify your audience. Valid only when `objective_type` is `TRAFFIC` or `APP_PROMOTION`. For details, see Audience Rules.

audience_type.description: Required and valid only when the campaign-level `app_promotion_type=APP_RETARGETING`. Not supported otherwise. App retargeting audience type. `NEW_CUSTOM_AUDIENCE` = retargeting custom audience. To use an empty retargeting custom audience, omit `audience_ids` and `excluded_audience_ids`. To use a non-empty audience, specify `audience_ids` (Include), `excluded_audience_ids` (Exclude), or both — they cannot share the same IDs.

automated_keywords_enabled.description: Valid only when at the campaign level `is_search_campaign=true`. Whether to enable automated keywords (system-generated keywords after ads are added). Default: `false`. Automated keywords in Search Ads Campaigns are allowlist-only.

bid_display_mode.description: Required and must be `CPV` (Cost per One View) when `objective_type=VIDEO_VIEW`. How Cost per View is calculated and measured. Cannot be updated after creation. Not needed when `objective_type` is not `VIDEO_VIEW`. The enum value `CPMV` is deprecated in v1.3.

bid_price.description: Required when `bid_type=BID_TYPE_CUSTOM` and `billing_event` is `CPC`, `CPM`, or `CPV`. Bid price (the average cost per result, used for the Cost Cap bidding strategy). When CBO is enabled at the campaign level, set the same bid value across all ad groups. Must be lower than the campaign-level and ad-group-level budget. See Bidding-Bidding limits for the verification mechanism.

bid_type.description: Bidding strategy that determines how the system manages cost per result, spend, and delivery. Required when Campaign Budget Optimization (CBO) is enabled at the campaign level (`budget_optimize_on=true`). For enum values, see the TikTok Marketing API Bidding Strategy enumeration. For new ad groups under one CBO campaign, this field should match the first ad group.

billing_event.description: Events you want to pay for. For enum values, see the TikTok Marketing API Billing Event enumeration; for the billing event associated with each optimization goal, see Corresponding billing event for an optimization goal.

blocked_pangle_app_ids.description: Pangle app block list IDs. You can obtain an ID from the `app_package_id` field returned by Get Pangle block list. Takes effect only when Pangle placement is selected.

brand_safety_partner.description: Required only when `brand_safety_type=THIRD_PARTY` and `placements=["PLACEMENT_TIKTOK"]`. Brand safety partner. `IAS` = IAS. `OPEN_SLATE` = the partner is named DoubleVerify on TikTok Ads Manager because it has been acquired by DoubleVerify. Pre-bid third-party brand safety solutions are allowlist-only. Once set, this field cannot be modified.

brand_safety_type.description: Brand safety type. Default value: NO_BRAND_SAFETY. Enum values: NO_BRAND_SAFETY (to be deprecated in the next API version): To not use any brand safety solution. Full inventory, which means your ads may appear next to some content featuring mature themes. EXPANDED_INVENTORY: Use TikTok's brand safety solution. Expanded inventory means that your ads will appear next to content where most inappropriate content has been removed, and that does not contain mature themes. In the next API version, EXPANDED_INVENTORY will replace NO_BRAND_SAFETY and will be the default brand safety option. STANDARD_INVENTORY: Use TikTok's brand safety solution. Standard inventory means that ads will appear next to content that is appropriate for most brands. LIMITED_INVENTORY: Use TikTok's brand safety solution. Limited inventory means that your ads will not appear next to content that contains mature themes. THIRD_PARTY: Use a third-party brand safety solution. You also need to pass a value to the brand_safety_partner field.

budget.description: Ad group budget. Ignored when Campaign Budget Optimization is enabled (`budget_optimize_on=true` at the campaign level). For daily budget value ranges by currency, see Currency-Daily budget value range.

budget_mode.description: Ad group budget mode. When Campaign Budget Optimization (CBO) is enabled at the campaign level, ad-group `budget_mode` is ignored. When CBO is disabled: `BUDGET_MODE_TOTAL` = lifetime budget; `BUDGET_MODE_DYNAMIC_DAILY_BUDGET` = average daily budget over a week (daily costs do not exceed 125% of the average; weekly costs do not exceed average × 7); `BUDGET_MODE_DAY` = daily budget. When `objective_type` is `TRAFFIC`, `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `LEAD_GENERATION`, `PRODUCT_SALES` (Video Shopping Ads only), `REACH`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, or `ENGAGEMENT`, and you want a non-lifetime budget, use `BUDGET_MODE_DYNAMIC_DAILY_BUDGET`. `BUDGET_MODE_DYNAMIC_DAILY_BUDGET` for `REACH`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, and `ENGAGEMENT` is allowlist-only. For `REACH`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, and `ENGAGEMENT`, prefer `BUDGET_MODE_DYNAMIC_DAILY_BUDGET` over `BUDGET_MODE_DAY`. If `BUDGET_MODE_DAY`, then `schedule_type` can be `SCHEDULE_START_END` or `SCHEDULE_FROM_NOW`. If `BUDGET_MODE_TOTAL`, then `schedule_type` must be `SCHEDULE_START_END` (which requires `schedule_end_time`).

campaign_id.description: ID of the campaign that this ad group belongs to.

carrier_ids.description: Carriers to target. Carriers must be consistent with the targeted location(s). Only carriers with `in_use=true` are valid.

catalog_authorized_bc_id.description: Required when `shopping_ads_type=VIDEO` and `product_source` is `CATALOG` or `STORE`. Optional when `shopping_ads_type=LIVE`. Not supported when `shopping_ads_type=PRODUCT_SHOPPING_ADS` and `product_source=STORE`. Business Center ID that has permission for the catalog. For catalogs in Business Center, pass the Business Center ID that owns the catalog. Starting June 30th, 2024, when `product_source=STORE`, this field is ignored.

catalog_id.description: Required when `product_source` is `CATALOG` or `STORE`. When `shopping_ads_type=LIVE`, `catalog_id`, `catalog_authorized_bc_id`, `store_id`, and `store_authorized_bc_id` are optional: if you provide a TikTok Shop through these parameters, sales of products in that shop are reported; otherwise sales of products showcased in `identity_id` are reported. When `product_source=CATALOG`, set this to the catalog you want to promote products from. When `product_source=STORE`, set this to the catalog bound to the promoted TikTok Shop. Starting June 30th, 2024, when `product_source=STORE`, `catalog_id` is ignored.

category_exclusion_ids.description: Valid only when at the campaign level `objective_type` is `REACH`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, `ENGAGEMENT`, `RF_REACH`, `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `TRAFFIC`, or `LEAD_GENERATION`, and at the ad group level `placements=["PLACEMENT_TIKTOK"]` and `brand_safety_type` is `STANDARD_INVENTORY` or `LIMITED_INVENTORY`. Content exclusion category IDs.

click_attribution_window.description: Click-through attribution window for the ad group. `OFF`, `ONE_DAY` = 1-day click, `SEVEN_DAYS` = 7-day click, `FOURTEEN_DAYS` = 14-day click, `TWENTY_EIGHT_DAYS` = 28-day click. Allowed values vary by advertising objective. To manually configure attribution windows, you must pass at least `click_attribution_window` and `view_attribution_window` simultaneously, and `engaged_view_attribution_window` is optional but, if passed, must be accompanied by both. If you omit `click_attribution_window`, `engaged_view_attribution_window`, `view_attribution_window`, and `attribution_event_count`, default settings (if any) are used; check via `/adgroup/get/`. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

comment_disabled.description: Whether to disable comments on ads on TikTok.

contextual_tag_ids.description: Contextual tag IDs. Allowlist-only. Only supports campaign-level `objective_type` of `REACH` and `VIDEO_VIEWS`. Not supported when `brand_safety_type=THIRD_PARTY`.

conversion_bid_price.description: Required when `bid_type=BID_TYPE_CUSTOM` and `billing_event=OCPM`. Target cost per conversion for oCPM (Optimized Cost per Mille). Must be lower than the campaign-level and ad-group-level budget. See Bidding-Bidding limits for the verification mechanism.

creative_material_mode.description: Creative delivery strategy. `CUSTOM` = custom (default). Automated ads (`creative_material_mode=DYNAMIC`) are deprecated; use Smart Creative ads (`creative_material_mode=CUSTOM`).

custom_conversion_id.description: ID of the Custom Conversion to use. Valid only when all of the following are met: either `pixel_id` or `app_id` is specified; a Custom Conversion has been configured for that `pixel_id`/`app_id`; `optimization_goal` is `CONVERT` or `IN_APP_EVENT`; `optimization_event` is specified and matches the Standard Event associated with the Custom Conversion; and the Custom Conversion's `activity_status` is `ACTIVE` or `NO_RECENT_ACTIVITY`.

dayparting.description: Ad delivery arrangement, a 48 × 7 = 336-character string of `0` and `1`. Each character maps to a 30-minute slot from Monday through Sunday: the first character is 0:01-0:30 Monday, the second is 0:31-1:00 Monday, the last is 23:31-0:00 Sunday. `1` = deliver in that slot; `0` = do not deliver. If unspecified, all-`0`, or all-`1`, full-time delivery is used.

deep_bid_type.description: Bidding strategy for in-app events. Required when CBO is enabled (`budget_optimize_on=true`) and `optimization_goal=VALUE`. `VO_MIN_ROAS` and `VO_HIGHEST_VALUE` are allowlisted. For full details, see the TikTok Marketing API Deep Event Bidding Strategy enumeration. When `secondary_optimization_event` is specified, you must also pass `deep_bid_type`.

deep_funnel_event_source.description: Required when `deep_funnel_optimization_status=ON`. Event source type. `PIXEL` = Pixel. `OFFLINE` = Offline Event Set. `CRM` = CRM Event Set.

deep_funnel_event_source_id.description: Required when `deep_funnel_optimization_status=ON`. Event Source ID. When `deep_funnel_event_source=PIXEL`, pass a Pixel ID. When `deep_funnel_event_source=OFFLINE`, pass an Offline Event Set ID. When `deep_funnel_event_source=CRM`, pass a CRM Event Set ID.

deep_funnel_optimization_event.description: Required when `deep_funnel_optimization_status=ON`. Deep funnel optimization event. For supported Standard Events available for Pixels, Offline Event Sets, and CRM Event Sets, see the "Event name for ad creation" column in Supported Pixel events. Example: `SHOPPING`.

deep_funnel_optimization_status.description: Valid only when `promotion_type=LEAD_GENERATION`. Status of deep funnel optimization, which optimizes upper-funnel events alongside a deeper-funnel secondary event to improve campaign effectiveness. Default: `OFF`. Deep funnel optimization with CRM events is allowlist-only; with Pixel or Offline events it is generally available.

device_model_ids.description: IDs of device models to target. Only active devices (`is_active=true` in the response of `/tool/device_model/`) can be used. `device_model_ids` and `device_price_ranges` cannot be set at the same time.

device_price_ranges.description: Targeting device price range. 10000 means 1000+. Numbers must be multiples of 50. The upper limit you set is increased by 50 to form the actual upper limit (for example, [0, 250] actually means [0, 300] in TikTok Ads Manager).

engaged_view_attribution_window.description: Engaged view-through attribution window (after at least 6 seconds of video). `ONE_DAY` = 1-day engaged view. `SEVEN_DAYS` = 7-day engaged view. Allowed values vary by advertising objective. If passed, must be accompanied by `click_attribution_window` and `view_attribution_window`. If you omit all four attribution fields, default settings (if any) are used; check via `/adgroup/get/`. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

excluded_audience_ids.description: List of custom audience IDs to exclude.

excluded_custom_actions.description: When `shopping_ads_retargeting_type=LAB3`, you must pass either `included_custom_actions` or `excluded_custom_actions`. Custom actions to use as Exclude conditions for the retargeted audience.

code.description: Custom action used as an Exclude condition. `VIEW_PRODUCT` = viewed the product. `ADD_TO_CART` = added the product to cart. `PURCHASE` = purchased the product.

days.description: Time range used to filter audiences that did not complete the specified action. Value range: [1, 180].

excluded_pangle_audience_package_ids.description: Valid only for Pangle placement. Do not specify alongside `included_pangle_audience_package_ids`. IDs of Pangle audiences to exclude; the package's `bind_type` must be `EXCLUDE`.

frequency.description: Together with `frequency_schedule`, controls how often people see your ad (only available for `REACH` ads). Both conditions must hold: `1 <= frequency <= 1000` and `1 <= frequency_schedule <= 30`. For example, `frequency=2` and `frequency_schedule=3` means "show ads no more than twice every 3 days".

frequency_schedule.description: Together with `frequency`, controls how often people see your ad (only available for `REACH` ads). See `frequency` for the valid combinations.

household_income.description: Household income to target. `TOP5` = top 5% of ZIP codes. `TOP10` = top 10% of ZIP codes. `TOP10_25` = top 10%-25% of ZIP codes. `TOP25_50` = top 25%-50% of ZIP codes. Supported only for Auction ad objectives, on TikTok placement, in the US.

identity_authorized_bc_id.description: Required when `identity_type=BC_AUTH_TT`. Business Center ID associated with the TikTok Account User identity.

identity_id.description: Required only when (`shopping_ads_type=VIDEO` and `product_source=SHOWCASE`) or `shopping_ads_type=LIVE`. Identity ID.

identity_type.description: Required only when (`shopping_ads_type=VIDEO` and `product_source=SHOWCASE`) or `shopping_ads_type=LIVE`. Identity type. `AUTH_CODE` = Authorized Post User. `TT_USER` = TikTok Business Account User. `BC_AUTH_TT` = TikTok account that a Business Center is authorized to access; when used, you must also pass `identity_authorized_bc_id`.

included_custom_actions.description: When `shopping_ads_retargeting_type=LAB3`, you must pass either `included_custom_actions` or `excluded_custom_actions`. Custom actions to use as Include conditions for the retargeted audience.

code.description: Custom action used as an Include condition. `VIEW_PRODUCT` = viewed the product. `ADD_TO_CART` = added the product to cart. `PURCHASE` = purchased the product.

days.description: Time range used to filter audiences that completed the specified action. Value range: [1, 180].

included_pangle_audience_package_ids.description: Valid only for Pangle placement. Do not specify alongside `excluded_pangle_audience_package_ids`. IDs of Pangle audiences to include; the package's `bind_type` must be `INCLUDE`.

interest_category_ids.description: IDs of general interest categories to target.

interest_keyword_ids.description: IDs of additional interest categories to target.

ios14_targeting.description: Required and must be `IOS14_PLUS` when the campaign-level `campaign_type=IOS14_CAMPAIGN`. iOS devices to target. `UNSET` = devices with iOS 14.4 or earlier (default for most scenarios). `IOS14_MINUS` = devices earlier than iOS 14.0 (not affected by the iOS 14 privacy update). `IOS14_PLUS` = devices with iOS 14.5 or later, used only for Dedicated Campaigns; each iOS 14 campaign can have up to 2 active ad groups. `ALL` = devices with iOS 14.5 or later, used only for iOS App Retargeting ads and iOS retargeting Video Shopping Ads with `product_source=CATALOG` and optimization location App. To target iOS 14.5+ in App Retargeting ads, set this to `ALL` and set `min_ios_version` to `14.5` or later. For iOS App Retargeting ads (`app_promotion_type=APP_RETARGETING` and `promotion_type=APP_IOS`) and for iOS retargeting Video Shopping Ads (`shopping_ads_type=VIDEO`, `product_source=CATALOG`, `promotion_type=APP_IOS`, and `shopping_ads_retargeting_type` is not `OFF`), `ALL` is used regardless of the value you pass. Once set to `IOS14_PLUS`, this field cannot be updated, and the following must hold: at the ad group level, `app_id` is an iOS App ID (the app's `platform=IOS`), `operating_systems=["IOS"]`, `min_ios_version` is passed and consistent with `ios14_targeting`, `optimization_goal` is `CLICK`, `INSTALL`, `IN_APP_EVENT`, or `VALUE`, and `min_android_version`, `shopping_ads_retargeting_type`, and `shopping_ads_retargeting_actions_days` are not specified; at the ad level, `deeplink_type` is not `DEFERRED_DEEPLINK`.

is_hfss.description: Whether the promoted content is HFSS (High Fat, Salt, Sugar). Set to `true` if your ad promotes or prominently features an HFSS product or brand. In regulated regions, HFSS ads must only target users 18 or older. You can set `true` only when targeted locations include locations in the UK, Australia, New Zealand, or the European Union. Default: `false`.

is_lhf_compliance.description: Whether the promoted content complies with LHF (Less Healthy Foods) regulations. Setting `true` certifies compliance with the 2024 UK LHF Regulations and other applicable laws for food/drink products advertised in the UK. Default: `false`. Starting January 1st, 2026, when targeting UK locations and `is_hfss=true`, this field is required and must be `true`.

isp_ids.description: Valid only when a country- or region-level location is specified via `location_ids`. IDs of Internet service providers to target. When `isp_ids` is passed, you cannot set the placement to Global App Bundle only (`placements=PLACEMENT_GLOBAL_APP_BUNDLE`).

languages.description: Codes of the languages to target. To target all languages, omit the field or pass an empty array.

location_ids.description: You must set `location_ids` or `zipcode_ids` or both. Location IDs to target. Maximum 3,000 (the combined total of `location_ids` and `zipcode_ids` cannot exceed 3,000 per ad group). Overlapping locations are not supported (for example, you cannot target the U.S. and California at the same time).
