If you target US locations on creation, you can later switch to other US locations but you cannot remove all US locations to target only non-US countries.

message_event_set_id.description: Required when all of the following are true: `promotion_type=LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_SOCIAL_MEDIA_APP_MESSAGE`, `optimization_goal=CONVERSATION`, and the instant messaging account in your ad group settings does not match an existing message event set. ID of the message event set used in the Instant Messaging Ad Group. If the chosen IM account does match an existing event set (Messenger via `messaging_app_account_id`, or WhatsApp populated from `phone_region_code`/`phone_region_calling_code`/`phone_number`), this field is ignored and auto-populated. Use `/ctm/message_event_set/get/` and check `matched_event_set` to determine if a unique set already exists; if not, the same call's `message_event_set_list` provides the available sets for ad creation. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

messaging_app_account_id.description: Required when `messaging_app_type` is `MESSENGER` or `LINE`. Ignored when `messaging_app_type` is `WHATSAPP`, `ZALO`, or `IM_URL`. ID of the instant messaging app account. When `messaging_app_type=MESSENGER`, pass the Facebook Page ID. When `messaging_app_type=LINE`, pass the LINE Business ID. When `messaging_app_type=WHATSAPP`, this field is ignored and is set automatically from `phone_region_code`, `phone_region_calling_code`, and `phone_number`. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

messaging_app_type.description: Valid only when `promotion_type=LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_SOCIAL_MEDIA_APP_MESSAGE`. Required when `optimization_goal=CONVERSATION`; when `optimization_goal=CLICK`, the default is `IM_URL`. Type of instant messaging app or customized URL. `MESSENGER` requires you to also pass a Facebook Page ID via `messaging_app_account_id`. `WHATSAPP` requires you to also pass `phone_region_code`, `phone_region_calling_code`, and `phone_number` (used to populate the WhatsApp number). `ZALO` requires you to also pass `phone_region_code`, `phone_region_calling_code`, and `phone_number` (used to populate the Zalo number). `LINE` requires you to also pass a LINE Business ID via `messaging_app_account_id`. `IM_URL` is for an Instant Messaging URL. When `optimization_goal=CONVERSATION`, you cannot set this field to `ZALO`, `LINE`, or `IM_URL`. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

min_android_version.description: Minimum device Android version. For enum values, see the TikTok Marketing API Minimum Android Version enumeration.

min_ios_version.description: Required when `ios14_targeting` is specified. Minimum iOS version. For enum values, see the TikTok Marketing API Minimum iOS Version enumeration.

network_types.description: Device connection types to target. For enum values, see the TikTok Marketing API Connection Type enumeration.

next_day_retention.description: Valid only when `placements` is `PLACEMENT_PANGLE` and `secondary_optimization_event=NEXT_DAY_OPEN`. Day 2 retention ratio. Formula: `next_day_retention = conversion_bid_price / deep_cpa_bid`. Value range: (0, 1]. To use this field, pass `conversion_bid_price`, `deep_cpa_bid`, and `next_day_retention` together such that they satisfy the formula; otherwise unexpected errors may occur.

operating_systems.description: Device operating systems to target. Only one value is allowed. Required when `objective_type=APP_PROMOTION`, or when `objective_type=TRAFFIC` and `promotion_type` is `APP_IOS` or `APP_ANDROID`.

operation_status.description: Status of the ad group when created. `ENABLE` = enabled at creation. `DISABLE` = disabled at creation. Default: `ENABLE`. To update status after creation, use `/adgroup/status/update/`.

optimization_event.description: Required when `pixel_id` is specified, or when `pixel_id` is not specified and `optimization_goal` is `IN_APP_EVENT` or `VALUE`. Conversion event. For new ad groups created under one CBO campaign, this field should match the first ad group. When `optimization_goal=PAGE_VISIT`, `optimization_event` is automatically set to `PAGE_VISIT`.

optimization_goal.description: The measurable result to drive with your ads. For the full enum list, see the TikTok Marketing API Optimization Goal enumeration; for CBO support, see Campaign Budget Optimization-Supported optimization goals. For each optimization goal, you must specify a corresponding `billing_event`. To use "Install with in-app event" on Pangle and/or Global App Bundle placements, set `optimization_goal=INSTALL`, specify a valid `secondary_optimization_event`, and only include `PLACEMENT_PANGLE` or `PLACEMENT_GLOBAL_APP_BUNDLE` (or both) in `placements`. When `promotion_type` is `LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_TT_DIRECT_MESSAGE`, `LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_SOCIAL_MEDIA_APP_MESSAGE`, or `LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_CALL`, the default is `CLICK`. Starting November 30th, 2024, you can no longer create or copy ad groups using `optimization_goal=INSTALL` with a valid `secondary_optimization_event` on TikTok placement or Automatic Placement when `objective_type=APP_PROMOTION` (existing such ad groups are unaffected; Pangle-only and Global App Bundle-only configurations are not impacted). `VIDEO_VIEW` is removed in v1.3; for `VIDEO_VIEWS` campaigns prefer `ENGAGED_VIEW` or `ENGAGED_VIEW_FIFTEEN`. For new ad groups under one CBO campaign, this field should match the first ad group.

pacing.description: Pacing mode. `PACING_MODE_SMOOTH` = budget allocated evenly within the scheduled time. `PACING_MODE_FAST` = consume budget and produce results as soon as possible. When CBO is on at the campaign level, the setting is ignored and `PACING_MODE_SMOOTH` is used. Otherwise this field is required.

phone_number.description: Required when `messaging_app_type` is `WHATSAPP` or `ZALO`. WhatsApp or Zalo phone number. For WhatsApp, use the same number connected to the Messagement Management Tool (MMT). Once set, this field cannot be updated.

phone_region_calling_code.description: Required when `messaging_app_type` is `WHATSAPP` or `ZALO`. Region calling code for the WhatsApp or Zalo phone number, for example `+1`. To obtain matching region codes and calling codes, use `/tool/phone_region_code/`. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

phone_region_code.description: Required when `messaging_app_type` is `WHATSAPP` or `ZALO`. Region code for the WhatsApp or Zalo phone number, for example `US`. To obtain matching region codes and calling codes, use `/tool/phone_region_code/`. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

pixel_id.description: Required when `optimization_goal` is `CONVERT` or `VALUE`. Not supported when `optimization_goal` is neither `CONVERT` nor `VALUE`. Pixel ID.

placement_type.description: Placement strategy for where ads are shown. `PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC` = TikTok's ad system selects the best combination of placements. `PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL` = manual placement selection. Default: `PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL`. Cannot be updated after creation. When set to `PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC`, the actual supported placements are reflected in the response `placements` (for example, if only TikTok is supported, the response returns `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`).

placements.description: Required when `placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL`. Ignored and overwritten by the system when `placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC`. Apps where you want to deliver your ads. Cannot be updated after creation. Currently supports `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`, `PLACEMENT_PANGLE`, and `PLACEMENT_GLOBAL_APP_BUNDLE`; do not select `PLACEMENT_TOPBUZZ` or `PLACEMENT_HELO` (deprecated). Locations available for `PLACEMENT_GLOBAL_APP_BUNDLE` are: Brazil, Indonesia, Vietnam, the Philippines, Thailand, Malaysia, Mexico, Saudi Arabia, and Japan; it does not support `optimization_goal=TRAFFIC_LANDING_PAGE_VIEW`. Using `PLACEMENT_GLOBAL_APP_BUNDLE` in Auction Reach is allowlist-only. If `objective_type=REACH` at the campaign level and `placements` includes `PLACEMENT_GLOBAL_APP_BUNDLE`, you cannot also specify `contextual_tag_ids`. If `objective_type=REACH` and `placements=["PLACEMENT_GLOBAL_APP_BUNDLE"]`, you cannot set `brand_safety_type=THIRD_PARTY`. For Product Sales campaigns (`objective_type=PRODUCT_SALES`), only `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK` is supported.

product_source.description: Required for Video Shopping Ads and Product Shopping Ads. Product source. For Video Shopping Ads, the campaign-level `campaign_product_source` constrains allowed values: if campaign is `CATALOG`, this field must be `CATALOG`; if campaign is `STORE`, this field must be `STORE` or `SHOWCASE`. If `campaign_product_source` is unset and the same campaign already contains both a `CATALOG` ad group and a `STORE`/`SHOWCASE` ad group, you cannot create more ad groups under that campaign — ad groups in the same campaign must use either `CATALOG` only, or some combination of `STORE` and `SHOWCASE`. For Product Shopping Ads, set this field to `STORE`.

promotion_target_type.description: Valid when the campaign `objective_type=LEAD_GENERATION`. Promotion type for the Lead Generation objective. `INSTANT_PAGE` = TikTok Instant Form (in-app fast-loading form to collect leads). `EXTERNAL_WEBSITE` = Website Form (your landing page or a TikTok Instant Page that redirects to a website with the form). When `promotion_target_type=EXTERNAL_WEBSITE` and `optimization_goal=CLICK`, do not pass `pixel_id` or `optimization_event`.

promotion_type.description: Promotion type (optimization location). Required when the campaign `objective_type` is not `REACH`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, or `ENGAGEMENT`. If `objective_type=ENGAGEMENT`, the only supported value is `EXTERNAL_OR_DISPLAY`. For the full list of enum values, see the TikTok Marketing API Promotion Type enumeration.

promotion_website_type.description: TikTok Instant Page type for the ad group. `UNSET` = do not use TikTok Instant Page. `TIKTOK_NATIVE_PAGE` = use TikTok Instant Page; in this case `pixel_id` is not supported and you must specify a TikTok Instant Page through `page_id` at the ad level. Required when `app_promotion_type=APP_PREREGISTRATION` at the campaign level.

purchase_intention_keyword_ids.description: IDs of purchase-intention categories to target. Do not pass `purchase_intention_keyword_ids` and `interest_keyword_ids` simultaneously, otherwise keyword conflict will occur. Supported only for Auction ads with `objective_type` in {`APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `LEAD_GENERATION`, `TRAFFIC`} or `PRODUCT_SALES` with `product_source=CATALOG`, and `placements` must include TikTok (`PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`) or Pangle (`PLACEMENT_PANGLE`).

request_id.description: Optional request identifier that allows duplicate `adgroup_name` values and provides 10-second idempotency. To create ad groups with the same `adgroup_name`, send different `request_id` values; retries with the same `request_id` within 10 seconds succeed only once. This is different from the response `request_id`, which uniquely identifies an HTTP request. Must be the string form of a 64-bit integer, for example `123456789`.

roas_bid.description: Required when `deep_bid_type=VO_MIN_ROAS`. ROAS goal for Value Optimization. Value range: in-app advertising scenarios (`objective_type=APP_PROMOTION`, `optimization_goal=VALUE`, and `optimization_event=AD_REVENUE_VALUE`) 0.01-10; Product Shopping Ads with TikTok Shop product source (`shopping_ads_type=PRODUCT_SHOPPING_ADS` and `product_source=STORE`) 0.01-20; other scenarios 0.01-1,000.

saved_audience_id.description: Saved Audience ID. Supported only when all of the following are met at the campaign level: `special_industries` is not specified (no Housing/Employment/Credit category) and `objective_type` is not `PRODUCT_SALES`; and at the ad group level: TikTok placement is selected (`placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC` or `placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL` with `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK` in `placements`); and `auto_targeting_enabled` is not `true`. The advertiser ID associated with the Saved Audience must match the ad group's advertiser ID. When using a Saved Audience, do not concurrently set targeting options (such as `gender`) that are already inside the Saved Audience, or an error will occur. If the Saved Audience's device settings conflict with the ad group's (for example, Saved Audience OS is Android but `ios14_targeting=IOS14_PLUS`, or campaign uses an Android `app_id` while the Saved Audience OS is iOS), an error will occur. If `saved_audience_id` was created with `age_groups` specified, the age restriction rules in New age restrictions for ads on TikTok also apply.

schedule_end_time.description: Required when `schedule_type=SCHEDULE_START_END` or `budget_mode=BUDGET_MODE_TOTAL`. Schedule end time (UTC+0), in the format `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`. No later than `2038-01-01 00:00:00`.

schedule_start_time.description: Schedule start time (UTC+0), in the format `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`. Can be up to 12 hours earlier than the current time and no later than `2028-01-01 00:00:00`.

schedule_type.description: Schedule type. `SCHEDULE_START_END` requires both a start time and an end time. `SCHEDULE_FROM_NOW` requires only a start time, and the end time is automatically set to 10 years later. If `budget_mode=BUDGET_MODE_TOTAL`, `schedule_type` must be `SCHEDULE_START_END`.

search_keywords.description: Required for Search Ads Campaigns (campaign-level `is_search_campaign=true`). Not supported for non-Search Ads Campaigns. List of search keywords used to match ads with user searches. Maximum 1,000 per ad group.

keyword.description: Required when `search_keywords` is passed. The search keyword. Maximum 80 characters. Must exclude emoji and these characters: `!` `#` `$` `%` `&` `(` `)` `*` `-` `/` `:` `;` `<` `>` `?` `@` `\` `^` `_` `¥` `……`. Search keywords must comply with TikTok's Advertising Terms and Community Guidelines: if all keywords are non-compliant, your campaign will not deliver; if some are rejected, you must remove or replace them via `/adgroup/update/`. To check review results, call `/adgroup/get/` and inspect `audit_status` within the `search_keywords` array.

keyword_bid.description: Required and valid only when `keyword_bid_type=CUSTOM`. Ignored when `keyword_bid_type=FOLLOW_ADGROUP`. Bid price for the keyword + match-type combination. Value range: > 0.

keyword_bid_type.description: Bid type for the keyword + match-type combination. `FOLLOW_ADGROUP` = use the ad group level `bid_price` as the keyword bid. `CUSTOM` = customize the bid via `keyword_bid`. Default: `FOLLOW_ADGROUP`. `CUSTOM` is valid only when at the campaign level `objective_type=TRAFFIC` and `is_search_campaign=true`, and at the ad group level `bid_type=BID_TYPE_CUSTOM` and `bid_price` is specified.

match_type.description: Required when `search_keywords` is passed. Match type for the search keyword. `PRECISE_WORD` = exact match. `PHRASE_WORD` = phrase match (same order). `BROAD_WORD` = broad match (any order).

search_result_enabled.description: Whether to include ads in Search Ads (showing ads to users searching for your business on TikTok). If `objective_type` is `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `TRAFFIC`, or `LEAD_GENERATION`, and `placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC` or (`placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL` and `placements` includes `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`), this field is automatically set to `true` (Automatic Search Placement); you may omit it, or pass `true`/`false`. If `objective_type` is `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `TRAFFIC`, or `LEAD_GENERATION` with the campaign's `is_search_campaign=true`, this field is automatically set to `false` and cannot be set to `true` (Search Ads Campaign is incompatible with Automatic Search Placement). Otherwise this field is automatically set to `false` and cannot be set to `true`.

secondary_optimization_event.description: Secondary goal when `optimization_goal` is `INSTALL` or `VALUE`. For enum values, see Conversion events - Secondary-goal events. When `secondary_optimization_event` is specified, you must also pass `deep_bid_type`. Starting November 30th, 2024, you can no longer create or copy ad groups using `optimization_goal=INSTALL` with `secondary_optimization_event` on TikTok placement or Automatic Placement when `objective_type=APP_PROMOTION` (existing such ad groups are unaffected; Pangle-only and Global App Bundle-only configurations are not impacted).

share_disabled.description: Whether to disable sharing ads to third-party platforms. Default: `false`. `true` is valid only when the campaign `objective_type` is `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `REACH`, `TRAFFIC`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, `ENGAGEMENT`, or `LEAD_GENERATION`, and at the ad group level either `placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC` or (`placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL` and `placements=PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`).

shopping_ads_retargeting_actions_days.description: Required when `shopping_ads_retargeting_type` is `LAB1` or `LAB2`. Time range (in days) for the targeted action. Allowed values: 1, 2, 3, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 180.

shopping_ads_retargeting_custom_audience.description: Valid only when `shopping_ads_type=VIDEO`, `product_source=CATALOG`, `shopping_ads_retargeting_type` is set to `LAB1`, `LAB2`, or `LAB3`, and `audience_ids` is passed. Logical relation between the Video Shopping Ads (VSA) retargeting audience (from `shopping_ads_retargeting_type`) and the custom audience (from `audience_ids`). `OR` = union of the two audiences. `AND` = intersection of the two audiences. If unset, the targeted audience defaults to the intersection. Once set, this field cannot be manually updated to a null value.

shopping_ads_retargeting_type.description: Required when `shopping_ads_type=VIDEO` and `product_source=CATALOG`. Retargeting type for shopping ads. `LAB1` = users who viewed products or added to cart but did not purchase. `LAB2` = users who added to cart but did not purchase. `LAB3` = users from a custom combination. `OFF` = no retargeting.

shopping_ads_type.description: Required and valid only when the campaign `objective_type` is `PRODUCT_SALES`. Shopping ads type. `VIDEO` = Video Shopping Ads. `LIVE` = Live Shopping Ads. `PRODUCT_SHOPPING_ADS` = Product Shopping Ads.

smart_audience_enabled.description: Whether to enable Smart audience. Supported values: `true`, `false`.

smart_interest_behavior_enabled.description: Whether to enable Smart interests & behaviors. Supported values: `true`, `false`.

spending_power.description: Spending power to target. `ALL` = all users. `HIGH` = high-spending users (typically spend more on TikTok ads than average). Not supported when the campaign `objective_type` is `PRODUCT_SALES` or `RF_REACH`. Requires Automatic Placement, or Select Placement with TikTok included (`placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC`, or `placements` includes `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`); does not take effect on Pangle. When `auto_targeting_enabled=true`, this is automatically set to `ALL`.

statistic_type.description: Conversion bid statistic type. `EVERYTIME` (Each Purchase) or `NONE` (Unique Purchase). Suitable values for your app event come from `/app/optimization_event/`.

store_authorized_bc_id.description: Required when `store_id` is passed. Business Center ID authorized to access the specified `store_id`.

store_id.description: Required when (`shopping_ads_type=VIDEO` and `product_source=STORE`) or (`shopping_ads_type=PRODUCT_SHOPPING_ADS` and `product_source=STORE`); optional when `shopping_ads_type=LIVE`. TikTok Shop ID.

items.description: The subplacements within TikTok for your ads, allowing you to choose where your ads will appear. Enum value: IN_FEED: In-feed. Ads will be placed in the For You feed and might also be placed in Profile Page and Following feeds. SEARCH_FEED: Search feed. TIKTOK_LITE: TikTok Lite, a streamlined version of TikTok that features a smaller app size and faster video loading speed. The TikTok Lite subplacement is currently available for Japan or South Korea as targeting locations. LEMON8: Lemon8, a community app for lifestyle content, focusing on real-life experiences, tips, guides, and product reviews. By including Lemon8 as a subplacement, your ads will appear in its For You feed, Search feed, and Immersive Video feed. Learn more about Lemon8.

vbo_window.description: Time window of the VBO IAA (Value-Based Optimization for in-app advertising) or VBO IAP (in-app purchase) bidding strategy. `SEVEN_DAYS` = first seven days (day 7). `ZERO_DAY` = current day (day 0). Default: `SEVEN_DAYS`. With Minimum ROAS (Target ROAS), this is the window of the target ROAS value (Day 7 vs Day 0); the system aims to keep average ROAS at or above the target. With Highest Value, this is the Highest Value window type (Day 7 vs Day 0); the system aims to fully spend the budget and maximize result value within the window. VBO IAP and VBO IAA in different scenarios are allowlist-only; in particular, Day 0 or Day 7 bidding for VBO IAP and for VBO IAA in Advanced Dedicated Campaign or Android campaign scenarios are allowlist-only. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

vertical_sensitivity_id.description: Valid only when at the campaign level `objective_type` is `REACH`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, or `ENGAGEMENT`, and at the ad group level `placements=["PLACEMENT_TIKTOK"]` and `brand_safety_type` is `STANDARD_INVENTORY` or `LIMITED_INVENTORY`. Vertical sensitivity category ID.

video_download_disabled.description: Whether to prevent users from downloading video ads on TikTok. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

view_attribution_window.description: View-through attribution window. `OFF`, `ONE_DAY` = 1-day view, `SEVEN_DAYS` = 7-day view. Allowed values vary by advertising objective. To manually configure attribution windows, pass at least `click_attribution_window` and `view_attribution_window` simultaneously. If you omit all four attribution fields, default settings (if any) are used; check via `/adgroup/get/`. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

zipcode_ids.description: You must set `location_ids` or `zipcode_ids` or both. Zip code or postal code IDs to target. Maximum 3,000 (combined with `location_ids` not exceeding 3,000 per ad group). Zip code targeting is supported only for the US; postal code targeting is supported for Canada, Brazil, Indonesia, Thailand, and Vietnam. Targeting postal code areas in Brazil, Indonesia, Thailand, and Vietnam is allowlist-only. Cannot be used in campaigns that have enabled `special_industries`. Cannot be used in campaigns with `objective_type=RF_REACH`. Only TikTok placement is supported (`placements` must include `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`). Overlapping locations are not supported. If you target US locations on creation, you can later switch to other US locations but you cannot remove all US locations to target only non-US countries.

exclude_field_types_in_response.description: Field types to exclude from the response.

fields.description: List of ad group fields to return. If omitted, all available fields are returned by default.

filtering.description: Filter conditions for selecting ad groups. If omitted, all ad groups under the advertiser are returned. Example: `filtering={"campaign_automation_type":"UPGRADED_SMART_PLUS"}`.

adgroup_ids.description: List of ad group IDs to filter by. Maximum 100 IDs.

buying_types.description: Buying types to filter by. Default value: `["AUCTION", "RESERVATION_RF"]`. `RESERVATION_TOP_VIEW` cannot be combined with other values; to filter TopView ads, set this field to `["RESERVATION_TOP_VIEW"]`.

campaign_ids.description: List of campaign IDs to filter by. Maximum 100 IDs.

campaign_system_origins.description: Origins of the campaigns the ad groups belong to. Default value: `["TT_ADS_PLATFORM"]`. When filtering Promote ad groups (`PROMOTE`), only these fields can be retrieved: `advertiser_id`, `campaign_id`, `campaign_name`, `adgroup_id`, `adgroup_name`, `create_time`, `budget`, `schedule_type`, `schedule_start_time`, `schedule_end_time`, `operation_status`, and `secondary_status`.

creation_filter_end_time.description: Upper bound of ad group creation time in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` (UTC). Returns ad groups created earlier than this time. A time range within 6 months is recommended to avoid affecting task speed and success.

creation_filter_start_time.description: Lower bound of ad group creation time in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` (UTC). Returns ad groups created later than this time. A time range within 6 months is recommended to avoid affecting task speed and success.

objective_type.description: Advertising objective. If you filter by either `WEB_CONVERSIONS` or `CONVERSIONS`, the endpoint returns ad groups for both `WEB_CONVERSIONS` and `CONVERSIONS`.

primary_status.description: Primary status. Default is `STATUS_NOT_DELETE`, which returns all ad groups except `STATUS_DELETE`. To return all statuses including deleted ad groups, use `STATUS_ALL`.

promotion_type.description: Promotion type (optimization location) to filter by. This filter is different from the `promotion_type` used for ad group creation, though both may appear in this endpoint. It is also supported in synchronous basic reports and synchronous DSA reports.

secondary_status.description: Ad group secondary status. This field is not returned in the sandbox environment because ad groups are not actually delivered there. Valid values depend on the `primary_status` you specify.

split_test_enabled.description: Filter by whether split test is enabled for the ad group. `true` returns only ad groups with split test enabled; `false` returns only ad groups with split test disabled. If omitted, all ad groups are returned.

page.description: Current page number. Default: `1`. Value must be greater than or equal to 1.

page_size.description: Page size. Default: `10`. Range: `1`-`1000`. If `filtering.buying_types` is `RESERVATION_TOP_VIEW`, the maximum allowed value is `100`.

adgroup_ids.description: IDs of the ad groups to operate on. Size range: 1-20.

allow_partial_success.description: Whether to allow partial success when operating on multiple ad groups. Default is `false`. If `true`, some specified ad groups may succeed while ineligible ad groups are filtered out.

operation_status.description: Operation to perform on the ad groups. `DISABLE` pauses delivery, `ENABLE` resumes delivery, and `DELETE` deletes the ad group. The status of deleted ad groups, or ad groups in deleted campaigns, cannot be modified. `ENABLE` and `DISABLE` are not supported for R&F ad groups.

action_category_ids.description: IDs of video interaction categories, creator interaction categories, hashtags, or hashtag bundles used with the selected behavior targeting. Search or list them with `/targeting/search/` (recommended), `/tool/action_category/`, or `/tool/hashtag/recommend/`; recommendations are also available from `/tool/targeting_category/recommend/`.

action_period.description: Time period to include behaviors from. Supported values are `0`, `7`, and `15`. If `action_scene` is `CREATOR_RELATED` or `HASHTAG_RELATED`, `0` is used regardless of the value passed. `0` means no definite time frame.

video_user_actions.description: Specific user interactions to target, depending on `action_scene`. If `action_scene=VIDEO_RELATED`, allowed values are `WATCHED_TO_END`, `LIKED`, `COMMENTED`, `SHARED`. If `action_scene=CREATOR_RELATED`, allowed values are `FOLLOWING`, `VIEW_HOMEPAGE`. If `action_scene=HASHTAG_RELATED`, the allowed value is `VIEW_HASHTAG`.

adgroup_name.description: Ad group name. Maximum length is 512 characters and emoji are not allowed.

age_groups.description: Age groups to target. In some scenarios, targeting `AGE_13_17` in the U.S., Latin America, the EEA, the UK, Switzerland, or Canada is not allowed. If you are affected by these restrictions and leave `age_groups` unset or pass `[]` without setting `exclude_age_under_eighteen=true`, the request will fail. In those restricted scenarios, if you would otherwise leave `age_groups` unset or empty, TikTok recommends also setting `exclude_age_under_eighteen=true` to avoid errors.

audience_ids.description: Audience IDs to include. Use `/dmp/custom_audience/list/` to obtain valid IDs.

audience_rule.description: Audience rules. Valid when `objective_type` is `TRAFFIC` or `APP_PROMOTION`.

audience_type.description: Required and valid only when campaign-level `app_promotion_type` is `APP_RETARGETING`; not supported otherwise. App retargeting audience type. You must use the same setting as when the ad group was created. Supported value is `NEW_CUSTOM_AUDIENCE`. If you want an empty retargeting custom audience, do not pass `audience_ids` or `excluded_audience_ids`. For a non-empty retargeting custom audience, pass `audience_ids`, `excluded_audience_ids`, or both, but the two lists cannot contain the same IDs.

automated_keywords_enabled.description: Valid only when campaign-level `is_search_campaign` is `true`. Whether to let the system automatically generate keywords after ads are added. Default is `false`. This feature is allowlist-only for Search Ads Campaigns.

bid_price.description: Valid only when `bid_type` is `BID_TYPE_CUSTOM` and `billing_event` is `CPC`, `CPM`, or `CPV`. Bid price for Cost Cap bidding. When CBO (`budget_optimize_on`) is on, TikTok suggests using the same bid across ad groups in the same campaign. `bid_price` must be lower than both campaign-level and ad-group-level budget.

bid_type.description: Bidding strategy that controls cost management, spending, and delivery. This field cannot be updated when Campaign Budget Optimization (`budget_optimize_on=TRUE`) is enabled.

blocked_pangle_app_ids.description: Pangle app block list IDs. Effective only when Pangle placement is selected. Use the `app_package_id` returned by the Pangle block list endpoint.

brand_safety_type.description: Brand safety type. Use `/tool/region/` to determine the countries and regions available for the chosen brand safety setting. Updating Brand Safety settings (`brand_safety_type`, `category_exclusion_ids`, and `vertical_sensitivity_id`) is allowlist-only. Pre-bid first-party Brand Safety for `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `TRAFFIC`, `LEAD_GENERATION`, and `PRODUCT_SALES` in Auction ads is also allowlist-only.

budget.description: Advertising budget. Cannot be updated when Campaign Budget Optimization (`budget_optimize_on`) is on. The new budget must be at least 105% of current spend; use reporting endpoints to retrieve the `spend` metric if needed.

carrier_ids.description: Carrier IDs to target. A carrier is valid only when its `in_use` field is `true`, and carriers must be consistent with the targeted locations.

catalog_authorized_bc_id.description: For catalogs in Business Center, specify the Business Center ID that the catalog belongs to. Starting June 30th, 2024, when `product_source` is `STORE`, this field is ignored on update. If you update an existing ad group where `product_source` is `STORE`, any existing `catalog_authorized_bc_id` will no longer be returned.

category_exclusion_ids.description: Content exclusion category IDs. This field can be updated only if the ad group's `schedule_start_time` has not been reached, or if it has been reached but `operation_status` is `DISABLE` and cost is 0; use `/adgroup/get/` to check those values. Use `/tool/content_exclusion/get/` to retrieve `excluded_category_list`. Updating Brand Safety settings is allowlist-only.

comment_disabled.description: Whether to allow comments on ads in this ad group on TikTok.

contextual_tag_ids.description: Contextual tag IDs. Use `/tool/contextual_tag/get/` to retrieve valid tags. This is an allowlist-only feature. Supported only when campaign `objective_type` is `REACH` or `VIDEO_VIEWS`, and not supported when `brand_safety_type` is `THIRD_PARTY`.

conversion_bid_price.description: Valid only when `bid_type` is `BID_TYPE_CUSTOM` and `billing_event` is `OCPM`. Target cost per conversion for oCPM. `conversion_bid_price` must be lower than both campaign-level and ad-group-level budget.

dayparting.description: Ad delivery schedule as a 48×7-character string, where each character maps to a 30-minute slot from Monday through Sunday. `1` means deliver and `0` means do not deliver. If omitted, all `0`, or all `1`, delivery is treated as full-time.

deep_bid_type.description: Bidding strategy for in-app events. When `secondary_optimization_event` is specified, you must also pass `deep_bid_type`.

deep_cpa_bid.description: Bid price used after choosing an in-app-event bidding strategy, for example `VO_MIN`.

deep_funnel_event_source.description: Required when `deep_funnel_optimization_status` is `ON`. Event source type for deep funnel optimization. When deep funnel optimization is enabled, you cannot update `deep_funnel_event_source`, `deep_funnel_event_source_id`, or `deep_funnel_optimization_event`. `PIXEL` uses a Pixel, `OFFLINE` uses an Offline Event Set, and `CRM` uses a CRM Event Set.

deep_funnel_event_source_id.description: Required when `deep_funnel_optimization_status` is `ON`. Event source ID. If `deep_funnel_event_source` is `PIXEL`, pass a Pixel ID from `/pixel/list/`. If `OFFLINE`, pass an Offline Event Set ID from `/offline/get/`. If `CRM`, pass a CRM Event Set ID from `/crm/list/`. When deep funnel optimization is enabled, you cannot update `deep_funnel_event_source`, `deep_funnel_event_source_id`, or `deep_funnel_optimization_event`.

deep_funnel_optimization_event.description: Required when `deep_funnel_optimization_status` is `ON`. Deep funnel optimization event. Supported values depend on the chosen event source; for Pixels you can also inspect `optimization_event` returned by `/pixel/list/`. Example: `SHOPPING`.

deep_funnel_optimization_status.description: Valid only when `promotion_type` is `LEAD_GENERATION`. Controls deep funnel optimization, which optimizes both upper-funnel and deeper-funnel events. If set to `ON`, you must also provide `deep_funnel_event_source`, `deep_funnel_event_source_id`, and `deep_funnel_optimization_event`. Default is `OFF`. Deep funnel optimization with CRM events is allowlist-only; Pixel and Offline event sources are generally available.

device_model_ids.description: Device model IDs to target. Use `/tool/device_model/` to retrieve valid IDs and device statuses; only active devices (`is_active=true`) can be used. Do not set this field together with `device_price_ranges`.

device_price_ranges.description: Device price range targeting. Values must be multiples of 50; `10000` means 1000+. Important: the upper limit you set is increased by 50 for the actual applied upper limit shown in Ads Manager. For example, `[0,250]` actually means `[0,300]`.

exclude_age_under_eighteen.description: Whether to exclude users younger than 18. Use only in scenarios where targeting `AGE_13_17` in the U.S., Latin America, the EEA, the UK, Switzerland, or Canada is not supported; in other scenarios this field is not supported. Default is `false`. See `age_groups` for the dependency.

excluded_audience_ids.description: Audience IDs to exclude. Use `/dmp/custom_audience/list/` to obtain valid IDs.

excluded_custom_actions.description: Custom actions to exclude for filtering shopping-ads retargeting audiences. When `shopping_ads_retargeting_type` is `LAB3`, you must pass either `included_custom_actions` or `excluded_custom_actions`.

code.description: Custom action used as an Exclude condition for shopping-ads retargeting.

days.description: Time range used to exclude audiences that did not complete the specified action. Range: 1-180.

excluded_pangle_audience_package_ids.description: Pangle audience package IDs to exclude. Valid only for Pangle placement. Obtain `package_id` values from `/pangle_audience_package/get/` with `bind_type=EXCLUDE`. Do not pass this field together with `included_pangle_audience_package_ids`.

frequency.description: Used with `frequency_schedule` to control how often people see the ad. Available only for `REACH` ads. Both must satisfy `1 <= frequency <= 1000` and `1 <= frequency_schedule <= 30`. Example: `frequency=2` and `frequency_schedule=3` means show ads no more than twice every 3 days.

frequency_schedule.description: Used with `frequency` to control ad frequency. Available only for `REACH` ads.

household_income.description: Household income targeting. Not supported in Reach & Frequency ads and works only on TikTok placement in the U.S.

included_custom_actions.description: Custom actions to include for filtering shopping-ads retargeting audiences. When `shopping_ads_retargeting_type` is `LAB3`, you must pass either `included_custom_actions` or `excluded_custom_actions`.

code.description: Custom action used as an Include condition for shopping-ads retargeting.

days.description: Time range used to include audiences that completed the specified action. Range: 1-180.

included_pangle_audience_package_ids.description: Pangle audience package IDs to include. Valid only for Pangle placement. Obtain `package_id` values from `/pangle_audience_package/get/` with `bind_type=INCLUDE`. Do not pass this field together with `excluded_pangle_audience_package_ids`.

interest_category_ids.description: General interest category IDs for audience targeting. Search or list them with `/targeting/search/` (recommended) or `/tool/interest_category/`; get recommendations by industry with `/tool/targeting_category/recommend/`.

interest_keyword_ids.description: Additional interest category IDs for audience targeting. Search them with `/targeting/search/` (recommended) or `/tool/interest_keyword/recommend/`.

ios14_targeting.description: Required and must be `IOS14_PLUS` when campaign-level `campaign_type` is `IOS14_CAMPAIGN`. iOS targeting mode. `UNSET` targets iOS 14.4 or earlier. `IOS14_MINUS` targets versions earlier than iOS 14.0. `IOS14_PLUS` targets iOS 14.5+ and is supported only for Dedicated Campaigns; once set to `IOS14_PLUS`, this field cannot be updated. `ALL` targets iOS 14.5+ and is supported only for iOS App Retargeting ads and iOS retargeting Video Shopping Ads with catalog product source and app optimization. If targeting iOS 14.5+ in App Retargeting ads, set `ios14_targeting=ALL` and `min_ios_version` to `14.5` or later, otherwise the request fails. For iOS App Retargeting ads (`app_promotion_type=APP_RETARGETING` and `promotion_type=APP_IOS`) and iOS retargeting Video Shopping Ads (`shopping_ads_type=VIDEO`, `product_source=CATALOG`, `promotion_type=APP_IOS`, and `shopping_ads_retargeting_type` is not `OFF`), `ALL` is used regardless of the value passed. In other cases the default is `UNSET`. Once set to `IOS14_PLUS`, these requirements must be met: `app_id` must be an iOS app ID from `/app/list/`, `operating_systems` must be `["IOS"]`, `min_ios_version` must be provided and consistent, `optimization_goal` must be `CLICK`, `INSTALL`, `IN_APP_EVENT`, or `VALUE`, `min_android_version`, `shopping_ads_retargeting_type`, and `shopping_ads_retargeting_actions_days` must not be specified, and at the ad level `deeplink_type` must not be `DEFERRED_DEEPLINK`.

is_hfss.description: Whether the promoted content is HFSS (High Fat, Salt, Sugar). If the ad promotes or prominently features an HFSS product or brand, set this to `true`. In regulated regions, HFSS ads must target only users age 18+. You can set this field to `true` when targeting locations include the UK, Australia, New Zealand, or the European Union. This setting can only be updated from `false` to `true`, not the reverse.

is_lhf_compliance.description: Whether the promoted content complies with LHF (Less Healthy Foods) regulations. Setting this to `true` confirms that any food or drink products advertised in the UK comply with the 2024 Less Healthy Foods Regulations and other applicable laws. Starting January 1st, 2026, if targeted locations include the UK and `is_hfss` is `true`, this field is required and must be `true`.

isp_ids.description: Internet service provider IDs to target. Valid only when you also provide a valid country- or region-level `location_ids` value. Use `/tool/targeting/list/` to get ISP IDs for a location. When `isp_ids` is set, `placements` cannot be only `PLACEMENT_GLOBAL_APP_BUNDLE`.

languages.description: Language codes to target. If omitted or empty, language targeting is not limited. Retrieve valid codes from `/tool/language/`.

location_ids.description: Location IDs to target. You must provide `location_ids`, `zipcode_ids`, or both. Maximum 3,000 combined IDs across `location_ids`, zip codes, and postal codes per ad group. Use `/tool/targeting/search/` or `/tool/region/` to find valid locations. Overlapping locations are not supported (for example, the U.S. and California together). If the ad group originally targeted U.S. locations via `location_ids` or `zipcode_ids`, you can update to other U.S. locations but cannot remove all U.S. locations and target only non-U.S. countries. If `TIKTOK_LITE` is included in `tiktok_subplacements`, you cannot update the ad group to exclude Japan and South Korea. To remove all location IDs, set `location_ids` to `[]` and simultaneously provide `zipcode_ids`, because targeted locations remain mandatory.

min_ios_version.description: Required when `ios14_targeting` is specified. Minimum iOS version; it must also be consistent with `ios14_targeting` when required.

next_day_retention.description: Day-2 retention ratio. Valid only when `placements` is `PLACEMENT_PANGLE` and `secondary_optimization_event` is `NEXT_DAY_OPEN`. Formula: `next_day_retention = conversion_bid_price / deep_cpa_bid`. Range is `(0,1]`. If you use this field, pass `conversion_bid_price`, `deep_bid_type`, and `next_day_retention` together and make sure the values satisfy the formula, or unexpected errors may occur.

operating_systems.description: Device operating systems to target. Only one value is allowed. Required when campaign `objective_type` is `APP_PROMOTION`, or when campaign `objective_type` is `TRAFFIC` and campaign `promotion_type` is `APP_IOS` or `APP_ANDROID`.

pacing.description: Pacing mode. `PACING_MODE_SMOOTH` spreads budget evenly across the schedule; `PACING_MODE_FAST` spends as quickly as possible. When CBO (`budget_optimize_on`) is on, this setting is ignored and becomes `PACING_MODE_SMOOTH`; otherwise this field is required.

purchase_intention_keyword_ids.description: Purchase intention category IDs for targeting audiences interested in purchases related to a content category. Use `/targeting/search/` to obtain valid IDs. This field supports incremental updates.

roas_bid.description: Required when `deep_bid_type` is `VO_MIN_ROAS`. ROAS goal for Value Optimization. Range is `0.01-10` for in-app advertising with `objective_type=APP_PROMOTION`, `optimization_goal=VALUE`, and `optimization_event=AD_REVENUE_VALUE`; `0.01-20` for Product Shopping Ads with `shopping_ads_type=PRODUCT_SHOPPING_ADS` and `product_source=STORE`; otherwise `0.01-1000`.

saved_audience_id.description: Saved Audience ID. Supported only when campaign `special_industries` for Housing, Employment, or Credit is not set, campaign `objective_type` is not `PRODUCT_SALES`, TikTok placement is selected (`placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC` or `placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL` with `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK` in `placements`), and `auto_targeting_enabled` is not `true`. Create the Saved Audience first with `/dmp/saved_audience/create/`; its advertiser must match this ad group's `advertiser_id`. Do not pass `saved_audience_id` together with targeting options already contained in that Saved Audience (for example `gender`), or the request will fail. Device settings in the Saved Audience must also be compatible with the ad group; for example, an Android Saved Audience conflicts with `ios14_targeting=IOS14_PLUS`, and an iOS Saved Audience conflicts with Android app promotion setups. If troubleshooting a conflict, use `/dmp/saved_audience/list/` to inspect the Saved Audience. If the Saved Audience was created with `age_groups`, the same age restriction rules still apply here.

schedule_end_time.description: Required when `schedule_type` is `SCHEDULE_START_END`. End time in UTC+0, format `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`. It cannot be later than `2038-01-01 00:00:00`.

schedule_start_time.description: Required when `schedule_type` is passed. Start time in UTC+0, format `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`. It can be up to 12 hours earlier than the current time, but not later than `2028-01-01 00:00:00`. This field cannot be updated if the ad group's current `schedule_start_time` is earlier than now.

schedule_type.description: Schedule type. If `SCHEDULE_START_END`, you must provide both `schedule_start_time` and `schedule_end_time`. If `SCHEDULE_FROM_NOW`, provide only `schedule_start_time` and the end time is automatically set to 10 years later.

search_keywords.description: Valid only in Search Ads Campaigns. List of search keywords used to match ads with user search terms. Maximum 1,000 items per ad group. To verify that the campaign is a Search Ads Campaign, call `/campaign/get/` and check `is_search_campaign`. If search keywords or targeted locations are updated, the keywords will go through review again.

keyword.description: When `search_keywords` is provided, you must include at least one `keyword` with its corresponding `match_type`. Search keyword text. Maximum length is 80 characters. Emoji and these special characters are not allowed: `!` `#` `$` `%` `&` `(` `)` `*` `-` `/` `:` `;` `<` `>` `?` `@` `\\` `^` `_` `¥` `……`. To check keyword review results, call `/adgroup/get/` and inspect `search_keywords[].audit_status`. If all keywords are non-compliant, the campaign will not deliver. If some keywords are rejected, remove or replace them with `/adgroup/update/` and approved keywords can continue delivering.

keyword_bid.description: Required and valid only when `keyword_bid_type` is `CUSTOM`; ignored when `keyword_bid_type` is `FOLLOW_ADGROUP`. Bid price for the keyword and match type combination. Must be greater than 0.

keyword_bid_type.description: Bid type for the keyword + match type pair. Default is `FOLLOW_ADGROUP`. If `FOLLOW_ADGROUP`, the keyword uses ad group-level `bid_price`. If `CUSTOM`, you must provide `keyword_bid`. `CUSTOM` is valid only when campaign `objective_type` is `TRAFFIC`, campaign `is_search_campaign` is `true`, ad group `bid_type` is `BID_TYPE_CUSTOM`, and ad group `bid_price` is specified.

match_type.description: When `search_keywords` is provided, you must include at least one `keyword` with its corresponding `match_type`. Match type for the keyword: `PRECISE_WORD` for exact match, `PHRASE_WORD` for phrase match in the same order, or `BROAD_WORD` for broad match.

search_result_enabled.description: Whether to include ads in Search Ads so they can show when users search for your business on TikTok. You can use this field only when: campaign `objective_type` is `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS` with `is_search_campaign=false`, `TRAFFIC`, or `LEAD_GENERATION`; if `objective_type` is `LEAD_GENERATION`, `promotion_type` must be `LEAD_GENERATION`; and placement is `PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC` or `PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL` with `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK` included in `placements`. This field can be used to update the value from `false` to `true` only under those conditions. If `is_search_campaign` is `true`, you cannot update it from `false` to `true`.

secondary_optimization_event.description: Secondary goal when `optimization_goal` is `INSTALL` or `VALUE`. When this field is specified, you must also pass `deep_bid_type`.

share_disabled.description: Whether to disable sharing of ads in this ad group to third-party platforms. `true` is valid only when all of these are met: campaign `objective_type` is one of `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `REACH`, `TRAFFIC`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, `ENGAGEMENT`, or `LEAD_GENERATION`; and placement is either `placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC` or `placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL` with `placements` set to `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`. This field supports incremental updates.

shopping_ads_retargeting_actions_days.description: Valid time range for the audience action to retarget. Required when `shopping_ads_retargeting_type` is `LAB1` or `LAB2`. Allowed values: `1`, `2`, `3`, `7`, `14`, `30`, `60`, `90`, `180`.

shopping_ads_retargeting_custom_audience.description: Valid only when all are true: `shopping_ads_type=VIDEO`, `product_source=CATALOG`, `shopping_ads_retargeting_type` is `LAB1`, `LAB2`, or `LAB3`, and `audience_ids` is provided. Controls the logical relation between the Video Shopping Ads retargeting audience and the custom audience in `audience_ids`: `OR` combines them, `AND` intersects them. If the custom audience is later removed, this field is automatically reset to null.

shopping_ads_retargeting_type.description: Valid when `shopping_ads_type` is `VIDEO` and `product_source` is `CATALOG`. Shopping ads retargeting type: `LAB1` retargets users who viewed products or added to cart but did not purchase, `LAB2` retargets users who added to cart but did not purchase, `LAB3` uses custom combinations, and `OFF` disables retargeting.

smart_interest_behavior_enabled.description: Whether to enable Smart interests & behaviors.

spending_power.description: Spending power targeting. `HIGH` targets users who typically spend more on TikTok ads than average users. Not supported when campaign `objective_type` is `PRODUCT_SALES` or `RF_REACH`. Requires TikTok placement via `placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC` or `placements` including `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`; if Pangle is also selected, spending power does not take effect on Pangle. When `auto_targeting_enabled=true`, `spending_power` is automatically set to `ALL`.

vertical_sensitivity_id.description: Vertical sensitivity category ID. This field can be updated only if the ad group's `schedule_start_time` has not been reached, or if it has been reached but `operation_status` is `DISABLE` and cost is 0; use `/adgroup/get/` to check those values. Use `/tool/content_exclusion/get/` to retrieve `vertical_sensitivity_list`. Updating Brand Safety settings is allowlist-only.

zipcode_ids.description: Zip code IDs or postal code IDs to target. You must provide `location_ids`, `zipcode_ids`, or both. Maximum 3,000 combined IDs across `location_ids`, zip codes, and postal codes per ad group. Obtain zip/postal IDs from `/tool/targeting/search/` using `geo_id` where `geo_type=ZIP_CODE`. Supported for U.S. zip codes and for postal codes in Canada, Brazil, Indonesia, Thailand, and Vietnam; Brazil, Indonesia, Thailand, and Vietnam postal-code targeting is allowlist-only. Not supported when campaign `special_industries` is enabled, when campaign `objective_type` is `RF_REACH`, or when TikTok placement is not included in `placements`. Overlapping locations are not supported. If the ad group originally targeted U.S. locations via `location_ids` or `zipcode_ids`, you can update to other U.S. locations but cannot remove all U.S. locations and target only non-U.S. countries. To remove all zip/postal IDs, set `zipcode_ids` to `[]` and simultaneously provide `location_ids`. This field supports incremental updates.

auto_disclaimer_types.description: Valid only when campaign `objective_type=LEAD_GENERATION` and `catalog_enabled=true`, the ad group specifies an Auto-Model catalog through `catalog_id`, and `catalog_creative_toggle=true` at the ad level. Disclaimer type to show in an Automotive Carousel Ad for Models. Max size: 1. Before using `EMISSION`, each vehicle must include `emission_disclaimer`, `emission_disclaimer_url`, `emission_overlay_disclaimer`, and `emission_image_link`. Before using `DISCOUNT`, each vehicle must include `offer_disclaimer` and `offer_disclaimer_url`.

call_to_action_id.description: Required in either of these scenarios: (1) campaign `objective_type=LEAD_GENERATION` and the ad group uses TikTok placement (`placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL` with `placements` including `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`, or `placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC`); (2) campaign `objective_type=APP_PROMOTION` or `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, the ad group uses TikTok placement, and `creative_info.identity_type` is `TT_USER`, `BC_AUTH_TT`, or `AUTH_CODE`. CTA portfolio ID (dynamic CTA) used in the ad.

catalog_creative_info.description: Additional settings for catalog creatives. Valid only when the ad is an Upgraded Smart+ E-commerce Catalog Ad and `catalog_creative_toggle` is `true`.

catalog_media_settings.description: Types of creatives from the E-commerce catalog to use. If this list includes `TEMPLATE_VIDEO`, you may also provide `catalog_template_video_id`. If `catalog_template_video_id` is omitted, all video templates and video URLs in the catalog are used to generate the ad. If `catalog_template_video_id` is provided, the selected template is used. If you specify `catalog_media_settings`, you cannot later update `catalog_creative_toggle` to `false` or update `catalog_media_settings` to an empty list.

catalog_template_video_id.description: Valid only when `TEMPLATE_VIDEO` is included in `catalog_media_settings`. Video template ID from your catalog, obtainable from `/catalog/video_package/get/`.

catalog_creative_toggle.description: Valid only when campaign `catalog_enabled` is `true`. Enables auto-selection of creatives from the catalog. Defaults to `false`. If set to `true` for Upgraded Smart+ Web Ads using catalog carousel format, provide `creative_info` containing only `music_info`. If set to `true` for Upgraded Smart+ Automotive Ads using catalog carousel format, provide `creative_info` with one image in `image_info` plus `music_info` for the end card image and music.

creative_auto_add_toggle.description: Valid only when either (1) campaign `objective_type=WEB_CONVERSIONS` and `sales_destination=WEBSITE`, or (2) campaign `objective_type=LEAD_GENERATION` and ad group `promotion_type=LEAD_GENERATION` with `promotion_target_type=INSTANT_PAGE` or `EXTERNAL_WEBSITE`. Enables automatic addition of newly generated assets during delivery. Default depends on allowlist status: `true` if allowlisted for default-on behavior, otherwise `false`. The feature is available to all advertisers, but default-on behavior is allowlist-only.

creative_auto_enhancement_strategy_list.description: List of automatic enhancement strategies to apply during delivery. Default depends on allowlist status: if allowlisted for specific strategies by default, the field defaults to those strategies; otherwise it defaults to an empty list. Each enhancement's default-on behavior is separately allowlist-only.

dark_post_status.description: Valid only for Spark Ads created through Spark Ads Push. Controls Ads-only mode for the creative. Defaults to `ON`. You can set `OFF` only if the identity's "Show through ads only" mode is disabled and the ad account does not have mandatory Ads-only mode enabled. If the ad account enforces mandatory Ads-only mode, this field can only be `ON`. Check the identity `ads_only_mode` via `/identity/info/` and the ad account `ads_only_mode` via `/advertiser/info/`. Mandatory Ads-only mode at the ad-account level is currently allowlist-only.

deeplink_utm_params.description: Valid only when campaign `objective_type=WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `sales_destination=APP`, and at the ad level `deeplink` is specified and `deeplink_type=DEFERRED_DEEPLINK`. List of deeplink URL parameters as key-value pairs. Max size: 14. This is currently an allowlist-only feature.

key.description: Deeplink URL parameter key. Can be a custom parameter or one of these supported UTM parameters: `utm_source`, `utm_medium`, `utm_content`, `utm_campaign`. UTM parameters are case-sensitive. Length limit for a custom parameter: 100 characters.

value.description: Deeplink URL parameter value. Can be a custom value or one of these macros: `__CAMPAIGN_NAME__`, `__CAMPAIGN_ID__`, `__AID_NAME__`, `__AID__`, `__CID_NAME__`, `__CID__`, `__PLACEMENT__`. Length limit for a custom value: 600 characters.

end_card_cta.description: Required when campaign `objective_type=LEAD_GENERATION` and `catalog_enabled=true`, the ad group specifies an Auto-Inventory or Auto-Model catalog through `catalog_id`, and `catalog_creative_toggle=true` at the ad level. CTA for the end card (`image_info`) of an Upgraded Smart+ Automotive Carousel Ad for Inventory, Automotive Carousel Ad for Models, or the catalog solution for Upgraded Smart+ TikTok Direct Messaging Ads. `SEND_MESSAGE` is available only for the catalog solution for Upgraded Smart+ TikTok Direct Messaging Ads.

fallback_type.description: Required when ad group `promotion_type=LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_SOCIAL_MEDIA_APP_MESSAGE` and `messaging_app_type=IM_URL`, and a custom URL scheme for an instant messaging app is specified through `deeplink` at the ad level. Controls the destination when the app is not installed. `WEBSITE` requires that you also provide the fallback URL in `landing_page_url_list`.

identity_authorized_bc_id.description: Required when `ad_configuration.identity_type` is `BC_AUTH_TT`. Business Center ID associated with the TikTok Account User in Business Center identity.

identity_id.description: Required in the same scenarios as `ad_configuration.identity_type`. Identity ID for the selected identity.

identity_type.description: Required when creating non-Spark Ads on non-TikTok placements, or when creating Spark Ads using catalog creatives from an E-commerce catalog. Non-Spark Ads on TikTok placement are no longer supported. For non-Spark Ads on non-TikTok placements, the only supported value is `CUSTOMIZED_USER`. For Upgraded Smart+ E-commerce Catalog Spark Ads with `catalog_creative_toggle=true`, supported values are `TT_USER` and `BC_AUTH_TT`.

phone_info.description: Required when ad group `promotion_type` is `LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_CALL`. Phone number details that users can call from the ad.

phone_number.description: Required when `phone_info` is specified. Phone number users can call from the ad, for example `12638282`.

phone_region_calling_code.description: Required when `phone_info` is specified. Region calling code, for example `+1`. Obtain the region code and region calling code from `/tool/phone_region_code/`.

phone_region_code.description: Required when `phone_info` is specified. Region code for the phone number, for example `US`. Obtain the region code and region calling code from `/tool/phone_region_code/`.

product_display_field_list.description: Valid only when campaign `objective_type=LEAD_GENERATION` and `catalog_enabled=true`, the ad group specifies an Auto-Inventory catalog through `catalog_id`, and `catalog_creative_toggle=true` at the ad level. Product detail fields to display in an Automotive Carousel Ad for Inventory. Max size: 2. The title is displayed automatically. For example, if set to `["MILEAGE","YEAR"]`, the ad displays the `mileage`, `price`, and `title` fields. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

product_ids.description: Required when `product_specific_type` is `CUSTOMIZED_PRODUCTS`. Catalog product IDs. Max size: 20. Retrieve `product_id` values with `/catalog/product/get/`.

product_info.description: Product information used to generate personalized ad variations. All fields in `product_info` are optional. More complete information may improve generated variations and ad performance.

catalog_tag_list.description: Catalog product information to display. Valid in either of these scenarios: (1) campaign `objective_type=WEB_CONVERSIONS` and `catalog_type=ECOMMERCE`; (2) campaign `objective_type=LEAD_GENERATION` and `catalog_enabled=true`, and the ad group specifies an Auto-Inventory catalog through `catalog_id`. In scenario 1, supported values are `PRICE`, `STRIKETHROUGH_PRICE`, `DISCOUNT`, and `FREE_SHIPPING`, defaulting to `["PRICE","STRIKETHROUGH_PRICE","DISCOUNT","FREE_SHIPPING"]`, max size 4. In scenario 2, supported values are `DEALER_NAME`, `CURRENT_MILEAGE`, `LEAD_PRICE`, `LEAD_SALE_PRICE`, `EXTERIOR_COLOR`, `TRIM`, `ADDRESS_CITY`, `VEHICLE_STATE`; max size is 2 primary tags (`DEALER_NAME`,`CURRENT_MILEAGE`,`EXTERIOR_COLOR`,`TRIM`,`ADDRESS_CITY`,`VEHICLE_STATE`) and 2 secondary tags (`LEAD_PRICE`,`LEAD_SALE_PRICE`).

product_card_type.description: The product card display type. Enum values: PRODUCT_CARD: Product Card. PRODUCT_TILE: Product Tiles. PRODUCT_INFO_CARD: Info Card. PRODUCT_SHOWCASE_TILE: Showcase Tiles. ANCHOR: Anchor. CAROUSEL_LABEL: Carousel label.

product_image_list.description: List of product images. Size range: 0-10. If omitted, a generic image is used so the image does not appear blank.

web_uri.description: Image ID for a product image. Supported formats: `.jpg`, `.png`, `.jpeg`, `.webp`; file size up to 5 MB; recommended resolution 800x800. Obtain image IDs from `/file/image/ad/search/` or `/file/image/ad/upload/`.

product_titles.description: List of product names. Size range: 0-1. Each name can be up to 40 characters, cannot contain emoji, and counts Chinese or Japanese words as two characters and English letters as one. If omitted, a default name is used so the field does not appear blank.

promo_info_list.description: Promo code and offer details. Valid only for regular Upgraded Smart+ Web Campaigns. Highlights offers, promo codes, or events in the ad. Promo codes require shoppers to enter a code at checkout; offers apply automatically. Max size: 10.

discount_type.description: Required when `promo_info_list` is specified. Discount type.

discount_value.description: Required when `promo_info_list` is specified. If `discount_type` is `PERCENTAGE`, provide an integer from 1 to 100. If `discount_type` is `CASH`, provide a float greater than 0.

minimum_purchase_currency.description: Required when `minimum_purchase_type` is `SUBTOTAL`. Minimum purchase currency.

minimum_purchase_value.description: Required when `minimum_purchase_type` is specified. If `minimum_purchase_type` is `QUANTITY`, provide an integer greater than or equal to 0. If `minimum_purchase_type` is `SUBTOTAL`, provide a float greater than 0.

promo_code.description: Promo code. If shoppers must enter a code at checkout, provide it here. For automatically applied offers, omit this field. Length limit: 30 characters, no emoji. Chinese or Japanese words count as two characters; English letters count as one.

valid_end_time.description: Promo code or offer end time in UTC+0, format `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`. Must be later than the current time. If you specify `valid_end_time`, you must also provide `valid_start_time`.

valid_start_time.description: Promo code or offer start time in UTC+0, format `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`.

selling_points.description: List of selling points. Max size: 15. Each selling point must be 1-25 characters and cannot contain emoji. Chinese or Japanese words count as two characters; English letters count as one.

product_info_enabled.description: Product information mode. Defaults to `UNSET`. This field is automatically set to `CATALOG` when campaign `app_promotion_type=MINIS` and `catalog_enabled=true`. This field can only be set to `UNSET` when an Inventory Card portfolio is specified through `card_id` in Upgraded Smart+ Automotive Ads.

product_set_id.description: Required when `product_specific_type` is `PRODUCT_SET`. Product set ID. Retrieve sets with `/catalog/set/get/` or create one with `/catalog/set/create/`.

product_specific_type.description: Required when campaign `catalog_enabled` is `true`. Controls how products are selected. If `ALL`, do not provide `product_set_id` or `product_ids`. If `PRODUCT_SET`, you must provide `product_set_id`. If `CUSTOMIZED_PRODUCTS`, you must provide `product_ids`.

app_tracking_info_list.description: Valid only when campaign `sales_destination=WEB_AND_APP`. Third-party tracking settings. Max size: 4.

app_id.description: Required when `app_tracking_info_list` is specified. App ID for the app type selected: Android when `app_type=APP_ANDROID`, iOS when `app_type=APP_IOS`.

app_type.description: Required when `app_tracking_info_list` is specified. App platform type.

click_tracking_url.description: When `app_type` is specified, provide either `impression_tracking_url` or `click_tracking_url` or both. Click tracking URL for the specified app platform.

impression_tracking_url.description: When `app_type` is specified, provide either `impression_tracking_url` or `click_tracking_url` or both. Impression tracking URL for the specified app platform.

brand_safety_postbid_partner.description: Post-bid third-party brand safety measurement partner.

brand_safety_vast_url.description: Returned when brand_safety_postbid_partner is IAS. The wrapped VAST URL used by the post-bid third-party partner to measure brand safety. You need to get the URL from the measurement partner IAS.

click_tracking_url.description: Click tracking URL from your measurement partner. If the app specified at the ad group level has `partner_id` 44 (TikTok Business SDK) or 49 (TikTok App API), you do not need to pass this field; if you do, it is ignored. If self-attribution is enabled for that app and the partner is not 44 or 49, this field defaults to the app's configured Click Tracking URL and updates are not supported. Check `partner_id` and `self_attribution_enabled` via `/app/list/` or `/app/info/`. Pangle currently does not support DCM, Sizmek, or Flashtalking.

impression_tracking_url.description: Default impression tracking URL from your measurement partner. If the app specified at the ad group level has `partner_id` 44 (TikTok Business SDK) or 49 (TikTok App API), you do not need to pass this field; if you do, it is ignored. If self-attribution is enabled for that app and the partner is not 44 or 49, this field defaults to the app's configured Default Impression Tracking URL and updates are not supported. Check `partner_id` and `self_attribution_enabled` via `/app/list/` or `/app/info/`.

tracking_app_id.description: Valid when campaign `objective_type` is `WEB_CONVERSIONS` or `LEAD_GENERATION`. App ID to track offsite app events. If ad group `app_id` is specified and you want to track offsite app events, `tracking_app_id` must match that same app ID; otherwise you may pass any app ID you want to track. Get app IDs from `/app/list/`.

tracking_message_event_set_id.description: Valid when ad group `promotion_type=LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_SOCIAL_MEDIA_APP_MESSAGE`, `optimization_goal=CLICK`, and `messaging_app_type` is `MESSENGER` or `WHATSAPP`, and `page_list` is not specified at the ad level. Message event set ID used to measure conversation starts in the instant messaging app. Once set, this field cannot be updated. Obtain IDs from `/ctm/message_event_set/get/`.

tracking_offline_event_set_ids.description: Valid only when campaign `objective_type=APP_PROMOTION` and `app_promotion_type` is `APP_INSTALL` or `APP_RETARGETING`. Offline Event Set IDs to track in-person actions. Max size: 50. For a new ad, existing auto-tracking Offline Event Sets must be tracked. If you omit this field, all existing auto-tracking Offline Event Set IDs in the ad account are included automatically. If you provide this field, you must include all existing auto-tracking Offline Event Set IDs; adding non-auto-tracking set IDs is optional. Find existing auto-tracking sets via `/offline/get/` where `auto_tracking=true`.

tracking_pixel_id.description: Valid only when campaign `objective_type=APP_PROMOTION` and `app_promotion_type` is `APP_INSTALL` or `APP_RETARGETING`. Pixel ID for tracking website events. If ad group `pixel_id` is already set, `tracking_pixel_id` must match it. If ad group `pixel_id` is not set, you may specify any pixel ID for website event tracking.

viewability_vast_url.description: Required when viewability_postbid_partner is IAS. The wrapped VAST URL used by the post-bid third-party partner to measure viewability. You need to get the URL from the measurement partner IAS. Note: Post-bid third-party viewability measurement is currently an allowlist-only feature. If you would like to access it, please contact your TikTok representative. When you set both brand_safety_postbid_partner and viewability_postbid_partner as IAS, brand_safety_vast_url should be the same as viewability_vast_url.

utm_params.description: Valid when campaign `objective_type` is `WEB_CONVERSIONS`. List of URL parameters as key-value pairs. Max size: 14. If `landing_page_url` already contains URL parameters, you may also pass `utm_params`, but it must exactly match the parameters used in the URL. The parameters are not automatically appended to `landing_page_url` during delivery.

key.description: URL parameter key. Supported UTM parameters: `utm_source`, `utm_medium`, `utm_content`, `utm_campaign`. UTM parameters are case-sensitive. Length limit for a custom parameter: 100 characters.

value.description: URL parameter value. Can be a custom value or one of these macros: `__CAMPAIGN_NAME__`, `__CAMPAIGN_ID__`, `__AID_NAME__`, `__AID__`, `__CID_NAME__`, `__CID__`, `__PLACEMENT__`. Length limit for a custom value: 600 characters.

ad_name.description: Ad name. To auto-generate the name, set this field to an empty string (`""`); the generated name format is the ad ID (`ad_id`). Length limit: 512 characters, no emojis. Each Chinese or Japanese word counts as two characters; each English letter counts as one.

ad_text_list.description: Required when `tiktok_item_id` is not specified. List of ad texts shown with the ad creative. Max size: 5.

ad_text.description: Required when `ad_text_list` is specified. Ad text shown as part of the creative.

adgroup_id.description: Ad group ID. Obtain valid IDs from `/smart_plus/adgroup/get/`.

auto_message_list.description: Required when ad group `promotion_type` is `LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_TT_DIRECT_MESSAGE`. Automatic message details for TikTok Direct Messaging Ads. Max size: 1.

auto_message_id.description: Required when `auto_message_list` is specified. ID of the automatic message used in a TikTok Direct Messaging Ad. Currently only welcome messages are supported. Use `/creative/auto_message/get/` to list welcome messages or `/creative/auto_message/create/` to create one.

call_to_action_list.description: Call-to-action list. Max size: 3. Not supported in certain TikTok-placement scenarios where you must use `call_to_action_id` instead.

call_to_action.description: Required when `call_to_action_list` is specified. Call-to-action text value. Do not use this field in these scenarios; use `ad_configuration.call_to_action_id` instead: (1) campaign `objective_type=LEAD_GENERATION` and ad group uses TikTok placement (`placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL` with `placements` including `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`, or `placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC`); (2) campaign `objective_type=APP_PROMOTION` or `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, the ad group uses TikTok placement, and `creative_info.identity_type` is `TT_USER`, `BC_AUTH_TT`, or `AUTH_CODE`.

creative_info.description: Creative configuration for this ad variation.

ad_format.description: Ad format. `SINGLE_VIDEO` requires either `video_info.video_id` plus `image_info.web_uri` as the cover, or `tiktok_item_id`. `CAROUSEL_ADS` requires either carousel images in `image_info.web_uri` plus `music_info.music_id`, or a TikTok photo post via `tiktok_item_id`. `CATALOG_CAROUSEL` requires `music_info.music_id` for Upgraded Smart+ Web Catalog Carousel Ads, and requires both `music_info.music_id` and an end card in `image_info.web_uri` for Upgraded Smart+ Automotive Catalog Carousel Ads.

aigc_disclosure_type.description: Valid only when `ad_configuration.identity_type` is `CUSTOMIZED_USER`. Controls whether the ad is labeled as AI-generated when viewed in full. Defaults to `NOT_DECLARED`.

identity_authorized_bc_id.description: Required when `creative_info.identity_type` is `BC_AUTH_TT`. Business Center ID associated with the TikTok Account User in Business Center identity.

identity_id.description: Required when creating Spark Ads without catalog creatives. If creating Spark Ads using catalog creatives from an E-commerce catalog, provide the identity in `ad_configuration` instead.

identity_type.description: Required when creating Spark Ads without catalog creatives. If creating Spark Ads using catalog creatives from an E-commerce catalog, instead provide `identity_type` and `identity_id` in `ad_configuration`. If this field is `TT_USER`, `BC_AUTH_TT`, or `AUTH_CODE`, and campaign `objective_type` is `APP_PROMOTION` or `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, and the ad group uses TikTok placement (`placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL` with `placements` including `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`, or `placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC`), then you must also provide dynamic CTA `call_to_action_id` in `ad_configuration`.

image_info.description: Required for: non-Spark Single Video ads and Spark Single Video ads through Spark Ads Push as the video cover; non-Spark Standard Carousel ads and Spark Standard Carousel ads through Spark Ads Push as 1-35 carousel images; and Catalog Carousel ads in Upgraded Smart+ Automotive Ads as one end card image. Not supported for Catalog Carousel ads in Upgraded Smart+ Web Ads.

web_uri.description: Required when `image_info` is specified. Image ID. Upload images with `/file/image/ad/upload/` or search existing images with `/file/image/ad/search/`.

music_info.description: Required when creating Standard Carousel Ads, including non-Spark Standard Carousel ads, Spark Standard Carousel ads through Spark Ads Push, and Spark Standard Carousel ads through Spark Ads Pull. Also required when campaign `objective_type` is `WEB_CONVERSIONS` or `LEAD_GENERATION` and `catalog_creative_toggle` is `true`, because the system automatically generates catalog carousel ads.

music_id.description: Required when `music_info` is specified. ID of the music used in carousel ads.

tiktok_item_id.description: Required for Spark Ads created through Spark Ads Pull: use a TikTok video post for Spark Single Video ads or a TikTok photo post for Spark Standard Carousel ads. Not supported when `catalog_creative_toggle` is `true`. Pass the `item_id` returned by `/tt_video/info/` or `/identity/video/get/`. When you provide `tiktok_item_id`, you do not need to provide `image_info`, `video_info`, or `title_list`. By using Spark Ads, you confirm you have commercial rights to use the music in the videos.

video_info.description: Required for non-Spark Single Video ads and Spark Single Video ads created through Spark Ads Push.

video_id.description: Required when `video_info` is specified. Video ID. Upload videos with `/file/video/ad/upload/` or search existing videos with `/file/video/ad/search/`.

custom_product_page_list.description: Custom product page details. Valid only for iOS app retargeting campaigns as documented. Size range: 0-1.

custom_product_page_url.description: Custom Product Page (CPP) URL. Valid only when campaign `objective_type` is `APP_PROMOTION`, `app_promotion_type` is `APP_RETARGETING`, and an iOS `app_id` is set at the ad group level. The URL must match that promoted app. Only users on iOS 15+ can open a CPP. Format: `https://apps.apple.com/{region}/app/{app_name}/id{app_id}?ppid={ppid}`. Length limit: 512 characters.

deeplink.description: Deeplink destination for users who have the app installed.

deeplink_type.description: Required when `deeplink` is specified. If you pass this field, also provide `deeplink`.

disclaimer.description: Disclaimer information. Valid only when campaign `objective_type` is `APP_PROMOTION` or `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, or when campaign `objective_type` is `LEAD_GENERATION` and `catalog_enabled` is `false` or omitted; and the ad group includes TikTok placement either by leaving placement fields unspecified for automatic placement or by setting `placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL` and including `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK` in `placements`. Once added to the ad, the disclaimer cannot be deleted.

disclaimer_clickable_texts.description: Required when `disclaimer_type` is `TEXT_LINK`. Clickable disclaimer entries. Max size: 3. If you use multiple clickable disclaimers, both the total combined text length and each individual text length must be no more than 40 characters.

text.description: Required when `disclaimer_clickable_texts` is specified. Disclaimer text. Length limit: 40 characters.

url.description: Required when `disclaimer_clickable_texts` is specified. URL opened when users tap the disclaimer text.

text.description: Required when `disclaimer_text` is specified. Disclaimer text. Length limit: 90 characters.

disclaimer_type.description: Required when `disclaimer` is specified. Disclaimer type. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

interactive_add_on_list.description: List of interactive add-on (creative portfolio) IDs. Size range: 0-1.

card_id.description: ID of an interactive add-on creative portfolio. Supported portfolio types: Display Card, Countdown Sticker, Gift Code Sticker, or Inventory Card for Upgraded Smart+ Automotive Ads. Create portfolios with `/creative/portfolio/create/`.

landing_page_url_list.description: Landing page URL list. Size range: 0-1.

landing_page_url.description: Required when `landing_page_url_list` is specified. Landing page URL.

operation_status.description: Status to apply when the ad is created. Defaults to `ENABLE`.

fields.description: Fields to return. If omitted, all fields are returned by default. Allowed values are the response fields under `list` and under `ad_configuration`, except `advertiser_id` and `smart_plus_ad_id`, which are returned by default.

adgroup_ids.description: Filter by ad group IDs. Max size: 100.

campaign_ids.description: Filter by campaign IDs. Max size: 100.

creation_filter_end_time.description: Latest ad creation time to include, in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` (UTC). Returns ads created before this time. Example: `2025-02-01 00:00:01`. If both `creation_filter_start_time` and `creation_filter_end_time` are omitted, ads created at any time are included. For task efficiency and speed, consider setting a creation-time range within six months.

creation_filter_start_time.description: Earliest ad creation time to include, in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` (UTC). Returns ads created after this time. Example: `2025-01-01 00:00:01`. If both `creation_filter_start_time` and `creation_filter_end_time` are omitted, ads created at any time are included. For task efficiency and speed, consider setting a creation-time range within six months.

modified_after.description: Latest ad modification time lower bound, in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` (UTC). Returns ads last modified after this time. For task efficiency and speed, consider setting a time range within six months for the creation time filters.

objective_type.description: Filter by advertising objective. Supported values for this endpoint are `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, and `LEAD_GENERATION`.

sales_destination.description: Sales destination to drive toward. `WEBSITE` drives sales on your website. `APP` drives sales in your app and requires a product catalog. `WEB_AND_APP` drives sales on both your website and app.

secondary_status.description: Filter by ad secondary status. Includes the following Upgraded Smart+ statuses: `AD_STATUS_DELIVERY_AND_REAUDIT` (review of modifications in progress), `AD_STATUS_DELIVERY_AND_TRANSCODING_FAIL` (video transcoding failed), `AD_STATUS_REVIEW_PARTIALLY_APPROVED` (ad is partially reviewed and delivering), `AD_STATUS_COLLECTION_TOGGLED_OFF` (lead collection has ended), `AD_STATUS_PRIVACY_POLICY_REJECTED` (rejected due to privacy policy violations), and `AD_STATUS_PRIVACY_POLICY_AUDIT` (in privacy policy review).

smart_plus_ad_ids.description: Filter by ad IDs. Max size: 100.

page.description: Current page number. Value range: greater than or equal to 1. Default: 1.

page_size.description: Page size. Value range: 1 to 100. Default: 10.
