operation_status.description: Operation to perform on the specified ads. Allowed values: `DISABLE` (pause), `ENABLE` (enable), `DELETE` (delete). Deleted ads, or ads in deleted campaigns or deleted ad groups, cannot be modified.

smart_plus_ad_ids.description: List of Upgraded Smart+ Ad IDs to update. Maximum 20 IDs per request. To obtain valid ad IDs, use /smart_plus/ad/get/.

auto_disclaimer_types.description: Valid only when campaign `objective_type` is `LEAD_GENERATION`, campaign `catalog_enabled` is `true`, the ad group specifies an Auto-Model catalog through `catalog_id`, and ad-level `catalog_creative_toggle` is `true`. Max size: 1. Before using `EMISSION`, each vehicle must include `emission_disclaimer`, `emission_disclaimer_url`, `emission_overlay_disclaimer`, and `emission_image_link`. Before using `DISCOUNT`, each vehicle must include `offer_disclaimer` and `offer_disclaimer_url`.

call_to_action_id.description: Dynamic CTA portfolio ID. Required when either: 1) campaign `objective_type` is `LEAD_GENERATION` and the ad group uses `PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC` or `PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL` with `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`; or 2) campaign `objective_type` is `APP_PROMOTION` or `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, the ad group uses `PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC` or `PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL` with `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`, and ad-level `creative_info.identity_type` is `TT_USER`, `BC_AUTH_TT`, or `AUTH_CODE`.

catalog_creative_info.description: Additional settings for catalog creatives. Valid only when the ad is an Upgraded Smart+ E-commerce Catalog Ad and `catalog_creative_toggle` is `true`.

catalog_media_settings.description: Creative types from the E-commerce catalog to use. If `TEMPLATE_VIDEO` is included, you may optionally provide `catalog_template_video_id`. If `catalog_template_video_id` is omitted, all catalog video templates and video URLs are used; if provided, the selected template is used. If `catalog_media_settings` was specified during ad creation, you cannot later update `catalog_creative_toggle` to `false` or update `catalog_media_settings` to an empty list.

catalog_template_video_id.description: Valid only when `TEMPLATE_VIDEO` is included in `catalog_media_settings`. Video template ID from the catalog.

catalog_creative_toggle.description: Valid only when campaign `catalog_enabled` is `true`. Whether to auto-select creatives from the catalog. If `true` for Upgraded Smart+ Web Ads using catalog carousel format, you must provide `creative_info` containing only `music_info`. If `true` for Upgraded Smart+ Automotive Ads using catalog carousel format, you must provide `creative_info` containing one image in `image_info` and `music_info` for the end card image and music.

creative_auto_add_toggle.description: Valid only when either: 1) campaign `objective_type` is `WEB_CONVERSIONS` and `sales_destination` is `WEBSITE`; or 2) campaign `objective_type` is `LEAD_GENERATION` and ad group `promotion_type` is `LEAD_GENERATION` with `promotion_target_type` equal to `INSTANT_PAGE` or `EXTERNAL_WEBSITE`. When `true`, newly generated assets can be auto-added during delivery. Supported values: `true`, `false`.

creative_auto_enhancement_strategy_list.description: Automatic enhancement strategies to apply during delivery. Once an ad group is created, `TRANSLATE_AND_DUB` cannot be changed: you cannot add it if initially excluded, or remove it if initially included. `IMAGE_QUALITY` and `IMAGE_RESIZE` only take effect when the ad contains image creatives.

dark_post_status.description: Valid only when creating Spark Ads through Spark Ads Push. Controls ads-only mode for creatives. `OFF` is allowed only if both the identity's ads-only mode is disabled and the ad account does not enforce mandatory ads-only mode. If the ad account enforces mandatory ads-only mode, you can set only `ON`. Mandatory ads-only mode for an ad account is an allowlist-only feature.

deeplink_utm_params.description: Valid only when campaign `objective_type` is `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, campaign `sales_destination` is `APP`, ad-level `deeplink` is specified, and `deeplink_type` is `DEFERRED_DEEPLINK`. Max size: 14. This is an allowlist-only feature.

key.description: Deeplink URL parameter key. Can be a custom parameter or one of the supported UTM parameters `utm_source`, `utm_medium`, `utm_content`, or `utm_campaign`. UTM parameters are case-sensitive. Custom key max length: 100 characters.

value.description: Deeplink URL parameter value. Can be a custom value or one of the macros `__CAMPAIGN_NAME__`, `__CAMPAIGN_ID__`, `__AID_NAME__`, `__AID__`, `__CID_NAME__`, `__CID__`, or `__PLACEMENT__`. Custom value max length: 600 characters.

end_card_cta.description: Valid when campaign `objective_type` is `LEAD_GENERATION`, campaign `catalog_enabled` is `true`, the ad group specifies an Auto-Inventory or Auto-Model catalog through `catalog_id`, and ad-level `catalog_creative_toggle` is `true`. CTA for the end card in supported automotive carousel or catalog direct messaging scenarios. `SEND_MESSAGE` is available only for the catalog solution for Upgraded Smart+ TikTok Direct Messaging Ads.

identity_authorized_bc_id.description: Required when `ad_configuration.identity_type` is `BC_AUTH_TT`. Business Center ID associated with the TikTok Account User in Business Center identity.

identity_id.description: Identity ID. Valid for non-Spark Ads on non-TikTok placements or Spark Ads using catalog creatives from an E-commerce catalog.

identity_type.description: Valid for non-Spark Ads on non-TikTok placements, or for Spark Ads using catalog creatives from an E-commerce catalog. Non-Spark Ads on TikTok placement are no longer supported. For non-Spark Ads on non-TikTok placements, the only supported value is `CUSTOMIZED_USER`. For Upgraded Smart+ E-commerce Catalog Spark Ads with `catalog_creative_toggle=true`, supported values are `TT_USER` and `BC_AUTH_TT`.

product_ids.description: Required when `product_specific_type` is `CUSTOMIZED_PRODUCTS`. Catalog product IDs. Max size: 20.

product_info.description: Product information used to create personalized ad variations and improve performance. All fields are optional; more detail can improve generated variations. Full-replacement update mode: if you update any field inside `product_info`, you must resubmit the entire `product_info` object. Updating `product_info` causes the ad to be reviewed again.

catalog_tag_list.description: Catalog product information tags. In scenario 1, when campaign `objective_type` is `WEB_CONVERSIONS` and `catalog_type` is `ECOMMERCE`, supported values are `PRICE`, `STRIKETHROUGH_PRICE`, `DISCOUNT`, and `FREE_SHIPPING`; default is `["PRICE","STRIKETHROUGH_PRICE","DISCOUNT","FREE_SHIPPING"]`, max size 4. In scenario 2, when campaign `objective_type` is `LEAD_GENERATION`, campaign `catalog_enabled` is `true`, and the ad group specifies an Auto-Inventory catalog through `catalog_id`, supported values are `DEALER_NAME`, `CURRENT_MILEAGE`, `LEAD_PRICE`, `LEAD_SALE_PRICE`, `EXTERIOR_COLOR`, `TRIM`, `ADDRESS_CITY`, and `VEHICLE_STATE`; max 2 primary tags (`DEALER_NAME`, `CURRENT_MILEAGE`, `EXTERIOR_COLOR`, `TRIM`, `ADDRESS_CITY`, `VEHICLE_STATE`) and 2 secondary tags (`LEAD_PRICE`, `LEAD_SALE_PRICE`).

product_card_type.description: The product card display type. Enum values: PRODUCT_CARD: Product Card. PRODUCT_TILE: Product Tiles. PRODUCT_INFO_CARD: Info Card. PRODUCT_SHOWCASE_TILE: Showcase Tiles. ANCHOR: Anchor. CAROUSEL_LABEL: Carousel label.

product_image_list.description: List of product images. Size range: 0-10. If omitted, a generic image is used so the image is not blank.

web_uri.description: Image ID for a product image. Supported formats: .jpg, .png, .jpeg, .webp. File size up to 5 MB. Recommended resolution: 800 x 800 pixels.

product_titles.description: List of product names. Size range: 0-1. Each product name must be at most 40 characters and cannot contain emoji. Each Chinese or Japanese word counts as two characters, and each English letter counts as one. If omitted, a default product name is used so the name is not blank.

promo_info_list.description: Details of promo codes and offers. Valid only for regular Upgraded Smart+ Web Campaigns. Max size: 10. Full-replacement update mode: if you update any field inside `promo_info_list`, you must resubmit the complete list. Updating this field triggers ad review again.

discount_currency.description: Required when `discount_type` is `CASH`. Currency code for the discount.

discount_type.description: Required when `promo_info_list` is specified. Discount type.

discount_value.description: Required when `promo_info_list` is specified. Discount value. When `discount_type` is `PERCENTAGE`, provide an integer from 1 to 100. When `discount_type` is `CASH`, provide a float greater than 0.

minimum_purchase_currency.description: Required when `minimum_purchase_type` is `SUBTOTAL`. Currency code for the minimum purchase subtotal.

minimum_purchase_value.description: Required when minimum_purchase_type is specified. Minimum purchase value. When minimum_purchase_type is QUANTITY, specify an integer that is 0 or greater. When minimum_purchase_type is SUBTOTAL, specify a float greater than 0.

promo_code.description: Promo code. If shoppers must enter a code at checkout, provide it here. For automatically applied offers, omit this field. Max length 30 characters; cannot contain emoji. TikTok-exclusive promo codes often perform best.

valid_end_time.description: Promo or offer valid end time in UTC+0, format `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`. Must be later than the current time. If you provide `valid_end_time`, you must also provide `valid_start_time`.

valid_start_time.description: Promo or offer valid start time in UTC+0, format `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`.

selling_points.description: List of selling points. Max size: 15. Each item must be 1-25 characters and cannot contain emoji. Each Chinese or Japanese word counts as two characters, and each English letter counts as one.

product_info_enabled.description: Product information mode. Automatically becomes `CATALOG` when campaign `app_promotion_type` is `MINIS` and campaign `catalog_enabled` is `true`. Can be set to `UNSET` only when an Inventory Card portfolio is specified through `card_id` in Upgraded Smart+ Automotive Ads.

product_set_id.description: Required when `product_specific_type` is `PRODUCT_SET`. Product set ID.

product_specific_type.description: Valid when campaign `catalog_enabled` is `true`. Determines how products are selected. If `ALL`, do not provide `product_set_id` or `product_ids`. If `PRODUCT_SET`, `product_set_id` is required. If `CUSTOMIZED_PRODUCTS`, `product_ids` is required.

brand_safety_postbid_partner.description: Post-bid third-party brand safety measurement partner. Enum values: DOUBLE_VERIFY, IAS, ZEFR. You can only update this field for the created ad before the ad passes the review and becomes active.

brand_safety_vast_url.description: Required when brand_safety_postbid_partner is IAS. The wrapped VAST URL used by the post-bid third-party partner to measure brand safety. You need to get the URL from the measurement partner IAS. You can only update this field for the created ad before the ad passes the review and becomes active. Note: Post-bid third-party brand safety measurement is currently an allowlist-only feature. If you would like to access it, please contact your TikTok representative. When you set both brand_safety_postbid_partner and viewability_postbid_partner as IAS, brand_safety_vast_url should be the same as viewability_vast_url.

click_tracking_url.description: Click tracking URL from your data partner. If the app specified at the ad group level has partner ID `44` (TikTok Business SDK) or `49` (TikTok App API), you do not need to provide this field and any provided value is ignored. If self-attribution is enabled for the app and the partner ID is not `44` or `49`, this field defaults to the app's configured click tracking URL and updates are not supported. Pangle does not support DCM, Sizmek, or Flashtalking.

impression_tracking_url.description: Default impression tracking URL from your data partner. If the app specified at the ad group level has partner ID `44` (TikTok Business SDK) or `49` (TikTok App API), you do not need to provide this field and any provided value is ignored. If self-attribution is enabled for the app and the partner ID is not `44` or `49`, this field defaults to the app's configured default impression tracking URL and updates are not supported.

tracking_app_id.description: Valid when campaign `objective_type` is `WEB_CONVERSIONS`. App ID to track for offsite app events. If ad-group `app_id` is specified and you want to track offsite app events, this value must match that app ID; otherwise you may provide any app ID to track.

tracking_offline_event_set_ids.description: Valid only when campaign `objective_type` is `APP_PROMOTION` and campaign `app_promotion_type` is `APP_INSTALL` or `APP_RETARGETING`. Offline Event Set IDs for in-person event tracking. Max size: 50. For a new ad, existing auto-tracking Offline Event Sets must be tracked. If omitted, all existing auto-tracking Offline Event Set IDs in the ad account are automatically included. If provided, you must include all existing auto-tracking Offline Event Set IDs; adding non-auto-tracking set IDs is optional.

tracking_pixel_id.description: Valid only when campaign `objective_type` is `APP_PROMOTION` and campaign `app_promotion_type` is `APP_INSTALL` or `APP_RETARGETING`. Pixel ID for tracking website events. If ad-group `pixel_id` is already set, `tracking_pixel_id` must match it; otherwise any pixel ID may be used for website event tracking.

viewability_vast_url.description: Returned when viewability_postbid_partner is IAS. The wrapped VAST URL used by the post-bid third-party partner to measure viewability. You need to get the URL from the measurement partner IAS.

utm_params.description: Valid when campaign `objective_type` is `WEB_CONVERSIONS`. Max size: 14. If `landing_page_url` already contains URL parameters, you may also pass `utm_params`, but it must exactly match the parameters already used in the URL. These parameters are stored only and are not automatically appended during delivery.

key.description: URL parameter key. Supported UTM parameters: `utm_source`, `utm_medium`, `utm_content`, `utm_campaign`. UTM parameters are case-sensitive. Custom key max length: 100 characters.

value.description: URL parameter value. Can be a custom value or one of the macros `__CAMPAIGN_NAME__`, `__CAMPAIGN_ID__`, `__AID_NAME__`, `__AID__`, `__CID_NAME__`, `__CID__`, or `__PLACEMENT__`. Custom value max length: 600 characters.

ad_name.description: Ad name. Max length 512 characters; cannot contain emojis. Each Chinese or Japanese word counts as two characters, and each English letter counts as one.

ad_text_list.description: List of ad texts shown as part of the creatives. Max size: 5.

ad_text.description: Required when `ad_text_list` is specified. Ad text.

call_to_action_list.description: List of call-to-actions. Max size: 3. In TikTok placement scenarios described above, this field is unsupported and you must use `ad_configuration.call_to_action_id` instead.

call_to_action.description: Required when `call_to_action_list` is specified. CTA text. This field is not supported when the campaign objective is `LEAD_GENERATION` and the ad group uses `PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC` or `PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL` with `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`; use `ad_configuration.call_to_action_id` instead. It is also not supported when the campaign objective is `APP_PROMOTION` or `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, the ad group uses `PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC` or `PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL` with `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`, and `creative_info.identity_type` is `TT_USER`, `BC_AUTH_TT`, or `AUTH_CODE`; in that case use `ad_configuration.call_to_action_id` instead.

creative_list.description: List of creatives. Size range: 1-50. Full-replacement update mode: if you update any field inside `creative_list`, you must resubmit the complete `creative_list` value.

ad_material_id.description: The ad-specific material ID of an existing creative. The ID is generated when a particular creative is used in an ad and differs from the creative ID you receive when uploading the creative to your ad account’s Creative Library. When you provide this field, the API preserves your existing creative throughout the update and prevents the creation of a new one. Using ad_material_id to update your Upgraded Smart+ Ads helps you streamline non-creative ad modifications and saves you the effort of re-entering all the creative_info parameters. Note: Using ad_material_id to update Upgraded Smart+ Ads is currently an allowlist-only feature. If you would like to access it, please contact your TikTok representative. When both creative_info and ad_material_id are specified, creative_info will be ignored.

ad_format.description: Ad format. `SINGLE_VIDEO` requires either `video_info.video_id` plus `image_info.web_uri` for the video cover, or `tiktok_item_id` for a TikTok video post. `CAROUSEL_ADS` requires either carousel images through `image_info.web_uri` plus `music_info.music_id`, or `tiktok_item_id` for TikTok photo posts. `CATALOG_CAROUSEL` requires `music_info.music_id`; for Upgraded Smart+ Automotive Catalog Carousel Ads it also requires an end card through `image_info.web_uri`.

aigc_disclosure_type.description: Valid only when `ad_configuration.identity_type` is `CUSTOMIZED_USER`. Controls whether the ad is self-disclosed as AI-generated content. `SELF_DISCLOSURE` turns on the toggle and shows an advertiser AI-generated label in full view; `NOT_DECLARED` does not declare AI-generated content.

identity_authorized_bc_id.description: Required when `creative_info.identity_type` is `BC_AUTH_TT`. Business Center ID associated with the TikTok Account User in Business Center identity.

identity_id.description: Identity ID. Valid when creating Spark Ads without catalog creatives. If using catalog creatives from an E-commerce catalog, set `identity_type` and `identity_id` in `ad_configuration` instead.

identity_type.description: Valid when creating Spark Ads without catalog creatives. If using catalog creatives from an E-commerce catalog, set `identity_type` and `identity_id` in `ad_configuration` instead. If this field is `TT_USER`, `BC_AUTH_TT`, or `AUTH_CODE`, and the campaign objective is `APP_PROMOTION` or `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, and the ad group uses `PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC` or `PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL` with `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`, then you must also provide dynamic CTA `ad_configuration.call_to_action_id`.

web_uri.description: Required when `image_info` is specified. Image ID.

music_id.description: Required when `music_info` is specified. ID of the music to use in carousel ads.

tiktok_item_id.description: TikTok post ID to use as a Spark Ad. Pass the `item_id` returned by `/tt_video/info/` or `/identity/video/get/`. When you provide `tiktok_item_id`, you do not need to provide `image_info`, `video_info`, or `title_list`. By using Spark Ads, you confirm you have rights to use the music in the videos for commercial purposes.

video_id.description: Required when `video_info` is specified. Video ID.

custom_product_page_list.description: Details of the custom product page to use in the ad. Valid only for APP_RETARGETING campaigns with an iOS app. Size range: 0-1.

custom_product_page_url.description: Custom Product Page URL. Valid only when campaign `objective_type` is `APP_PROMOTION`, campaign `app_promotion_type` is `APP_RETARGETING`, and an iOS app is specified through ad-group `app_id`. The URL must match the promoted app at the ad group level. Only users with iOS 15+ can open a custom product page. Format: `https://apps.apple.com/{region}/app/{app_name}/id{app_id}?ppid={ppid}`. Max length 512.

deeplink.description: Deeplink destination to open when the audience has your app installed.

deeplink_type.description: Deeplink type. If you provide `deeplink_type`, you should also provide `deeplink`.

disclaimer.description: Disclaimer information. Valid only when the campaign objective is `APP_PROMOTION` or `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, or `LEAD_GENERATION` with `catalog_enabled=false` or omitted, and the ad group includes TikTok placement either through automatic placement or `PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL` with `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`. You cannot remove a disclaimer added at creation, and you cannot change `disclaimer_type` between `TEXT_ONLY` and `TEXT_LINK` after it exists. You can only add a disclaimer to an ad that does not already have one, or update the existing disclaimer text and URL where applicable.

disclaimer_clickable_texts.description: Required when `disclaimer_type` is `TEXT_LINK`. Clickable disclaimer entries. Max size: 3. If multiple clickable disclaimers are used, both the total length of all texts and the length of each individual text must be no more than 40 characters.

text.description: Required when `disclaimer_clickable_texts` is specified. Clickable disclaimer text. Max length: 40 characters.

url.description: Required when `disclaimer_clickable_texts` is specified. URL opened when the disclaimer text is tapped.

text.description: Required when `disclaimer_text` is specified. Disclaimer text. Max length: 90 characters.

disclaimer_type.description: Required when `disclaimer` is specified. Disclaimer type. `TEXT_ONLY` requires `disclaimer_text`; `TEXT_LINK` requires `disclaimer_clickable_texts`.

interactive_add_on_list.description: List of interactive add-on (creative portfolio) IDs. Size range: 0-1.

card_id.description: ID of an interactive add-on creative portfolio. Supported portfolio types: Display Card, Countdown Sticker, Gift Code Sticker, or Inventory Card for Upgraded Smart+ Automotive Ads.

landing_page_url_list.description: Landing page URL list. Size range: 0-1.

landing_page_url.description: Required when `landing_page_url_list` is specified. Landing page URL.

playable_list.description: Valid only in any of the following scenarios: Scenario 1: At the campaign level, objective_type is APP_PROMOTION. At the ad group level, the placement is not Global Apple Bundle-only (with placement_type as PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL and placements as ["PLACEMENT_GLOBAL_APP_BUNDLE"]) . At the ad level, ad_format is SINGLE_VIDEO and a video or video post is specified. Scenario 2: At the campaign level, objective_type is APP_INSTALL. At the ad group level: promotion_type is MINI_GAME. The placement is not Global Apple Bundle-only (with placement_type as PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL and placements as ["PLACEMENT_GLOBAL_APP_BUNDLE"]) . At the ad level, ad_format is SINGLE_VIDEO and a video or video post is specified. The list of playables. Max size: 5.

playable_url.description: The URL of the playable. To upload playables to the Creative Library of your ad account and obtain the playable URLs, see Upload playables. To obtain the URLs of existing playables within your ad account, use /playable/get/.

adgroup_name.description: Ad group name. Maximum 512 characters. Emojis are not supported.

app_config.description: Required when campaign `sales_destination` is `WEB_AND_APP`. App configuration for up to 2 apps. You can provide an Android app, an iOS app, or one of each. Maximum size: 2.

app_id.description: Required when `app_config` is specified. App ID of an app to promote.

Required when both conditions are met: at the campaign level, (`objective_type` is `APP_PROMOTION` and `app_promotion_type` is `APP_INSTALL` or `APP_RETARGETING`) or (`objective_type` is `WEB_CONVERSIONS` and `sales_destination` is `APP`); and `campaign_type` is `REGULAR_CAMPAIGN`. App ID of the app to promote. You cannot use an app that has not activated the SAN module on your MMP.

attribution_event_count.description: Event count / statistic type. If you omit `click_attribution_window`, `engaged_view_attribution_window`, `view_attribution_window`, and `attribution_event_count`, default settings, if any, are used; you can confirm defaults via `/smart_plus/adgroup/get/`. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

bid_price.description: Required when `optimization_goal` is `CLICK` and `bid_type` is `BID_TYPE_CUSTOM`. Target cost per click. Must be lower than budget. When CBO is enabled (`budget_optimize_on=true`) at the campaign level, this setting, if specified, must be the same across all ad groups in the same campaign.

bid_type.description: Bidding strategy. `BID_TYPE_NO_BID` is Maximum Delivery. `BID_TYPE_CUSTOM` is Cost Cap / Target CPA and can only be used when campaign-level or ad-group-level `budget_mode` is `BUDGET_MODE_DYNAMIC_DAILY_BUDGET`. This setting, if specified, must be the same across all ad groups in the same campaign.

billing_event.description: Billing event. Currently only `OCPM` and `CPC` are supported. When `optimization_goal` is `CLICK`, set this to `CPC`. When `optimization_goal` is not `CLICK`, set this to `OCPM`. When CBO is enabled (`budget_optimize_on=true`) at the campaign level, this setting must be the same across all ad groups in the same campaign.

budget.description: Required when campaign CBO is disabled (`budget_optimize_on=false`) and ignored when CBO is enabled (`budget_optimize_on=true`). If `budget_auto_adjust_strategy=UNSET`, this is the fixed ad-group budget. If `budget_auto_adjust_strategy=AUTO_BUDGET_INCREASE`, this is the initial ad-group budget.

budget_auto_adjust_strategy.description: Valid only when campaign `budget_optimize_on` is `false` and, at the ad group level, either: for `APP_PROMOTION`, `budget_mode` is `BUDGET_MODE_DYNAMIC_DAILY_BUDGET`, `optimization_goal` is `VALUE`, `deep_bid_type` is `VO_MIN_ROAS`, and `vbo_window` is `ZERO_DAY`; or for `LEAD_GENERATION`, `budget_mode` is `BUDGET_MODE_DYNAMIC_DAILY_BUDGET` and `bid_type` is `BID_TYPE_CUSTOM`. `AUTO_BUDGET_INCREASE` enables Goal-based budget increase: the provided `budget` becomes the initial daily budget, and it may automatically increase by 20%, up to 10 times per day, when utilization reaches 90% or more, then reset to the original daily budget each day. `UNSET` disables this behavior. This feature is allowlist-only.

budget_mode.description: Required when campaign CBO is disabled (`budget_optimize_on=false`) and ignored when CBO is enabled (`budget_optimize_on=true`). Ad-group budget mode. If `BUDGET_MODE_TOTAL`, then `schedule_type` must be `SCHEDULE_START_END`, which requires `schedule_end_time`. When campaign-level `budget_optimize_on` is `false` and campaign `budget_mode` is `BUDGET_MODE_DAY`, you can only set this field to `BUDGET_MODE_DYNAMIC_DAILY_BUDGET`. This setting, if specified, must be the same across all ad groups in the same campaign.

campaign_id.description: ID of the campaign that this ad group belongs to.

catalog_authorized_bc_id.description: Required when `catalog_enabled` is `true`. Business Center ID that owns `catalog_id`.

catalog_id.description: Required when `catalog_enabled` is `true` at the campaign level. Catalog ID to use in the ad group.

click_attribution_window.description: Click-through attribution window. If you manually configure attribution windows, you must pass at least `click_attribution_window` and `view_attribution_window` together, and may optionally include `engaged_view_attribution_window`; if `engaged_view_attribution_window` is passed, it must be accompanied by both `click_attribution_window` and `view_attribution_window`. `THIRTY_DAYS` is valid only when `promotion_type` is `MINI_GAME`. `THIRTY_TWO_DAYS` and `ONE_HUNDRED_EIGHTY_DAYS` are valid only when `promotion_type` is `MINI_APP` and `optimization_event` is `ACTIVE_PAY`. If you omit `click_attribution_window`, `engaged_view_attribution_window`, `view_attribution_window`, and `attribution_event_count`, default settings, if any, are used; you can confirm defaults via `/smart_plus/adgroup/get/`. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

comment_disabled.description: Whether to disable comments on TikTok. Default is `false`.

conversion_bid_price.description: Required when `optimization_goal` is `CONVERT`, `TRAFFIC_LANDING_PAGE_VIEW`, `INSTALL`, or `IN_APP_EVENT`, and `bid_type` is `BID_TYPE_CUSTOM`. Target cost per conversion or landing page view. Must be lower than budget. When CBO is enabled (`budget_optimize_on=true`) at the campaign level, this setting, if specified, must be the same across all ad groups in the same campaign.

custom_conversion_id.description: Custom Conversion ID to use in the ad group. Valid only when either `pixel_id` or `app_id` is specified, a Custom Conversion exists for that source, `optimization_goal` is `CONVERT` or `IN_APP_EVENT`, `optimization_event` is specified and matches the Standard Event associated with the Custom Conversion, and the Custom Conversion status is Active or No recent activity.

dayparting.description: Delivery schedule string of 48 × 7 characters, one per 30-minute slot from Monday through Sunday. `1` means deliver and `0` means do not deliver. An all-1 value or omitting this field means full-time delivery.

deep_bid_type.description: Required when `optimization_goal` is `VALUE`. Bidding strategy for in-app events. `VO_MIN_ROAS` can only be used when campaign-level or ad-group-level `budget_mode` is `BUDGET_MODE_DYNAMIC_DAILY_BUDGET`. This setting, if specified, must be the same across all ad groups in the same campaign.

deep_funnel_event_source.description: Required when `deep_funnel_optimization_status` is `ON`. Event source type for deep funnel optimization.

deep_funnel_event_source_id.description: Required when `deep_funnel_optimization_status` is `ON`. Source ID corresponding to `deep_funnel_event_source`: when `PIXEL`, provide a Pixel ID; when `OFFLINE`, provide an Offline Event Set ID; when `CRM`, provide a CRM Event Set ID.

deep_funnel_optimization_event.description: Required when `deep_funnel_optimization_status` is `ON`. Deep funnel optimization event, for example `SHOPPING`.

deep_funnel_optimization_status.description: Valid only when `promotion_type` is `LEAD_GENERATION`. Enables or disables deep funnel optimization, which optimizes both primary and deeper-funnel events. Default is `OFF`. Deep funnel optimization with CRM events is allowlist-only; Pixel and Offline event sources are generally available.

engaged_view_attribution_window.description: Engaged view-through attribution window. Default is `OFF`. If you manually configure attribution windows, you must pass at least `click_attribution_window` and `view_attribution_window` together, and may optionally include this field; if this field is passed, it must be accompanied by both `click_attribution_window` and `view_attribution_window`. `FOURTEEN_DAYS` and `TWENTY_EIGHT_DAYS` are valid only in Upgraded Smart+ Ads with Website and App Optimization. If you omit `click_attribution_window`, `engaged_view_attribution_window`, `view_attribution_window`, and `attribution_event_count`, default settings, if any, are used; you can confirm defaults via `/smart_plus/adgroup/get/`. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

gaming_ad_compliance_agreement.description: Valid when campaign `objective_type` is `APP_PROMOTION` and either `app_promotion_type` is `APP_RETARGETING`, or `app_promotion_type` is `APP_INSTALL` with `campaign_type` `REGULAR_CAMPAIGN`. Whether to agree to the Compliance Assurance Policy for Gaming Advertisers on TikTok. Default is `OFF`. This is currently an allowlist-only feature.

identity_authorized_bc_id.description: Required when `identity_type` is `BC_AUTH_TT`. Business Center ID associated with the TikTok Account User in Business Center identity. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

identity_id.description: Valid only when `promotion_type` is `NATIVE_SERIES`, or when `promotion_type` is `LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_TT_DIRECT_MESSAGE` and the ad account is allowlisted for ad-group-level TikTok account selection in TikTok Direct Messaging Ads. TikTok account identity ID used for the Series host/manager or for direct messaging ads. Selecting a TikTok account at the ad group level for direct messaging ads is allowlist-only. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

identity_type.description: Valid only when `promotion_type` is `NATIVE_SERIES`, or when `promotion_type` is `LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_TT_DIRECT_MESSAGE` and the ad account is allowlisted for ad-group-level TikTok account selection in TikTok Direct Messaging Ads. Identity type for the TikTok account. Selecting a TikTok account at the ad group level for direct messaging ads is allowlist-only. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

is_hfss.description: Valid only when `targeting_optimization_mode` is `MANUAL`. Whether the promoted content is HFSS (High Fat, Salt, Sugar). In regulated regions, HFSS ads must target users aged 18 or over. Can be set to `true` when targeting includes the UK, Australia, New Zealand, or the European Union. Default is `false`.

is_lhf_compliance.description: Required and must be `true` when targeted locations include the UK and `is_hfss` is `true`. Confirms compliance with UK Less Healthy Foods regulations. Default is `false`.

message_event_set_id.description: Required when `promotion_type` is `LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_SOCIAL_MEDIA_APP_MESSAGE`, `optimization_goal` is `CONVERSATION`, and the messaging account configured in the ad group does not match any existing message event set. If the messaging account selected via `messaging_app_account_id` or derived from `phone_info` already matches a unique existing event set, this field is ignored and automatically populated. If `/ctm/message_event_set/get/` returns an empty `matched_event_set`, use that endpoint's `message_event_set_list` to choose a value. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

messaging_app_account_id.description: Required when `messaging_app_type` is `MESSENGER` or `LINE`, or when `messaging_app_type` is `ZALO` and `zalo_id_type` is `ZALO_OFFICIAL_ACCOUNT`. For `MESSENGER`, provide a Facebook Page ID. For `LINE`, provide a LINE Business ID. For `ZALO` with `ZALO_OFFICIAL_ACCOUNT`, provide the Zalo Official Account ID. If `messaging_app_type` is `WHATSAPP` or `zalo_id_type` is `ZALO_PHONE_ACCOUNT`, this field is ignored and automatically set from `phone_info`. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

messaging_app_type.description: Valid only when `promotion_type` is `LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_SOCIAL_MEDIA_APP_MESSAGE`. Required when `optimization_goal` is `CONVERSATION`. If `optimization_goal` is `CLICK`, default is `IM_URL`. Companion fields depend on the value: `MESSENGER` requires `messaging_app_account_id` with a Facebook Page ID; `WHATSAPP` requires `phone_info`; `ZALO` requires `zalo_id_type`, and then `messaging_app_account_id` if `zalo_id_type=ZALO_OFFICIAL_ACCOUNT` or `phone_info` if `zalo_id_type=ZALO_PHONE_ACCOUNT`; `LINE` requires `messaging_app_account_id` with a LINE Business ID; `IM_URL` requires no companion account field. When `optimization_goal` is `CONVERSATION`, you cannot set this field to `LINE` or `IM_URL`. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

min_budget.description: Valid only when campaign `budget_optimize_on` is `true`, campaign `budget_mode` is `BUDGET_MODE_DYNAMIC_DAILY_BUDGET`, and ad-group `bid_type` is `BID_TYPE_NO_BID`. Minimum ad-group budget. The system will aim to spend at least this amount, but it is not guaranteed.

minis_id.description: Required when `promotion_type` is `MINI_APP` or `MINI_GAME`. TikTok Minis ID. If `promotion_type` is `MINI_APP`, provide a mini app ID; if `MINI_GAME`, provide a mini game ID.

movie_premiere_date.description: Valid when campaign `is_promotional_campaign` is `true` and the advertiser is allowlisted for theatrical-release promotion settings. Theatrical release date in `YYYY-MM-DD` (UTC+0).

native_series_id.description: Required when `promotion_type` is `NATIVE_SERIES`. TikTok Series ID.

operation_status.description: Status to apply when the ad group is created. Default is `ENABLE`.

optimization_event.description: Required when `pixel_id` is specified; or when `pixel_id` is not specified and `optimization_goal` is `IN_APP_EVENT` or `VALUE`; or when `pixel_id` is not specified and `minis_id` is specified. Conversion event. When CBO is enabled (`budget_optimize_on=true`) at the campaign level, this setting, if specified, must be the same across all ad groups in the same campaign.

optimization_goal.description: The measurable result to optimize for. Supported values are `CLICK`, `INSTALL`, `IN_APP_EVENT`, `VALUE`, `CONVERT`, `TRAFFIC_LANDING_PAGE_VIEW`, `CONVERSATION`, and `LEAD_GENERATION`. When CBO is enabled (`budget_optimize_on=true`) at the campaign level, this setting, if specified, must be the same across all ad groups in the same campaign. When `promotion_type` is `LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_SOCIAL_MEDIA_APP_MESSAGE` and `optimization_goal` is `CONVERSATION`, `messaging_app_type` can only be `MESSENGER`, `WHATSAPP`, or `ZALO`.

phone_info.description: Required when `messaging_app_type` is `WHATSAPP`, or when `messaging_app_type` is `ZALO` and `zalo_id_type` is `ZALO_PHONE_ACCOUNT`. Phone details used for WhatsApp or Zalo phone-number messaging. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

phone_number.description: Required when `phone_info` is specified. WhatsApp or Zalo phone number. For WhatsApp, use the same phone number connected to the Messaging Management Tool (MMT).

phone_region_calling_code.description: Required when `phone_info` is specified. Region calling code for the WhatsApp or Zalo phone number, for example `+1`.

phone_region_code.description: Required when `phone_info` is specified. Region code for the WhatsApp or Zalo phone number, for example `US`.

pixel_id.description: Required when campaign `objective_type` is `WEB_CONVERSIONS` or `LEAD_GENERATION` and ad-group `optimization_goal` is `CONVERT` or `VALUE`. Not supported when `optimization_goal` is `CLICK`, `INSTALL`, `IN_APP_EVENT`, or `TRAFFIC_LANDING_PAGE_VIEW`. Pixel ID.

placement_type.description: Placement strategy. By default, the system may automatically configure placements for Upgraded Smart+ campaigns. If only Select Placement is supported in your scenario, omitting `placement_type` and `placements` can trigger a placement error; in that case set `placement_type` to `PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL` and provide `placements`. `placement_type` cannot be updated after creation. If set to `PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC`, the actual supported placements are returned in `placements`.

placements.description: Required when `placement_type` is `PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL`. Ignored and overwritten by the system when `placement_type` is `PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC`. `placements` cannot be updated after creation. `PLACEMENT_GLOBAL_APP_BUNDLE` is limited to certain target locations and does not support `optimization_goal=TRAFFIC_LANDING_PAGE_VIEW`.

promotion_target_type.description: Required when `objective_type` is `LEAD_GENERATION`. Optimization location for lead generation. When CBO is enabled (`budget_optimize_on=true`) at the campaign level, this setting, if specified, must be the same across all ad groups in the same campaign.

promotion_type.description: Promotion type (optimization location). Choose where to promote. Supported values are `APP_ANDROID`, `APP_IOS`, `WEBSITE`, `MINI_APP`, `MINI_GAME`, `NATIVE_SERIES`, `LEAD_GENERATION`, `LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_TT_DIRECT_MESSAGE`, `LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_SOCIAL_MEDIA_APP_MESSAGE`, and `LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_CALL`, depending on campaign settings. When campaign `objective_type` is `APP_PROMOTION` and `app_promotion_type` is `APP_INSTALL` or `APP_RETARGETING`, set this to `APP_ANDROID` or `APP_IOS`. When `objective_type` is `APP_PROMOTION` and `app_promotion_type` is `MINIS`, set this to `MINI_APP`, `MINI_GAME`, or `NATIVE_SERIES`. When `objective_type` is `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, set this to `WEBSITE` if `sales_destination` is `WEBSITE`, or `APP_ANDROID`/`APP_IOS` if `sales_destination` is `APP`. When `objective_type` is `LEAD_GENERATION`, set this to one of `LEAD_GENERATION`, `LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_TT_DIRECT_MESSAGE`, `LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_SOCIAL_MEDIA_APP_MESSAGE`, or `LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_CALL`. When CBO is enabled (`budget_optimize_on=true`) at the campaign level, this setting must be the same across all ad groups in the same campaign.

request_id.description: Idempotency key for ad group creation.

roas_bid.description: Required when `deep_bid_type` is `VO_MIN_ROAS`. Target ROAS for value-based optimization. Range: 0.01 to 1,000. When CBO is enabled (`budget_optimize_on=true`) at the campaign level, this setting, if specified, must be the same across all ad groups in the same campaign.

schedule_end_time.description: Required when `schedule_type` is `SCHEDULE_START_END`. Schedule end time in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` (UTC+0). Must not be later than `2038-01-01 00:00:00`.

schedule_start_time.description: Schedule start time in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` (UTC+0). Can be up to 12 hours earlier than the current time, but not later than `2028-01-01 00:00:00`.

schedule_type.description: Schedule type. `SCHEDULE_FROM_NOW` can only be used when campaign-level or ad-group-level `budget_mode` is `BUDGET_MODE_DYNAMIC_DAILY_BUDGET`. `SCHEDULE_START_END` runs between `schedule_start_time` and `schedule_end_time`.

share_disabled.description: Whether to disable sharing to third-party platforms. Default is `false`.

suggestion_audience_enabled.description: Valid only when `targeting_optimization_mode` is `AUTOMATIC`. Whether to enable audience suggestions. Default is `false`. When `true`, you can additionally specify `age_groups`, `gender`, `audience_ids`, `interest_category_ids`, `interest_keyword_ids`, `purchase_intention_keyword_ids`, and `actions` in `targeting_spec` as suggestions for automatic targeting. These are guidance signals only and delivery to those audiences is not guaranteed. If targeting settings do not align with `targeting_optimization_mode` and `suggestion_audience_enabled`, they are ignored without error. You cannot set this field to `true` if Realtime API (RTA) is enabled at the campaign level.

targeting_optimization_mode.description: Audience targeting optimization mode. Default is `AUTOMATIC`. When `AUTOMATIC` and `suggestion_audience_enabled=false`, allowed targeting fields depend on campaign scenario but generally include a limited control set such as `location_ids`, `zipcode_ids`, `spc_audience_age`, `languages`, `operating_systems`, and `excluded_audience_ids`; for app-destination Smart+ catalog ad groups, it can instead include `audience_ids` and `gender` rather than some other fields. When `AUTOMATIC` and `suggestion_audience_enabled=true`, you can additionally provide suggestion fields such as `age_groups`, `gender`, `audience_ids`, `interest_category_ids`, `interest_keyword_ids`, `purchase_intention_keyword_ids`, and `actions`. When `MANUAL`, you can specify the full custom-targeting set listed under `targeting_spec`, including demographic, audience, interest, behavior, device, network, and saved-audience fields. If you send targeting settings that do not match the selected `targeting_optimization_mode` and `suggestion_audience_enabled`, those settings are ignored without error.

targeting_spec.description: Targeting settings object. Which nested fields are accepted depends on `targeting_optimization_mode` and `suggestion_audience_enabled`; see those fields for the exact allowed combinations.

action_category_ids.description: Valid only when TikTok is the only selected placement. Category, hashtag, or hashtag-bundle IDs used for the chosen `action_scene`.

action_period.description: Behavior lookback period. Allowed values: `0`, `7`, `15`. If `action_scene` is `CREATOR_RELATED` or `HASHTAG_RELATED`, `0` is used regardless of the value you pass. In TikTok Ads Manager, `VIDEO_RELATED` uses 15 days by default, but API calls may still pass `0`, `7`, or `15`.

video_user_actions.description: User actions to target. Allowed values depend on `action_scene`: for `VIDEO_RELATED`, use `WATCHED_TO_END`, `LIKED`, `COMMENTED`, `SHARED`; for `CREATOR_RELATED`, use `FOLLOWING`, `VIEW_HOMEPAGE`; for `HASHTAG_RELATED`, use `VIEW_HASHTAG`. In TikTok Ads Manager these are defaulted automatically for some scenes, but via API you can pass specific combinations.

age_groups.description: Age groups to target. `AGE_13_17` can only be used when campaign `objective_type` is `APP_PROMOTION` and `app_promotion_type` is `APP_INSTALL` or `APP_RETARGETING`.

app_targeting_type.description: Required and valid only when campaign `objective_type` is `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `sales_destination` is `APP`, and ad-group `optimization_goal` is `CLICK`, `IN_APP_EVENT`, or `VALUE`. App targeting type. When campaign `campaign_type` is `IOS14_CAMPAIGN`, you can only set this field to `PROSPECT`. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

audience_ids.description: Audience IDs to include. Not supported when campaign-level `rta_id` is specified.

blocked_pangle_app_ids.description: Pangle app block list IDs. Effective only when Pangle placement is selected.

carrier_ids.description: Carrier IDs to target. Carriers must be consistent with the targeted locations, and only carriers with `in_use=true` are valid.

device_model_ids.description: Device model IDs to target. Only active models can be used. Do not set together with `device_price_ranges`.

device_price_ranges.description: Device price range to target. Values must be multiples of 50; `10000` means 1000+. The upper bound you set is increased by 50 for the actual applied range shown in Ads Manager, so `[0,250]` actually means `[0,300]`.

excluded_audience_ids.description: Audience IDs to exclude. Not supported when campaign-level `rta_id` is specified.

excluded_custom_actions.description: When `shopping_ads_retargeting_type` is `LAB3`, you must specify either `included_custom_actions` or `excluded_custom_actions`. Catalog audience actions to exclude.

days.description: Lookback window for the excluded action. Range: 1-180.

excluded_pangle_audience_package_ids.description: Valid only for Pangle placement. Do not specify together with `included_pangle_audience_package_ids`. Pangle audience package IDs to exclude.

included_custom_actions.description: When `shopping_ads_retargeting_type` is `LAB3`, you must specify either `included_custom_actions` or `excluded_custom_actions`. Catalog audience actions to include.

days.description: Lookback window for the included action. Range: 1-180.

included_pangle_audience_package_ids.description: Valid only for Pangle placement. Do not specify together with `excluded_pangle_audience_package_ids`. Pangle audience package IDs to include.

interest_category_ids.description: General interest category IDs to target.

interest_keyword_ids.description: Additional interest category IDs to target.

isp_ids.description: Valid only when `location_ids` includes a valid country- or region-level location. ISP IDs to target. If you pass `isp_ids`, you cannot set placements to Global App Bundle only (`placements=["PLACEMENT_GLOBAL_APP_BUNDLE"]`).

location_ids.description: Location IDs to target. Required for most Upgraded Smart+ campaigns; if campaign `catalog_type` is `TRAVEL_ENTERTAINMENT`, you must provide `location_ids`, `zipcode_ids`, or both. If you add the US as a target location, you cannot remove the US after campaign creation.

operating_systems.description: Device operating systems to target. Only one value is allowed. If `promotion_type` is `APP_ANDROID`, this field is ignored and defaults to `["ANDROID"]`. If `promotion_type` is `APP_IOS`, this field is ignored and defaults to `["IOS"]`.

purchase_intention_keyword_ids.description: Purchase intention category IDs to target. Placement must include `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK` or `PLACEMENT_PANGLE`.

saved_audience_id.description: Valid when campaign `special_industries` does not specify Housing, Employment, or Credit, and TikTok placement is selected either through `placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC` or through `placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL` with `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK` in `placements`. Saved Audience ID. Do not simultaneously set `saved_audience_id` and targeting options contained in that saved audience, such as `gender`; if there is a conflict, the Saved Audience settings take precedence and conflicting ad-group settings are ignored. If the saved audience includes `age_groups`, the usual age restrictions for the campaign objective still apply.

shopping_ads_retargeting_actions_days.description: Required when `shopping_ads_retargeting_type` is `LAB1` or `LAB2`. Lookback window for the retargeted audience action. Allowed values: `1`, `2`, `3`, `7`, `14`, `30`, `60`, `90`, `180`.

shopping_ads_retargeting_custom_audience.description: Valid only when `shopping_ads_retargeting_type` is `LAB1`, `LAB2`, or `LAB3` and `audience_ids` is specified. Relation between shopping retargeting audience and `audience_ids`. If omitted, the audience defaults to the intersection of both sets (`AND`). Once set, this field cannot be updated to null.

shopping_ads_retargeting_type.description: Valid only when campaign `objective_type` is `WEB_CONVERSION`, `sales_destination` is `WEB_AND_APP`, `WEBSITE`, or `APP`, campaign `catalog_type` is `ECOMMERCE`, and ad-group `targeting_optimization_mode` is `MANUAL`. Retargeting type. Default is `OFF`. If `LAB1` or `LAB2`, you must also specify `shopping_ads_retargeting_actions_days`. If `LAB3`, you must specify either `included_custom_actions` or `excluded_custom_actions`.

smart_audience_enabled.description: Whether to enable Smart audience. Supported values: `true`, `false`.

smart_interest_behavior_enabled.description: Whether to enable Smart interests & behaviors. Supported values: `true`, `false`.

spc_audience_age.description: Smart+ audience age setting. Default is `OVER_EIGHTEEN`. `ALL` is allowlist-only and can be used only when campaign `smart_plus_adgroup_mode` is `MULTIPLE`.

spending_power.description: Spending power to target. If `HIGH`, targets users who typically spend more on TikTok ads than average users.

zipcode_ids.description: Zip code or postal code IDs for location targeting. If campaign `catalog_type` is `TRAVEL_ENTERTAINMENT`, you must provide `location_ids`, `zipcode_ids`, or both; otherwise `zipcode_ids` is not supported. Maximum 3,000 values combined across `location_ids` and `zipcode_ids`. Zip code targeting is only for the US; postal code targeting is supported for Canada, Brazil, Indonesia, Thailand, and Vietnam, with some countries allowlist-only. Not allowed with `special_industries`, not allowed when campaign `objective_type` is `RF_REACH`, and overlapping targeted locations are not supported. If you target US locations during creation, you can later change them to other US locations but cannot remove all US locations and target only non-US countries.

items.description: Valid only when the following conditions are met: At the campaign level: objective_type is APP_PROMOTION, LEAD_GENERATION, or WEB_CONVERSIONS. At the ad group level: placement_type is PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL and placements includes PLACEMENT_TIKTOK. The subplacements within TikTok for your ads, allowing you to choose where your ads will appear. Enum values: LEMON8: Lemon8, a community app for lifestyle content, focusing on real-life experiences, tips, guides, and product reviews. By including Lemon8 as a subplacement, your ads will appear in its For You feed, Search feed, and Immersive Video feed. Learn more about Lemon8 for Performance Auction. PINE_DRAMA: PineDrama, an app for watching short-form dramas. Ads will be placed on recommendation pages, within episode streams, and more. Learn more about PineDrama for Performance Auction.

vbo_window.description: Window for the selected value-based bidding strategy. Default is `SEVEN_DAYS`. When `deep_bid_type` uses Minimum ROAS / Target ROAS, this controls whether the target ROAS is Day 7 or Day 0. When Highest Value is used, this controls whether value is maximized within Day 7 or Day 0. This setting, if specified, must be the same across all ad groups in the same campaign. Some VBO IAP/VBO IAA Day 0 and Day 7 scenarios are allowlist-only. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

video_download_disabled.description: Whether users can download your video ads on TikTok. Default is `false`.

view_attribution_window.description: View-through attribution window. If you manually configure attribution windows, you must pass at least `click_attribution_window` and `view_attribution_window` together, and may optionally include `engaged_view_attribution_window`; if `engaged_view_attribution_window` is passed, it must be accompanied by both `click_attribution_window` and `view_attribution_window`. If you omit `click_attribution_window`, `engaged_view_attribution_window`, `view_attribution_window`, and `attribution_event_count`, default settings, if any, are used; you can confirm defaults via `/smart_plus/adgroup/get/`. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

zalo_id_type.description: Required when `messaging_app_type` is `ZALO`. Zalo contact format. If `ZALO_OFFICIAL_ACCOUNT`, you must also specify `messaging_app_account_id`. If `ZALO_PHONE_ACCOUNT`, you must also specify `phone_info`. You can only set `zalo_id_type` to `ZALO_PHONE_ACCOUNT` when `optimization_goal` is `CLICK`. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

fields.description: Fields to return. If omitted, all fields are returned by default.

adgroup_ids.description: Filter by ad group IDs. Max size: 100.

campaign_ids.description: Filter by campaign IDs. Max size: 100.

objective_type.description: Advertising objective. Supported values are `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, and `LEAD_GENERATION`.

optimization_goal.description: The measurable result to drive. Supported values are `CLICK`, `INSTALL`, `IN_APP_EVENT`, `VALUE`, `CONVERT`, `TRAFFIC_LANDING_PAGE_VIEW`, and `LEAD_GENERATION`.

primary_status.description: Primary status. Default is `STATUS_NOT_DELETE`, which returns ad groups in all statuses except `STATUS_DELETE`. To include deleted ad groups, use `STATUS_ALL`.

promotion_type.description: Promotion type (optimization location). Valid values depend on other fields: when `objective_type` is `APP_PROMOTION` and `app_promotion_type` is `APP_INSTAL`, this is `APP_ANDROID` or `APP_IOS`; when `objective_type` is `APP_PROMOTION` and `app_promotion_type` is `MINIS`, this is `MINI_APP`, `MINI_GAME`, or `NATIVE_SERIES`; when `objective_type` is `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, this is `WEBSITE` if `sales_destination` is `WEBSITE`, or `APP_ANDROID`/`APP_IOS` if `sales_destination` is `APP`; when `objective_type` is `LEAD_GENERATION`, this is `LEAD_GENERATION`, `LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_TT_DIRECT_MESSAGE`, `LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_SOCIAL_MEDIA_APP_MESSAGE`, or `LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_CALL`.

sales_destination.description: Sales destination. `WEBSITE` drives sales on your website. `APP` drives sales on your app and requires a product catalog. `WEB_AND_APP` drives sales on both your website and your app.

page.description: Current page number. Default value: 1. Value range: greater than or equal to 1.

page_size.description: Page size. Default value: 10. Value range: 1-1000.

adgroup_ids.description: IDs of the ad groups to operate on. Size range: 1-20. To obtain valid ad group IDs, use /smart_plus/adgroup/get/.

operation_status.description: Operation to perform on the ad groups. Allowed values: `DISABLE` (pause), `ENABLE` (enable), `DELETE` (delete). The status of deleted ad groups, or ad groups in deleted campaigns, cannot be modified.

adgroup_id.description: Ad group ID to update. Obtain valid IDs from `/smart_plus/adgroup/get/`.

adgroup_name.description: Ad group name. Maximum length is 512 characters. Emoji is not supported.

bid_price.description: Valid only when `optimization_goal` is `CLICK` and `bid_type` is `BID_TYPE_CUSTOM`. Target cost per click; the system aims to keep average CPC around or below this amount. `bid_price` must be lower than `budget`. Important: if multiple ad groups exist in the same campaign, updating `bid_price` on one ad group automatically updates `bid_price` for all other ad groups in that campaign. When CBO is enabled at the campaign level (`budget_optimize_on=true`), this setting, if specified, must be the same across all ad groups in the campaign.

budget.description: Fixed ad group budget or initial ad group budget. When `budget_auto_adjust_strategy` is `UNSET`, this is the fixed ad group budget. When `budget_auto_adjust_strategy` is `AUTO_BUDGET_INCREASE`, this is the initial ad group budget; use the returned `current_budget` to retrieve the current budget value.

budget_auto_adjust_strategy.description: Ad group budget strategy for custom ad group budget. Valid only when campaign-level `budget_optimize_on` is `false` and ad-group-level conditions are met: for `objective_type=APP_PROMOTION`, `budget_mode` must be `BUDGET_MODE_DYNAMIC_DAILY_BUDGET`, `optimization_goal` must be `VALUE`, `deep_bid_type` must be `VO_MIN_ROAS`, and `vbo_window` must be `ZERO_DAY`; for `objective_type=LEAD_GENERATION`, `budget_mode` must be `BUDGET_MODE_DYNAMIC_DAILY_BUDGET` and `bid_type` must be `BID_TYPE_CUSTOM`. `AUTO_BUDGET_INCREASE` enables Goal-based budget increase; when used, `budget` is the initial daily budget and may increase by 20% up to 10 times per day when budget utilization reaches 90% or more, then resets to the original daily budget each day. `UNSET` disables Goal-based budget increase. This feature is allowlist-only.

comment_disabled.description: Whether to disable comments on TikTok. Supported values: `true`, `false`.

conversion_bid_price.description: Valid only when `optimization_goal` is `CONVERT`, `TRAFFIC_LANDING_PAGE_VIEW`, `INSTALL`, or `IN_APP_EVENT`, and `bid_type` is `BID_TYPE_CUSTOM`. Target cost per conversion or landing page view; the system aims to keep average cost around or below this amount. `conversion_bid_price` must be lower than `budget`. Important: if multiple ad groups exist in the same campaign, updating `conversion_bid_price` on one ad group automatically updates the campaign's corresponding bid value for all other ad groups in that campaign. When CBO is enabled at the campaign level (`budget_optimize_on=true`), this setting, if specified, must be the same across all ad groups in the campaign.

dayparting.description: Ad delivery schedule as a 48 × 7 character string, where each character represents a 30-minute slot from Monday to Sunday: `1` for delivery and `0` for no delivery. The first character maps to Monday 00:01-00:30, the second to Monday 00:31-01:00, and the last to Sunday 23:31-00:00. An all-0 value, an all-1 value, or omitting this field is treated as full-time delivery.

is_hfss.description: Valid only when `targeting_optimization_mode` is `MANUAL`. Whether the promoted content is a HFSS (High Fat, Salt, Sugar) product or brand. Set to `true` if the ad promotes or prominently features HFSS content. In regulated regions, HFSS ads must target users aged 18 or over. You can set this field to `true` when targeting locations include the UK, Australia, New Zealand, or the European Union. Supported values: `true`, `false`.

is_lhf_compliance.description: Required and must be `true` when targeting locations include the UK and `is_hfss` is `true`. Confirms the promoted content complies with UK Less Healthy Foods regulations. By setting this field to `true`, you confirm that any food or drink products advertised on TikTok in the UK comply with the 2024 Less Healthy Foods Regulations and other applicable laws. Supported values: `true`, `false`.

roas_bid.description: Valid only when `deep_bid_type` is `VO_MIN_ROAS`. Target ROAS for Value-Based Optimization. Range: 0.01-1000. Important: if multiple ad groups exist in the same campaign, updating `roas_bid` on one ad group automatically updates the corresponding bidding value for all other ad groups in that campaign. When CBO is enabled at the campaign level (`budget_optimize_on=true`), this setting, if specified, must be the same across all ad groups in the campaign.

schedule_end_time.description: Valid only when `schedule_type` is `SCHEDULE_START_END`. Schedule end time in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` (UTC+0). The end time cannot be later than `2038-01-01 00:00:00`.

schedule_start_time.description: Schedule start time in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` (UTC+0). The start time can be up to 12 hours earlier than the current time, but cannot be later than `2028-01-01 00:00:00`.

schedule_type.description: Schedule type. `SCHEDULE_FROM_NOW` runs continuously after the scheduled start time. `SCHEDULE_START_END` runs only between the scheduled start and end times. You can set `schedule_type` to `SCHEDULE_START_END` only when `budget_mode` is `BUDGET_MODE_TOTAL` at the campaign level or at the ad group level.

share_disabled.description: Whether to disable sharing of the campaign to third-party platforms. Supported values: `true`, `false`.

suggestion_audience_enabled.description: Valid only when `targeting_optimization_mode` is `AUTOMATIC`. Whether to enable audience suggestions. When `true`, you can additionally specify `age_groups`, `gender`, `audience_ids`, `interest_category_ids`, `interest_keyword_ids`, `purchase_intention_keyword_ids`, and `actions` as suggestions for automatic targeting; delivery to those audiences is not guaranteed. If targeting settings do not align with `targeting_optimization_mode` and `suggestion_audience_enabled`, those settings are ignored without error. You cannot set this field to `true` if Realtime API (RTA) is enabled at the campaign level. Supported values: `true`, `false`.

targeting_optimization_mode.description: Audience targeting optimization mode. `AUTOMATIC` enables automatic targeting using real-time data and machine learning. When `targeting_optimization_mode` is `AUTOMATIC` and `suggestion_audience_enabled` is `false`, you can specify only these optional audience control settings: `location_ids`, `zipcode_ids`, `spc_audience_age`, `languages`, `operating_systems`, `excluded_audience_ids`. When `targeting_optimization_mode` is `AUTOMATIC` and `suggestion_audience_enabled` is `true`, you can additionally specify `age_groups`, `gender`, `audience_ids`, `interest_category_ids`, `interest_keyword_ids`, `purchase_intention_keyword_ids`, and `actions` as suggestions that guide automatic targeting. `MANUAL` enables custom targeting; when `targeting_optimization_mode` is `MANUAL`, you can specify `location_ids`, `zipcode_ids`, `age_groups`, `gender`, `languages`, `audience_ids`, `excluded_audience_ids`, `interest_category_ids`, `interest_keyword_ids`, `purchase_intention_keyword_ids`, `actions`, `smart_interest_behavior_enabled`, `smart_audience_enabled`, `spending_power`, `household_income`, `operating_systems`, `min_android_version`, `min_ios_version`, `device_model_ids`, `network_types`, `carrier_ids`, `isp_ids`, `device_price_ranges`, and `saved_audience_id`. If you specify targeting settings that do not align with `targeting_optimization_mode` and `suggestion_audience_enabled`, those settings are ignored without error.

action_category_ids.description: Valid only when TikTok is the only placement selected. IDs of video interaction categories, creator interaction categories, hashtags, or hashtag bundles to target.

action_period.description: Lookback period for behaviors. If `action_scene` is `CREATOR_RELATED` or `HASHTAG_RELATED`, `0` is used regardless of the value you specify. When creating via API, you can pass `0`, `7`, or `15`.

video_user_actions.description: Specific user actions to target. If `action_scene` is `VIDEO_RELATED`, allowed values are `WATCHED_TO_END`, `LIKED`, `COMMENTED`, `SHARED`. If `action_scene` is `CREATOR_RELATED`, allowed values are `FOLLOWING`, `VIEW_HOMEPAGE`. If `action_scene` is `HASHTAG_RELATED`, allowed value is `VIEW_HASHTAG`.

age_groups.description: Age groups to target. `AGE_13_17` can be used only when campaign-level `objective_type` is `APP_PROMOTION` and `app_promotion_type` is `APP_INSTALL` or `APP_RETARGETING`.

audience_ids.description: Audience IDs to include. Not supported when campaign-level `rta_id` is specified.

blocked_pangle_app_ids.description: Pangle app block IDs. Effective only when Pangle placement is selected. Use the `app_package_id` returned by `/pangle_block_list/get/`.

carrier_ids.description: Carrier IDs to target. Carriers must be consistent with the targeted locations, and only carriers with `in_use=true` are valid.

device_model_ids.description: Device model IDs to target. Only active devices (`is_active=true`) from `/tool/device_model/` can be used. `device_model_ids` and `device_price_ranges` cannot be set at the same time.

device_price_ranges.description: Device price range targeting. Values must be multiples of 50; `10000` means 1000+. Important: the upper limit you set is increased by 50 and that new value is used as the actual upper limit. For example, `[0,250]` actually means `[0,300]`.

excluded_audience_ids.description: Audience IDs to exclude. Not supported when campaign-level `rta_id` is specified.

excluded_custom_actions.description: Details of catalog audiences to exclude. When `shopping_ads_retargeting_type` is `LAB3`, you must specify either `included_custom_actions` or `excluded_custom_actions`.

code.description: Custom action used to exclude audiences when building catalog retargeting.

days.description: Lookback window in days for the specified action. Range: 1-180.

included_custom_actions.description: Details of catalog audiences to include. When `shopping_ads_retargeting_type` is `LAB3`, you must specify either `included_custom_actions` or `excluded_custom_actions`.

code.description: Custom action used to include audiences when building catalog retargeting.

days.description: Lookback window in days for the specified action. Range: 1-180.

interest_category_ids.description: General interest category IDs to target.

interest_keyword_ids.description: Additional interest category IDs to target.

isp_ids.description: Valid only when `location_ids` includes a valid country- or region-level location ID. ISP IDs to target. When `isp_ids` is passed, placement cannot be Global App Bundle only (`placements=["PLACEMENT_GLOBAL_APP_BUNDLE"]`).

location_ids.description: Location IDs to target. When `catalog_type` is `TRAVEL_ENTERTAINMENT` at the campaign level, you must set `location_ids`, `zipcode_ids`, or both. For other Smart+ campaign types, `location_ids` is required. If the US is included as a target location, you cannot remove the US after campaign creation.

operating_systems.description: Device operating systems to target. Only one value is allowed. When `promotion_type` is `APP_ANDROID`, this field is ignored and defaults to `["ANDROID"]`. When `promotion_type` is `APP_IOS`, this field is ignored and defaults to `["IOS"]`.

purchase_intention_keyword_ids.description: Purchase intention category IDs to target audiences interested in purchases related to a content category. Placement must include `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK` or `PLACEMENT_PANGLE`.

saved_audience_id.description: Valid only when campaign `special_industries` does not include Housing, Employment, or Credit, and TikTok placement is selected (`placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC` or `placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL` with `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK` included in `placements`). Saved Audience ID. The Saved Audience must belong to the same advertiser as the ad group. Avoid passing both `saved_audience_id` and overlapping targeting options from that Saved Audience, such as `gender`, because Saved Audience settings take precedence and conflicting ad group targeting is ignored. If the Saved Audience was created with `age_groups`, the applicable age restriction rules still apply.

shopping_ads_retargeting_actions_days.description: Required when `shopping_ads_retargeting_type` is `LAB1` or `LAB2`. The lookback window, in days, for audience actions to retarget. Allowed values: `1`, `2`, `3`, `7`, `14`, `30`, `60`, `90`, `180`.

shopping_ads_retargeting_custom_audience.description: Valid only when `shopping_ads_retargeting_type` is `LAB1`, `LAB2`, or `LAB3`, and `audience_ids` is specified. Defines the logical relation between the retargeting audience and `audience_ids`. `OR` targets anyone in either audience set. `AND` targets only people in both. If omitted, the default behavior is `AND`. Once set, this field cannot be updated to a null value.

shopping_ads_retargeting_type.description: Retargeting type. Valid only when campaign-level `objective_type` is `WEB_CONVERSION`, `sales_destination` is `WEB_AND_APP`, `WEBSITE`, or `APP`, campaign-level `catalog_type` is `ECOMMERCE`, and ad-group-level `targeting_optimization_mode` is `MANUAL`. `LAB1` retargets people who viewed products or added to cart but did not purchase. `LAB2` retargets people who added to cart but did not purchase. `LAB3` uses a custom combination and requires either `included_custom_actions` or `excluded_custom_actions`. `OFF` disables retargeting.

smart_audience_enabled.description: Whether Smart audience is enabled. Supported values: `true`, `false`.

smart_interest_behavior_enabled.description: Whether Smart interests & behaviors is enabled. Supported values: `true`, `false`.

spc_audience_age.description: Age group for the ad group. `ALL` targets all age groups, `18+` targets ages 18 and above, and `25+` targets ages 25 and above. `ALL` is allowlist-only and can be used only when campaign-level `smart_plus_adgroup_mode` is `MULTIPLE`. Use `/smart_plus/campaign/get/` to check the campaign's `smart_plus_adgroup_mode`.

spending_power.description: Spending power to target. `HIGH` targets users who typically spend more on TikTok ads than average users.

zipcode_ids.description: Zip code or postal code IDs to target. When `catalog_type` is `TRAVEL_ENTERTAINMENT` at the campaign level, you must set `location_ids`, `zipcode_ids`, or both. For other Smart+ campaign types, `zipcode_ids` is not supported. Maximum 3000 items total across `location_ids` and `zipcode_ids`. ZIP targeting is supported only for the US; postal code targeting is supported only for Canada, Brazil, Indonesia, Thailand, and Vietnam. Postal code targeting in Brazil, Indonesia, Thailand, and Vietnam is allowlist-only. Not supported when campaign `special_industries` is enabled or when campaign `objective_type` is `RF_REACH`. Overlapping locations are not supported. If US locations were targeted at creation through `location_ids` or `zipcode_ids`, you can later change them to other US locations but cannot remove all US targeting and target only non-US countries. To retrieve details for these IDs, use `/tool/targeting/info/`.
